Abstract: Distributional Diffusion Models (DDMs) replace the standard mean-prediction denoiser with a \emph{distributional} denoiser trained via a scoring rule objective, learning a stochastic approximation to $p(x_1 \mid x_t)$ rather than its conditional mean. However, scaling DDMs to modern image-generation settings faces two obstacles: (i) multi-particle training incurs overhead that scales with the number of particles, (ii) DDMs use globally fixed scoring rule hyperparameters, forcing a single trade-off across sampling budgets. We mitigate these limitations by deferring particle expansion to late transformer layers, and the hyperparameter trade-off by introducing time-dependent scoring rule schedules informed by the dynamical regimes of~\citet{Biroli2024}. Combined with a DiT-based latent setup, these changes make DDM training practical on class-conditional ImageNet-$256^2$, achieving 4.48 FID at 4 steps and 2.38 at 50 steps with DiT-XL/2, from a single model trained from scratch in one stage, without a teacher, self-distillation or JVPs. The result is a stochastic few-step generator whose FID does not degrade as the sampling budget grows from 4 to 50 NFE, and the same recipe transfers to text-to-image generation. Code and pre-trained models available at https://github.com/CompVis/iDDM.

</details>


### [122] [End-to-End Self-Supervised RGB-T Tracking without Modality Misleading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37162)
*Shenglan Li,Rui Yao,Kunyang Sun,Hong Jia,Yong Zhou,Javen Qinfeng Shi,Xinyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ESMTrack 提出一种全端到端自监督 RGB-T 跟踪框架，仅用首帧标注，通过跨模态对比与模态解耦机制实现竞争性 SOTA 性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有监督 RGB-T 跟踪依赖昂贵的模态对齐边界框标注；自监督方法多采用两阶段伪标签范式，训练对伪标签质量敏感，且无法端到端联合优化。

Method: 提出 ESMTrack，仅需首帧标注。使用两个目标：首帧接地三元组损失和无标注搜索帧的跨帧时序三元组损失，通过前向-后向一致性筛选可靠样本。采用三分支架构（融合分支 + RGB/热红外单模态分支），以 Average Peak-to-Correlation Energy 量化模态贡献，并用可靠性估计引导训练时的模态解耦机制，抑制主导模态捷径并自适应加权跨模态对比学习。

Result: 在五个 RGB-T 跟踪基准上取得竞争性 SOTA 性能，具有强跨数据集泛化能力和实时推理速度。

Conclusion: ESMTrack 验证了无需离线伪标签和密集帧级标注的全端到端自监督 RGB-T 跟踪的可行性，代码已开源。

Abstract: RGB-T object tracking leverages the complementary characteristics of visible and thermal infrared modalities to improve robustness under adverse conditions. Existing supervised methods typically rely on costly modality-aligned bounding box annotations, while most self-supervised approaches follow a two-stage pseudo-labeling paradigm, making tracker training sensitive to pseudo-label quality and preventing joint end-to-end optimization. In this paper, we propose ESMTrack, a fully end-to-end self-supervised RGB-T tracking framework without offline pseudo-label generation or dense frame-level bounding box annotations. Given only the standard initial-frame annotation used in visual tracking, ESMTrack learns discriminative and temporally consistent representations through two complementary objectives: a grounding triplet loss on annotated initial frames and a cross-frame temporal triplet loss on unlabeled search frames, with reliable samples selected by forward-backward consistency. To address modality dominance bias, ESMTrack employs a three-branch architecture consisting of a fusion branch and two unimodal branches for RGB and thermal inputs. We quantify modality contributions using the Average Peak-to-Correlation Energy by measuring response discrepancies between the fusion and unimodal branches. The resulting reliability estimates guide a training-time modality decoupling mechanism that suppresses dominant-modality shortcuts and adaptively weights cross-modal contrastive learning for task-level alignment. Extensive experiments on five RGB-T tracking benchmarks show that ESMTrack achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance, strong cross-dataset generalization, and real-time inference speed. The source code is available at https://github.com/LiShenglana/ESMTrack.

</details>


### [123] [Sparse cubical complexes for efficient topology-preservation in image data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37177)
*Alexander H. Berger,Marco Fontana,Daniel Rueckert,Johannes C. Paetzold,Laurin Lux,Ulrich Bauer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出稀疏立方滤波（sparse cubical filtrations），作为持续同调（PH）计算的替代基础，大幅降低运行成本，并在图像分割中保持甚至提升拓扑精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续同调在图像分割等领域能有效提取和保留拓扑信息，但尽管适用性广泛，其运行成本高昂，使实际应用常不可行。作者认为该成本主要源于处理了对下游任务（如优化目标）不重要的信息，因此希望降低计算开销。

Method: 提出稀疏立方滤波作为PH计算的替代基础，通过减少对下游任务无用信息的处理来降低后续计算成本；并与稠密对应方法进行对比，在真实数据集上验证其优化信号的一致性。

Result: 在真实数据集上计算成本最高降低100倍；与稠密方法的优化信号高度一致；在3D大数据块等现实中其他PH目标难以运行的训练场景中有效；在六个不同数据集上拓扑精度提升最高达80%，同时保持像素级和区域级精度。

Conclusion: 稀疏立方滤波能够显著降低PH计算成本，并可在以往不可行的训练场景中作为有效优化目标，提升拓扑精度而不牺牲其他精度。

Abstract: Persistent homology (PH) is a frequently used tool for extracting and preserving topological information from image data, particularly in image segmentation, where preservation of topological structures is important. However, despite its general applicability across dimensionality, domains, and target structures, the runtime cost of PH-based methods often makes their practical use infeasible. In this work, we argue that this runtime cost is largely driven by processing information that is unimportant for downstream application (e.g. as optimization objective). We propose sparse cubical filtrations as an alternative foundation for PH computation, reducing subsequent computational costs by factors of up to 100 on real datasets. We show close agreement with the optimization signal of the dense counterpart and empirically evaluate our solution's effectiveness as an optimization objective in realistic training regimes where other PH-based objectives can practically not operate (i.e., 3D data with large patch sizes). We show how our solution improves topological accuracy by up to 80\% across six diverse datasets while maintaining pixel- and region-based accuracy.

</details>


### [124] [InsightMap: Structured Spatial Modeling for Embodied Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37187)
*Hongpei Zheng,Hujun Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: InsightMap 用自上而下地图作为显式空间记忆与动作条件预测目标，共享多模态骨干同时学习导航动作预测与动作后地图生成，在导航与静态空间任务上均取得领先结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言引导导航需将局部观测连接到持续的空间参照，并学习动作如何改变该表征，现有方法缺乏显式且可预测的空间记忆机制。

Method: 将历史视图关联到带标签的地图位置；用共享多模态骨干联合学习导航动作预测与动作后地图生成；地图预测提供辅助监督，导航推理从观测空间上下文解码动作；构建对齐的 RGB-D 数据管线支持导航、VQA、情境推理与 3D 定位的统一接口。

Result: R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 未见验证集 SR 分别为 56.9% 与 54.9%；加入地图预测监督使 R2R-CE 的 SR 提升 4.3、SPL 提升 3.2 个百分点；ScanQA 103.7 CIDEr、SQA3D 60.1% 精确匹配、ScanRefer 0.5 IoU 定位准确率 53.1%；在 Unitree Go2 的走廊、实验室和办公环境中优于 NaVid 与 NaVILA。

Conclusion: 以地图为显式记忆与预测目标的多模态框架能有效统一导航与静态空间理解任务，并提升真实机器人部署表现。

Abstract: Language-guided navigation requires connecting partial observations to a persistent spatial reference and learning how actions change that representation. We introduce InsightMap, a framework that uses top-down maps as both explicit spatial memory and action-conditioned prediction targets. Historical views are linked to labeled map locations, and a shared multimodal backbone jointly learns navigation action prediction and post-action map generation. Map prediction provides auxiliary training supervision, while navigation inference decodes actions from the observed spatial context. An aligned RGB-D data pipeline supports a common interface for navigation, visual question answering, situated reasoning, and 3D grounding. On the validation-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, InsightMap achieves success rates (SR) of 56.9% and 54.9%, respectively. Adding map-prediction supervision improves R2R-CE SR by 4.3 and success weighted by path length (SPL) by 3.2 percentage points. On static spatial tasks, InsightMap achieves 103.7 CIDEr on ScanQA, 60.1% exact-match accuracy on SQA3D, and 53.1% grounding accuracy at 0.5 IoU on ScanRefer with detected object proposals. On Unitree Go2, it outperforms NaVid and NaVILA in hallway, lab, and office environments.

</details>


### [125] [HaPRL: Human-Anchored Process Reinforcement Learning for Visual Search Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37190)
*Zhangquan Chen,Yaoxin Niu,Xiang An,Mingze Sun,Zhumei Wang,Chih-Ting Liao,Hongkun Cao,Ruqi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HaPRL：首个利用人类搜索行为强化多轮视觉搜索智能体搜索过程的框架，通过1K+人类标注数据与任务自适应评判器，显著优于仅基于结果的强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮视觉搜索智能体仅以最终答案作为奖励，搜索过程缺乏监督，导致"推理错误但结果正确"的错误路径频繁出现，进而造成无效训练（沿错误路径扩展）。

Method: 构建标注平台，收集1K+带细粒度行为信号的人类标注数据；训练时设计评判器（judge），以人类在同一图像上实际搜索轨迹的蒸馏信号为锚点，用任务自适应权重对每个rollout打分。

Result: HaPRL持续优于基于结果的强化学习；早期引入过程监督使后续基于结果的扩展（scaling）效果提升6.7倍。

Conclusion: 将模型行为与人类过程标注信号对齐至关重要，为基座模型训练提供了新见解。

Abstract: Multi-turn visual search agents answer questions about high-resolution images by iteratively deciding where to look. Reinforcement learning for these agents rewards only the final answer, leaving the search process unsupervised. Consequently, faulty routes in which the reasoning process is erroneous yet the final result is correct arise frequently, which in turn leads to ineffective training, i.e., scaling along the wrong paths. In this paper, we introduce HaPRL, the first framework to reinforce the search process with human search behavior. We first build an annotation platform and collect 1K+ human-annotated data with fine-grained behavioral signals. During training, a carefully designed judge scores each rollout with task-adaptive weights, anchored on the distilled trace of how a human annotator actually searched the same image. Extensive experiments show that HaPRL consistently outperforms outcome-based RL, and early-stage process supervision yields 6.7x more improvement in subsequent outcome-based scaling. Our results also demonstrate the importance of aligning model behavior with human process annotation signals, which offer new insight into the training of foundation models.

</details>


### [126] [Exploring In-Context Learning for Handwritten Text Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37195)
*Eric Ayllon,Abel Gandia,Jorge Calvo-Zaragoza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文探索使用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）的上下文学习（In-Context Learning）构建无需更新参数的手写文本识别（HTR）流程，并在多数据集、跨域场景下评估其性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HTR研究多依赖需要大量标注样本的专用模型，成本高、难以泛化。作者希望利用通用VLM的上下文学习能力，实现无需参数更新即可转录手写文本，以降低成本并提升跨域适用性。

Method: 采用预训练VLM，通过上下文学习构建转录流程，不更新模型参数。在多个数据集和模型上进行评估，涵盖受控的同域（ID）场景和更贴近实际的跨域（CD）场景（上下文示例来自与查询图像不同的数据集）。同时分析上下文样本数量与采样方式对性能的影响。

Result: 在同域和跨域场景下结果呈现相同规律：随着上下文规模增大，误差范围收窄并趋向平均性能，即更大的上下文规模会牺牲最优采样（oracle-best sampling）的性能以换取更低的期望误差。结果表明，无需任何参数更新，该方法在存在域偏移时有潜力与传统的HTR竞争；此外，不同的上下文采样方式效果差异明显。

Conclusion: 通用VLM可被有效教会从图像转录手写文本，无需参数更新即可在域偏移下具备竞争力。不同上下文采样方式效果不同，未来应投入更多精力寻找理想的采样方法。

Abstract: Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) systems have become an indispensable tool for the digitization of historical documents. Not only do they cut down time and cost, but they also allow democratizing access and processing of their contents by generating their transcripts. However, literature in HTR currently focuses mostly on specialized models that require large amounts of annotated samples to achieve satisfactory performance.
  We explore the use of In-Context Learning with pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to create a transcription pipeline without updating the model's parameters. We then evaluate this pipeline across multiple collections and models, and demonstrate that general-purpose VLMs can be effectively taught how to transcribe handwritten text from images. To assess how our observations may translate to practical applications, we evaluate the performance in a Cross-Domain (CD) scenario, where context examples are drawn from a different collection than the query image.
  Results in both the controlled In-Domain (ID) scenario and the realistic CD scenario follow the same patterns. First, as context size grows, the error range is expected to narrow towards the average performance. Thus, larger context sizes sacrifice the performance of the oracle-best sampling for lower expected error rates.
  The results obtained show that, without any parameter updates, this methodology has strong potential to compete with traditional HTR in the presence of domain shift. Moreover, we show and argue that some context samplings work better than others and suggest more effort should be put into finding an ideal sampling method in future work.

</details>


### [127] [Adaptive Reward Routing: Dynamic Multi-Reward Optimization for Joint Audio-Video Diffusion via Forward-Process RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37200)
*Songlin Yang,Xiaotong Zhao,Jiacheng Zhang,Zhe Wang,Toyota Li,Eric Liu,Alan Zhao,Anyi Rao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出自适应奖励路由（Adaptive Reward Routing），在联合音视频扩散模型的前向过程强化学习（DiffusionNFT）中，同步动态调整更新位置与奖励协调方式，从而提升模态质量、语义一致性与音视频同步性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多奖励引导的强化学习可沿多个互补目标（模态特定质量、跨模态语义对齐、时序同步）改进联合音视频扩散模型，但其效果依赖于两个随训练变化的量：奖励驱动的更新应作用于何处，以及竞争性奖励应如何组合。现有方法多采用固定的路由与奖励权重，无法跟踪模型功能的演化。

Method: 方法包含两个组件：(i) 跨模态影响引导路由（更新定位）：以双向跨注意力响应作为演化中跨模态影响的高效代理，动态重加权 token 感知损失，并在跨模态层间缩放梯度，无需额外模型干预。(ii) 保偏好模态感知重加权（奖励协调）：将预设权重保留为偏好先验，在预热后以分支特定的奖励梯度交互作为残差修正，从而解决演化中的冲突，避免强奖励压制弱但关键的目标。

Result: 大量实验表明，在模态质量、语义一致性和音视频同步性方面，相比强强化学习基线取得了一致提升；消融与机制分析进一步验证了自适应更新路由与奖励协调的互补收益。

Conclusion: 通过联合自适应更新位置与奖励协调，所提方法能有效应对训练过程中模型功能与奖励冲突的演化，是提升联合音视频扩散模型多目标性能的有效途径。

Abstract: Multi-reward guided reinforcement learning (i.e., RL) offers a promising way to improve joint audio-video diffusion models along several complementary objectives, including modality-specific quality, cross-modal semantic alignment, and temporal synchronization. Its effectiveness, however, depends on two quantities that change during training: where reward-driven updates should act, and how competing rewards should be combined. Existing methods tend to rely on fixed routing and reward weights, failing to track evolving model functions. To address these limitations, we propose Adaptive Reward Routing to jointly adapt update locations and reward coordination during forward-process RL (i.e., DiffusionNFT) of joint audio-video diffusion models. Our method consists of two components. (i) Cross-Modal Influence-Guided Routing (Localizing Updates): We use bidirectional cross-attention responses as an efficient proxy for evolving cross-modal influence, dynamically reweighting token-aware losses and scaling gradients across cross-modal layers without additional model interventions. (ii) Preference-Preserving Modality-Aware Reweighting (Coordinating Rewards): We preserve predefined weights as preference priors and use branch-specific reward-gradient interactions as residual corrections after warm-up. This resolves evolving conflicts without letting dominant rewards suppress weak but essential objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in modality quality, semantic consistency, and audio-video synchronization over strong RL baselines. Ablations and mechanism analyses further validate the complementary benefits of adaptive update routing and reward coordination.

</details>


### [128] [ResComEmb: Effective and Efficient Multimodal Embedding via Residual Homogeneity Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37225)
*Zijing Cai,Yuzhe Wang,Jingxian Zhu,Fengbin Zhu,Richang Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ResComEmb 提出了一种多向量多模态嵌入框架，通过多粒度视图编码、残差同质压缩和长度自适应双向后期交互匹配，在降低视觉 token 预算的同时提升了通用多模态嵌入质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型嵌入方法存在两难：将输入压缩为单一向量会限制细粒度表达能力；而保留长序列视觉 token 向量则带来高昂的存储与交互成本。因此需要一种兼顾效果与效率的通用多向量多模态嵌入方案。

Method: ResComEmb 首先在原生动态分辨率下将每个输入编码为有序的全局、中间和细粒度视图；经 MLLM 上下文化和嵌入投影后，使用可训练的残差同质压缩（RHC）模块，在显式视觉 token 预算下减少粒度内冗余与跨粒度重复；随后引入长度自适应的双向后期交互匹配机制，对每一方向的最强 token 级匹配取平均，并依据双方有效 token 数量加权组合两个分数以进行查询-文档评分。

Result: 在 MMEB、ViDoRe V1 和 ViDoRe V2 上的大量实验表明，ResComEmb 生成的通用多模态嵌入质量优于 VLM2Vec-V2；在视觉文档检索中仅使用 ColQwen2.5 全部视觉 token 预算的 37.5% 即可超越后者，展现出良好的效果-效率权衡。

Conclusion: ResComEmb 通过多粒度编码、冗余压缩与自适应匹配，有效解决了单向量表达不足与长序列成本高的矛盾，在通用多模态嵌入与视觉文档检索任务中实现了更优的效果-效率平衡。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for universal multimodal representation learning. However, existing methods either compress each input into a single vector, limiting fine-grained expressiveness, or retain long sequences of visual-token vectors, incurring substantial storage and interaction costs. To resolve this trade-off, we propose ResComEmb, a trainable framework for effective and efficient universal multi-vector multimodal embedding. ResComEmb first encodes each input at native dynamic resolution into ordered global, intermediate, and fine-grained views. After MLLM contextualization and embedding projection, a trainable Residual Homogeneity Compression (RHC) module reduces within-granularity redundancy and cross-granularity repetition under explicit visual token budgets. Then, ResComEmb introduces a length-adaptive Bidirectional Late-Interaction Matching mechanism for robust query-document scoring, which averages the strongest token-level matches in each direction and combines the two scores using a weight based on how many valid tokens each side has. Extensive experiments on MMEB, ViDoRe V1, and ViDoRe V2 show that ResComEmb produces higher-quality universal multimodal embeddings than VLM2Vec-V2, and outperforms ColQwen2.5 in visual document retrieval using only 37.5% of its full visual token budget, demonstrating a favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off.

</details>


### [129] [AESOP: Asymmetric Human-Camera Generation with Translation-Intensity Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37229)
*Jingzhong Lin,Zhanke Wang,Heng Li,Wenxiang Liu,Zhao Zhang,Kecheng Tang,Dongdong Xiang,Changbo Wang,Di Kang,Chunchao Guo,Linchao Bao,Gaoqi He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AESOP是一个统一框架，用非对称结构同时处理"给定人体动作生成相机轨迹"和"人体-相机联合生成"两个任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机生成与人体-相机联合生成通常被当作两个独立任务，但二者共享一种非对称依赖关系：人体动作可独立生成，而相机运动是对已实现动作的响应。同时，现有方法中相机平移强度难以明确指定。

Method: 提出AESOP框架，包含独立的人体通路与共享的人体条件相机生成器，非对称架构在相机生成时保留人体输出。针对平移强度欠定义问题，构建在相机平移幅度上不同、但共享人体动作与相机文本的轨迹对，据此学习显式的强度条件。

Result: 在PulpMotion数据集上的实验表明，两个任务在相机分布与构图质量上均表现良好，并能有效控制相机平移强度。

Conclusion: 统一框架AESOP有效利用人体与相机间的非对称依赖，兼顾两类任务并实现对相机平移强度的显式控制。

Abstract: Human motion defines an action, while a camera trajectory determines how it is presented. Camera generation for a given human motion and joint human-camera generation are usually treated as separate tasks, although both share an asymmetric dependency: human motion can be generated independently, whereas the camera responds to the realized action. We introduce AESOP, a unified framework with an independent human pathway and a shared human-conditioned camera generator. Its asymmetric architecture serves both tasks while preserving the human output during camera generation. Although human context anchors the shot to the action and camera text describes its movement, translation intensity remains underspecified. We therefore construct trajectory pairs that differ in camera translation magnitude while sharing human motion and camera text, then use these pairs to learn an explicit intensity condition. Experiments on the PulpMotion dataset demonstrate strong camera distributional and framing quality in both tasks and effective control over camera translation intensity.

</details>


### [130] [Seeing Is Not Addressing: Auditing Linguistic Access to Frozen Visual Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37230)
*Woosang Jeon,Jiwon Yang,Soo Chung,Taehyeong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究视觉可辨别性与语言可表达性之间的差距，提出通过图像侧对比匹配视觉基础来探测并缩小文本到图像检索中的原生文本访问差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉区分往往比语言概念化更精细，视觉语言模型存在类似不对称性：某些区分在冻结图像几何中可辨别，却难以通过原生文本接口表达。作者希望分离并研究这一差距。

Method: 使用FactorAtlas全交叉测试平台（23,040张图像，涵盖形状、色相、图案和干扰变化），在同一区分的留出图像上比较视觉可辨别性与语言可表达性两种读出；推导图像侧对比，将每个值与替代值分离以实现匹配的视觉基础，并测试其是否缩小跨因素和模型的原生文本访问差距；采用方向特定和视觉缺失控制。

Result: 匹配视觉基础带来的增益与相关视觉对比相关联，在全局对齐后仍持续存在，并可扩展到组合检索和自然图像。

Conclusion: 视觉可辨别性与语言可表达性不必重合，匹配视觉基础能够探测并缩小由此产生的访问差距。

Abstract: Visual distinctions are often finer than those reflected in linguistic conceptualization. Vision-language models exhibit a similar asymmetry: a distinction can remain discriminable in frozen image geometry while being weakly addressable through the native text interface. We study this gap by separating visual discriminability from linguistic addressability in text-to-image retrieval. Using FactorAtlas, a fully crossed testbed of 23,040 images spanning shape, hue, pattern, and nuisance variation, we compare both readouts on held-out images of the same distinctions. We then derive image-side contrasts that separate each value from its alternatives for matched visual grounding, and test whether this reduces the native-text access gap across factors and models. Direction-specific and visual-absence controls tie these gains to the relevant visual contrast; the gains persist after global alignment and extend to compositional retrieval and natural images. Together, these results show that visual discriminability and linguistic addressability need not coincide, and that matched visual grounding can probe and reduce the resulting access gap.

</details>


### [131] [Codebook-Guided Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Structurally Heterogeneous Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37243)
*Dae Ung Jo,Jongin Lim,YoungJoon Yoo,Daeho Um*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于向量量化码本的跨模态蒸馏框架，解决结构异构特征空间难以做单元级对齐的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有特征级对齐方法假设教师和学生特征处于结构可对齐的表示空间，但在2D空间视觉网格与1D时序音频序列这类结构异构、缺乏清晰单元级对应关系的模态下不成立，限制了特征级对齐的适用性。

Method: 用向量量化码本将教师特征抽象为一组向量形式的码，忽略其原始特征结构；被选中的码作为学生学习的"概念级锚点"；码的选择由任务相关性和学生兼容性共同引导，使学生无需直接单元级特征对齐即可获得可迁移的教师知识。

Result: 在多种跨模态蒸馏场景下，分类与语义分割任务上均验证了所提框架的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过码本实现概念级知识传递，可绕过结构异构特征空间的单元级对齐限制，为跨模态蒸馏提供一种更通用的解决思路。

Abstract: Cross-modal knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a teacher modality to a student modality. Existing feature-level alignment methods typically assume that teacher and student features reside in structurally alignable representation spaces. However, this assumption does not hold when cross-modal features are structurally heterogeneous and lack clear unit-level correspondence, such as 2D spatial visual grids and 1D temporal audio sequences, thereby limiting the applicability of feature-level alignment. To address this challenge, we propose a cross-modal distillation framework that enables effective knowledge transfer across structurally heterogeneous feature spaces via a vector-quantized codebook. Specifically, teacher features are abstracted into a set of vector-form codes regardless of their original feature structure, and the selected codes serve as concept-level anchors for student learning. Code selection is guided by both task relevance and student compatibility, allowing the student to receive transferable teacher knowledge without requiring direct unit-level feature alignment. Experimental results across diverse cross-modal distillation scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on classification and semantic segmentation tasks.

</details>


### [132] [V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37250)
*Yang Zhang,Jiangyuan Zhao,Chenyou Fan,Jiayu Hu,Xiu Yuan,Chenjia Bai,Xiu Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 V-JEPA Policy，直接以冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器潜在空间为基础构建世界-动作模型（WAM），无需继承完整预训练视觉生成模型，即可在下游任务中取得与代表性 WAM 和 VLA 基线相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 WAM 多通过适配大规模预训练的视频生成器或图像编辑模型获得预测知识，但这也意味着必须继承完整的生成模型。作者希望探究：仅由大规模预测式预训练得到的预测性视觉潜在空间，是否就足以为有效的 WAM 学习提供基础。

Method: 在冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器潜在空间上构建 WAM。采用单一的下游训练阶段，从零联合学习一个指令条件下的未来潜在预测器和一个流匹配动作专家，并由预测器的未来信息上下文 key-value 状态来条件化动作生成。总参数 0.9B，其中可训练 0.6B。

Result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboCasa-GR1 上，V-JEPA Policy 与代表性 WAM 及 VLA 基线性能相当。在相同下游框架与训练预算下比较不同视觉基础，V-JEPA 潜在表示优于判别式、重建式及面向视频理解的替代方案，分布偏移下优势尤为明显。此外，在无动作标签的 DROID 视频-指令对上预训练预测器并迁移为 WAM，可显著提升下游控制与分布外泛化。

Conclusion: 预测性视觉潜在表示可作为有效 WAM 学习的基础：既支持从任务专用演示中学习，也能迁移从更广泛野外视频中获得的未来建模知识。

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) couple future visual-state prediction with action generation. By adapting video generators or image-editing models pretrained at scale, a prominent line of recent WAMs inherits both predictive knowledge and the models in which it was learned. We ask whether a predictive visual latent space induced by large-scale predictive pretraining can instead provide a sufficient foundation for effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model. To answer this question, we introduce V-JEPA Policy, a simple framework that builds a WAM on the latent space of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. An instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert are jointly learned from scratch in a single downstream stage, with the predictor's future-informed context key--value states conditioning action generation. With 0.9B total parameters, of which 0.6B are trainable, V-JEPA Policy achieves competitive performance with representative WAM and vision-language-action baselines across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa-GR1. Comparing visual foundations under the same downstream framework and training budget identifies V-JEPA latents as more effective than the discriminative, reconstructive, and video-understanding-oriented alternatives, particularly under distribution shifts. Beyond task-specific learning, pretraining the predictor on DROID video--instruction pairs without action labels and adapting it into a WAM yields substantial gains in downstream control and out-of-distribution generalization. Together, these findings establish predictive visual latents as a foundation for effective WAM learning from task-specific demonstrations and for transferring future-modeling knowledge acquired from broader in-the-wild videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/breez3young/VJEPA-Policy.

</details>


### [133] [Collision-Aware and Observation-Aligned Object-Centric Scene Reconstruction from Point Cloud](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37260)
*Yuxuan Xie,Xuan Yu,Rong Xiong,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出COOL框架，基于实例与背景点云条件化的生成模型，结合显式碰撞损失与联合优化重采样，实现碰撞感知且与观测对齐的物体中心场景重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于生成的物体中心场景重建多为图像条件，存在尺度模糊与几何约束不足的问题，难以在补全部分物体观测的同时保持度量对齐并避免与周围环境碰撞。

Method: COOL以物体生成模型为基础，将生成条件设置为实例点云与背景点云：实例几何将生成锚定在场景坐标中，背景几何提供局部上下文以实现场景一致的补全；同时引入显式碰撞损失，并在推理阶段采用联合优化与重采样来减少碰撞。

Result: 在3D-Front与Scan2CAD数据集上，方法在场景级保真度、观测对齐和碰撞减少方面均表现强劲；额外研究验证了其对掩码错误的鲁棒性以及在真实场景复刻中的适用性。

Conclusion: COOL通过点云条件化生成与显式碰撞约束，有效缓解尺度模糊与几何约束不足，实现度量对齐、场景一致且低碰撞的物体中心场景重建。

Abstract: Object-centric scene reconstruction requires completing partial object observations while preserving metric alignment and avoiding collisions with the surrounding. Existing generation-based methods are often image-conditioned and suffer from scale ambiguity and insufficient geometric constraints. We propose COOL, a framework for COllision-aware and Observation-aLigned reconstruction. Based on an object generation model, COOL conditions the generation on instance and background point clouds. Instance geometry anchors generation in scene coordinates, while background geometry provides local context for scene-consistent completion. We further introduce an explicit collision loss and use joint optimization and resampling to reduce collisions during inference. Experiments on 3D-Front and Scan2CAD demonstrate strong scene-level fidelity, observation alignment, and collision reduction. Moreover, additional studies validate its robustness to mask errors and its applicability to real-world scene replicas.

</details>


### [134] [Beyond Attention Imbalance: Mitigating Hallucinations via Spectral Surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37263)
*Siqi Lu,Suo Wei,Yongbin Zheng,Jianhang Yao,Wanying Xu,Peng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 FLASH，一个免训练、无需对比解码的框架，通过频域视角检测视觉注意力头并施加自适应频谱调制，缓解多模态大模型幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将幻觉归因于跨模态注意力失衡，多采用重加权视觉 token 或抑制语言先验，但忽略了视觉信息流的频谱特征，且常依赖对比解码导致推理时间翻倍。

Method: 识别出两种幻觉模式——感知-语义解离与局部固着；提出 FLASH，利用 Spectral Vortex Score 在多注意力层中检测视觉头，并在解码过程中施加自适应频谱调制以修正视觉信息流。

Result: 实验表明，FLASH 在性能与效率之间取得了优于当前 SOTA 方法的平衡。

Conclusion: FLASH 从频谱角度为幻觉缓解提供了新思路，兼具免训练、免对比解码的优势。

Abstract: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve remarkable success, hallucinations remain a significant barrier to their reliable deployment. Recent studies primarily attribute these issues to cross-modal attention imbalances; most solutions therefore focus on reweighting visual tokens or suppressing language priors. However, such approaches often overlook the spectral characteristics of the visual information flow and frequently rely on Contrastive Decoding (CD), which doubles inference time. Instead of following conventional approaches, we identify two distinct hallucination patterns-Perceptual-Semantic Dissociation and Localized Fixation-and propose FLASH (Frequency-Localized Attention SHaping), a training-free and CD-free framework. FLASH utilizes a Spectral Vortex Score to detect vision heads within multi-head attention layers and applies adaptive spectral modulation to rectify the visual information flow during decoding. Empirical results demonstrate that FLASH achieves a superior balance between performance and efficiency compared to SOTA methods.

</details>


### [135] [UniAfford: Token-Routed Multitask Learning for Generalizable 2D-3D Affordance Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37264)
*Yuhao Liu,Yiming Zhong,Hanqing Wang,Shaocheng Yan,Yuhang Zhang,Wenzhou Lyu,Ziyang Ding,Wei Zhang,Xue Zhao,Jin Pan,Yuexin Ma,Xinge Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Token Router for Tasks 多任务训练范式与 UniAfford 统一框架，将 2D 与 3D affordance grounding 统一到 MLLM 语义中枢中，实现零样本跨模态泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 2D 与 3D affordance grounding 在任务定义、监督格式、数据集与评估协议上相互割裂，难以学习跨视觉与几何空间可迁移的物体-可供性语义。

Method: 提出 Token Router for Tasks 范式，将上下文隐藏状态路由到任务特定分支并由分支目标直接监督；实例化为 UniAfford（MLLM 共享语义中枢 + 模态感知 token router，生成图像/点云 query，分别驱动 SAM 风格像素解码器与 SONATA 点解码器），并构建 UniAfford-Data 数据集（共享物体-可供性分类法下的 2D 像素级、3D 点级标注与语言指令，语义级 2D-3D 配对）。

Result: 在 2D 与 3D affordance 基准上无需目标特定微调即展现强零样本泛化，并在模态隔离协议下取得分支级 SOTA；消融验证了 token routing、2D-3D 联合监督与解码器耦合的有效性，语言头诊断表明路由隐状态携带可解释的物体-可供性语义。

Conclusion: 统一的多任务路由范式可有效弥合 2D-3D 可供性感知的割裂，支持灵活的单模态与联合推理，并提升跨模态语义可迁移性。

Abstract: Affordance perception aims to localize actionable regions supporting embodied interaction, yet 2D and 3D affordance grounding have evolved as separate problems, with different task definitions, supervision formats, datasets, and evaluation protocols. This fragmentation limits the learning of transferable object-affordance semantics across visual and geometric spaces. We propose Token Router for Tasks, a multitask training paradigm for MLLM-based systems that routes contextual hidden states to task-specific branches without requiring the language head to generate predefined markers. Routed states are supervised directly by branch-specific objectives, enabling dense prediction losses to shape shared MLLM representations. We instantiate this paradigm as UniAfford, a unified framework for generalizable 2D-3D affordance perception, together with UniAfford-Data, a dataset integrating pixel-level 2D annotations, point-level 3D annotations, and language instructions under a shared object-affordance taxonomy, supporting heterogeneous supervision through semantic-level 2D-3D pairing. UniAfford adopts an MLLM as a shared semantic hub and a modality-aware token router to produce image- and point-cloud-affordance queries. These queries respectively condition a SAM-style pixel decoder and a SONATA-based point decoder, enabling flexible 2D, 3D, and joint affordance inference from image-only, point-cloud-only, or paired multimodal inputs. Experiments demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization across 2D and 3D affordance benchmarks without target-specific fine-tuning, alongside state-of-the-art branch-wise performance under modality-isolated protocols. Ablations validate token routing, joint 2D-3D supervision, and decoder coupling, while language-head diagnostics show that routed latent states carry meaningful object-affordance semantics. Project page: https://4dvlab.github.io/UniAfford

</details>


### [136] [SAM Meets VLM: Parameter-Decoupled Full-Parameter Training for Unified Medical Reasoning and Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37283)
*Xuyang Cao,Enyou Liu,Jun Zhao,Zhuoyun Liu,Jintao Fei,Leo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出参数解耦训练框架，实现医学多模态大模型统一推理与分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学MLLM需同时回答临床问题并定位视觉证据，但统一架构中图像级推理与像素级分割对共享表征空间要求不同，全参数训练困难。

Method: 将<SEG>隐状态作为语义到空间的提示输入掩码解码器，并使其与通用语言状态可分离。分三阶段训练：医学浅层对齐适配视觉特征而不扰动LLM；受控指令微调塑造可分离的<SEG>提示状态，用DBI监控并缩放进入语言主干的梯度；冻结VLM专化SAM分支提升掩码精度。

Result: 在医学指代分割、视觉定位、视觉问答与文本问答基准上，实现强语言条件分割，同时保持有竞争力的推理能力。消融显示两阶段指令微调、梯度缩放和分割专化均有贡献。

Conclusion: 参数解耦训练可有效缓解推理与分割的冲突，兼顾分割精度与推理性能。

Abstract: Medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly expected not only to answer clinical questions, but also to localize the visual evidence behind their predictions. A common strategy connects a vision--language model (VLM) with SAM-style segmentation through a special <SEG> token, yet full-parameter training of this unified architecture is difficult because image-level reasoning and pixel-level segmentation impose different requirements on the shared representation space. To address this issue, we propose a parameter-decoupled training framework for unified medical reasoning and segmentation. The framework treats the <SEG> hidden state as a semantic-to-spatial prompt for the mask decoder and encourages it to become separable from generic language states, reducing ambiguous segmentation prompts and potential disruption to reasoning representations. It first performs medical shallow alignment to adapt visual features to clinical language without disturbing the LLM; then controlled instruction tuning shapes separable <SEG> prompt states, monitored by the Davies--Bouldin Index (DBI), while scaling segmentation gradients entering the language backbone; finally, the SAM branch is specialized with the VLM frozen to improve mask precision without altering reasoning parameters. Experiments on medical referring segmentation, grounding, visual QA, and textual QA benchmarks show that our framework achieves strong language-conditioned segmentation while preserving competitive reasoning ability. Ablations show that two-phase instruction tuning, gradient scaling, and segmentation specialization all contribute to the model.

</details>


### [137] [VISTA-Bench: Benchmarking Multilingual Image Translation with Image-Specific Rubrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37287)
*Bo Lv,Mao Zheng,Zheng Li,Fangxu Liu,Mingrui Sun,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VISTA-Bench，一个覆盖22种语言、10个领域的图像翻译评测基准，并开发了图像专属的评分细则评估协议。通过对16个主流模型（12个多模态、4个文本输入）的评估，实现了对翻译质量和视觉/知识依赖信息保真的系统分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像翻译是多模态模型面向多语言应用的基础能力，需要跨语言的视觉理解与意义保持。但现有基准语言覆盖有限，且缺乏明确的图像专属评估标准，难以全面评估这一能力。

Method: 提出VISTA-Bench：覆盖22种语言、10个领域；采用语言与场景采样的方式，结合模型辅助、人工验证的标注，将相关文本分组为连贯语义单元并提供多语言参考译文；开发图像专属评分细则，明确必要内容、语义关系和可接受的译文变体，分别输出翻译质量和视觉/知识依赖信息保真度的分数。

Result: 对16个主流模型（含12个多模态模型和4个文本输入模型）进行了广泛评估，并在语言、领域及评估维度上进行了系统分析。

Conclusion: VISTA-Bench弥补了现有图像翻译评测在语言覆盖和图像专属评估标准上的不足，为多模态模型图像翻译能力的系统评估提供了基准与可分离的质量/保真度评分体系。

Abstract: Image translation is a fundamental capability of multimodal models for multilingual applications, requiring visual understanding and meaning preservation across languages. However, existing benchmarks have limited language coverage and often lack explicit image-specific evaluation criteria, making it difficult to comprehensively assess this capability. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce VISTA-Bench, covering 22 languages and 10 domains, and develop an image-specific rubric evaluation protocol. The benchmark combines sampling for language and scenario coverage with model-assisted, human-verified annotations that group related text into coherent semantic units and provide multilingual reference translations. The rubrics specify essential content, semantic relations, and acceptable translation variants, yielding separate output-based scores for translation quality and the preservation of visual and knowledge-dependent information. We conduct extensive evaluations of 16 mainstream models, including 12 multimodal models and four text-input models, and provide systematic analyses across languages, domains, and evaluation dimensions.

</details>


### [138] [Why Cross-Skeleton Retargeting Is Non-Identifiable: Structural Limits of Generative Motion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37297)
*Zhiyuan Li,Wenyan Yang,Pekka Marttinen,Joni Pajarinen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出跨骨架动作生成存在结构性不可识别问题：无配对分布匹配导致规范不可识别，稀疏配对监督导致条件均值退化；提出源实例保真度（SIF）诊断，揭示现有方法多为"源盲"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨骨架动作生成模型能把动作结构与意图从一个身体迁移到另一个身体，但目标动作有两种无法区分的解释：模型迁移了源片段，还是仅恢复了该动作的典型动作。作者认为这一歧义是结构性的，而非偶然，因此需要指出问题并给出可观测的诊断手段。

Method: 作者从理论层面分析标准生成目标下的源条件重定向映射不可识别：无配对分布匹配带来规范（gauge）不可识别，不同骨架的潜空间可相互变换而不改变训练证据；稀疏配对监督则导致条件均值退化，平方误差训练收敛到忽略源片段的平均目标动作。为让缺失证据可观测，提出源实例保真度（SIF）诊断：在固定目标骨架与动作的条件下，检验输出之间的差异是否与源片段的差异一致。

Result: 在动物运动数据上，许多通过标准动作级测试的方法在 SIF 诊断下处于"源盲"底线，而能超越底线的方法也只保留了部分关系信号。

Conclusion: 跨骨架重定向需要能够识别其所声称学习的源条件映射的目标函数与评估方法，SIF 提供了这样的诊断方向。

Abstract: Cross-skeleton motion generation trains generative models to carry action structure and motion intention from one body to another. Yet a target motion that shows the right action has two explanations that the training data cannot tell apart: the model transferred the source clip, or it recovered a typical motion for the requested action. We show that this ambiguity is structural rather than incidental: under standard generative objectives, the source-conditioned retargeting map is non-identifiable in sparse heterogeneous motion domains. Unpaired distribution matching yields gauge non-identifiability: the latent spaces of different skeletons can be transformed relative to one another without changing the training evidence, so different source-conditioned maps fit it equally well. Sparse paired supervision admits the complementary failure mode, \emph{conditional-mean degeneration}: when clips are paired only by action, squared-error training converges to an average target motion that ignores the source clip. To make the missing evidence observable, we introduce Source-Instance Fidelity (SIF), a diagnostic that tests whether outputs differ from one another the way their source clips do, with the target skeleton and action held fixed. Under this diagnostic, methods that succeed at the standard action-level test on animal motion data often sit at the source-blind floor, while the methods that rise above it retain only a partial relational signal. Retargeting therefore needs objectives and evaluations that can identify the source-conditioned map it claims to learn. Project page: https://cross-skeleton-retargeting.netlify.app/.

</details>


### [139] [Technical note on: Zero-Training Feature-Space Alignment via Information Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37302)
*Behraj Khan,Tahir Qasim Syed,Syed Ahmad Chan Bukhari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ZFGA是一种无需训练、闭式的测试时适应方法，通过Fisher几何对齐改善特征空间几何畸变，提升分布偏移下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度视觉模型在分布偏移下性能下降，现有测试时适应方法通常需要迭代优化、超参数调优和多次前向-反向传播，成本高且不稳定。

Method: 基于分布偏移会扭曲特征空间几何的观察，估计预测分布关于特征嵌入的Fisher信息矩阵，并施加线性变换，使测试特征Fisher几何与干净数据参考几何对齐，实现特征空间中的自然梯度式预条件，不修改模型参数，仅需前向传播与矩阵运算。

Result: 在CIFAR-10-C和ImageNet-C上，使用ResNet-50、DINO ViT-S/16、CLIP ViT-B/32评估：ZFGA在三个模型上均优于零样本推理；ResNet-50上协方差白化更优，CLIP上Fisher白化与ZFGA无显著差异；在六种对比方法中，ZFGA是唯一不严重损害任一模型家族的方法；Fisher几何畸变与ZFGA增益正相关（Pearson r=0.366, p=0.017）。

Conclusion: ZFGA是一种轻量、确定性的闭式测试时适应替代方案，初步证据表明几何错位是鲁棒性下降的原因之一。

Abstract: Deep vision models often degrade under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation can improve robustness but typically requires iterative optimization, hyperparameter tuning, and multiple forward-backward passes. We propose Zero-Training Fisher Geometry Alignment (ZFGA), a closed-form method that improves robustness under covariate shift without modifying model parameters. ZFGA is based on the observation that distribution shifts distort feature-space geometry. It estimates the Fisher information matrix of the predictive distribution with respect to feature embeddings and applies a linear transformation that aligns test-feature Fisher geometry with a reference geometry computed from clean data. This provides a natural-gradient-inspired preconditioning step in feature space. We evaluate ZFGA on CIFAR-10-C and ImageNet-C using ResNet-50, DINO ViT-S/16, and CLIP ViT-B/32. ZFGA consistently improves over zero-shot inference across all three models, although it is not the strongest method for every model. Covariance whitening performs better on ResNet-50, while Fisher whitening is statistically indistinguishable from ZFGA on CLIP. Across six training-free and gradient-based alternatives (covariance whitening, Fisher whitening, TENT, T3A, LAME, and AdaNPC), ZFGA is the only method that does not substantially harm any of the three model families. The Fisher geometry distortion is also positively correlated with ZFGA gain (Pearson r = 0.366, p = 0.017), providing preliminary evidence that geometric misalignment contributes to robustness degradation. ZFGA requires only forward passes and matrix operations at inference time, offering a lightweight and deterministic alternative to optimization-based test-time adaptation.

</details>


### [140] [FLASH: A "Generate Once, Synthesize Many" Framework for Synthetic Anomaly Generation in Industrial Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37314)
*Abhay Kumar Das,Rajesh Gangireddy,Ashwin Vaidya,Samet Akcay*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FLASH提出"一次生成、多次合成"范式，将缺陷生成与异常合成解耦，仅用正常图像即可高效生成大规模多样化的合成异常数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业异常检测中真实缺陷稀缺，现有合成异常方法存在两难：程序化方法快但难以表达复杂异常，生成式方法缺陷多样但需逐样本生成、成本高。因此需要兼顾多样性与效率的方案。

Method: FLASH在仅有正常图像条件下，利用VLM引导与图像生成模型产出少量缺陷图像，并从中提取、验证、入库可复用的缺陷块。合成阶段，OBS定位宿主图像的前景物体感知区域，MRSP噪声生成多样且尺寸可控的掩码以确定缺陷位置与范围，再将检索到的缺陷块无缝融合到新的无缺陷图像上，无需再次图像生成。

Result: 在MVTec AD 2数据集上，FLASH生成的异常接近真实缺陷的校准水平，图像级F1达78.1%，真实异常上界为83.6%，并在各检测器间提供了程序化与生成式方案中最一致的校准迁移；合成速度比逐样本生成方法快11.95倍以上。

Conclusion: FLASH通过缺陷块库复用与可控掩码合成，在效率与多样性之间取得平衡，接近真实异常性能并具备良好跨检测器泛化能力。

Abstract: Synthetic anomaly generation helps expand industrial anomaly datasets when real defects are scarce or unavailable. Existing approaches lie at two extremes: procedural approaches are fast but struggle to represent complex anomalies, while generative approaches produce diverse defects but require costly per-sample generation. We present FLASH, a framework that decouples defect generation from anomaly synthesis under a ``generate once, synthesize many'' paradigm. Given only normal images, FLASH uses Vision-Language Model (VLM) guidance and an image-generation model to produce a small set of defect images, from which it extracts, validates, and banks reusable defect patches. For synthesis of anomalous images, Object Boundary Suppression (OBS) first identifies the probable foreground object-aware region of the host image, while Multi-Resolution Spectral Pyramid (MRSP) noise generates diverse, size-controllable masks that determine the defect location and spatial extent. It then composes a large and diverse synthetic anomalous image set by localizing the defect region, sampling size-controllable placement masks and seamlessly blending retrieved defects onto new defect-free images without further need for image generation. Experiments on the MVTec AD 2 dataset show that FLASH-generated anomalies nearly close the calibration gap on real defects, reaching 78.1% image-level F1 against an 83.6% real-anomaly upper bound and providing the most consistent calibration transfer across detectors among procedural and generative alternatives. Moreover, FLASH synthesizes anomalies more than 11.95x faster than per-sample generative approaches.

</details>


### [141] [The Domain Is a Residue: Adapting Self-Supervised Features, Not Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37330)
*Thomas Deixelberger,Markus Steinberger*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出2.9M参数的表示特征适配器(RFA)，在冻结的DINO特征编码-解码框架下移动占总范数13-14%的天气/光照风格残差，以极少参数和训练时间实现去雾、去雨、去雪及仿真到真实的域翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无配对翻译器（如CycleGAN-Turbo）依赖生成器直接看到源域外观（像素、近似可逆隐变量或控制图）并保留它，因此难以彻底去除源域（雾、雨、雪、渲染风格）而同时保留场景内容。作者希望找到一种只携带风格残差、与场景内容解耦的表示，从而更干净地完成域去除。

Method: 基于DINO特征图确定场景内容，天气、光照与渲染风格以约占特征范数13-14%的残差形式存在。提出RFA：一个2.9M参数的网络，仅训练该适配器及其判别器，而编码器和特征条件解码器（一次训练、适配所有条件）保持冻结，通过移动该残差实现域翻译。

Result: 对比CycleGAN-Turbo：在雾的KID与另一指标上均领先，夜晚KID领先，雪、雨、雾霾上处于噪声范围内的持平；仿真到真实任务上两项指标均优于REGEN和HyPER-GAN；仅RFA能在去除雨的同时保留场景。代价是结构保持：除雾外CycleGAN-Turbo在各条件上保留更多场景结构。在VAE隐变量上同一适配器退化为恒等映射；未见过该适配器的其他组解码器也能渲染其输出。可训练参数约为CycleGAN-Turbo的1/160，单条件训练时间不足其1/5。

Conclusion: 将风格残差与场景内容在DINO特征空间中解耦，可用极小参数量的适配器高效完成去雾/雨/雪及仿真到真实翻译，且具备跨解码器泛化与隐空间依赖性，但场景结构保持方面仍有取舍。

Abstract: Clearing fog, rain or snow from footage, or turning renders into photographs, must remove the source domain and keep the scene. Unpaired translators carry it through because their generator sees the source appearance (pixels, a near-invertible latent or a control map) and keeps it. A DINO feature map fixes what is in the scene and carries weather, lighting and rendering style as a residue of 13 to 14% of the feature norm. We propose the Representation Feature Adapter (RFA), a 2.9M-parameter network that moves this residue. We train only the adapter and its discriminators; the encoder and a feature-conditioned decoder, trained once for all conditions, stay frozen. Against CycleGAN-Turbo it is ahead on both metrics on fog and on KID on night, and level within noise on snow, rain and haze. On sim-to-real it leads REGEN and HyPER-GAN on both metrics. Only the RFA removes the rain while keeping the scene. The removal costs scene structure: CycleGAN-Turbo keeps more on every condition but fog. On VAE latents the identical adapter collapses to the identity, and decoders from other groups that never saw it render its output. The RFA has about 160 times fewer trainable parameters than CycleGAN-Turbo and under a fifth of its per-condition training time.

</details>


### [142] [OFBD: Object-Focused Background Debiasing for Long-Tailed Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37331)
*Shenghan Chen,Yiming Liu,Zhipeng Deng,Haolin Wang,Jiale Zhou,Zhijian Wu,Xiankai Lu,Yafei Ou,Yefeng Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示长尾分类中尾类退化不仅源于样本不足，还源于背景偏置的表征与优化，并提出OFBD框架从分布与优化两个角度缓解背景偏置，显著提升尾类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长尾数据下的性能权衡是视觉识别的长期难题。现有方法（重平衡、表征学习、数据增强）主要针对样本不足，但尾类退化的根本原因探索不足。作者发现标准长尾训练会诱导背景偏置的表征与优化：尾类经历更大的背景分布偏移，且越来越受背景梯度驱动，说明尾类退化还来自无关背景特征的学习。

Method: 提出对象聚焦背景去偏（OFBD）框架，从分布和优化两个视角缓解背景偏置。包含两个组件：前景引导的CutMix，保留与目标相关的前景同时多样化互补背景；背景引导的特征校正，无需可学习参数或额外训练即可抑制背景偏置特征。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法提升了整体准确率，在尾类上取得显著增益，且可作为插件用于主流长尾方法，无需外部数据或预训练识别模型。

Conclusion: 尾类退化由样本不足与背景特征学习共同导致，OFBD通过分布与优化层面的背景去偏有效缓解该问题，具有通用性和即插即用特性。

Abstract: Balancing performance trade-offs on long-tailed data distributions remains a long-standing challenge in visual recognition. Existing methods mainly improve tail classes through re-balancing, representation learning, or data augmentation, but the underlying cause of tail class degradation is still insufficiently explored. In this paper, we find that standard long-tailed training induces background-biased representation and optimization: tail classes suffer larger background distribution shifts and become increasingly driven by background gradients. This reveals that tail degradation is not merely caused by insufficient samples, but also by the learning of irrelevant background features. To tackle this issue, we propose Object-Focused Background Debiasing (OFBD), a framework that mitigates background bias from both distribution and optimization perspectives. Specifically, Foreground-guided CutMix preserves target-related foregrounds while diversifying complementary backgrounds, and Background-guided Feature Rectification suppresses background-biased features without learnable parameters or additional training. Extensive experiments show that our method improves overall accuracy, achieves significant tail-class gains, and can serve as a plug-in for mainstream long-tailed methods without external data or pretrained recognition models. The code is available at: https://ofbd-neurips2026-longtail-learning.github.io/

</details>


### [143] [UGO: Unified Architecture for General Multi-Object Tracking by Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37339)
*Jer Pelhan,Alan Lukezic,Matej Kristan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UGO是一个统一的开类别多目标跟踪器，结合了示例条件检测头与实例传播头，无需训练的能量最小化整合方法生成像素级掩码和检测，并采用分层记忆提升召回和分割精度，在GMOT基准和视频目标计数上取得新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用多目标跟踪(GMOT)方法依赖边界框和代理训练，难以处理非刚性物体、拥挤场景和干扰物。

Method: 提出UGO统一跟踪器：1) 将预训练的示例条件检测头与实例传播头配对于同一架构；2) 新颖的免训练能量最小化整合方法，将重叠提议转化为排他性的像素级掩码和检测，解决过度分割、重复和冲突；3) 跨全局与实例级别的分层记忆，配合新的记忆管理协议。

Result: 在GMOT基准和视频目标计数上创下新SOTA，并与专用MOT方法具有竞争力。

Conclusion: UGO为统一的开类别多目标跟踪建立了强有力的范式。

Abstract: General multi-object tracking (GMOT) tracks all instances of a user-specified category from a single first-frame exemplar. Prior work relies on bounding boxes and surrogate training, and struggles with non-rigid objects, crowded scenes, and distractors. We introduce UGO, a unified GMOT tracker that pairs a pretrained exemplar-conditioned detection head with an instance-propagation head in a common architecture. A novel training-free, energy-minimization consolidation method converts overlapping proposals into exclusive pixel-wise masks and detections, resolving over-segmentation, duplicates, and conflicts. A hierarchical memory spanning global and instance levels improves recall and per-instance segmentation accuracy using a new memory management protocol. UGO sets a new state-of-the-art on GMOT benchmarks and video object counting, and is competitive with specialist MOT methods, establishing a strong paradigm for unified, open-category multi-object tracking.

</details>


### [144] [HyperSAM: A Promptable Foundation Model for Hyperspectral Remote Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37340)
*Li Pang,Xinqiao Wu,Jing Yao,Pedram Ghamisi,Jun Zhou,Zhengchao Chen,Deyu Meng,Xiangyong Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HyperSAM 是一个可提示的高光谱基础模型，结合物理引导的高光谱数据合成与基于 SAM3 的光谱适应架构，在多种高光谱任务上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱基础模型构建面临两大瓶颈：一是大规模高光谱语料缺乏高空间分辨率与可靠的密集标注；二是多数高光谱模型几乎从头训练，未能充分利用现代视觉基础模型学到的几何与交互先验。

Method: 数据侧：通过物理信息丰度迁移生成器，从高分辨率 SpaceNet 多光谱影像合成全光谱高光谱立方体，并用 SAM3 生成的伪掩码提供目标中心监督。模型侧：采用冻结的 SAM3 RGB 图像分支、由 RGB ViT 初始化的可训练高光谱侧编码器、ControlNet 式零初始化特征注入，以及轻量级专家混合掩码精修器；并引入 CromSS 风格置信度选择以对噪声伪标签加权。

Result: 大量实验表明，HyperSAM 在分类、异常检测、变化检测、目标检测和机载溢油制图等多种高光谱任务上具有强泛化能力；高质量合成高光谱数据比单纯扩大含噪高光谱监督更有效。

Conclusion: HyperSAM 通过数据合成与基础模型适应的协同设计，缓解了标注稀缺与先验复用不足的问题，验证了合成数据与提示式基础模型在高光谱遥感中的潜力。

Abstract: Hyperspectral remote sensing provides dense spectral measurements that are indispensable for material-level Earth observation, yet the construction of a general-purpose hyperspectral foundation model remains difficult. Two bottlenecks are especially limiting. First, large hyperspectral corpora rarely provide high spatial resolution together with reliable dense annotations. Second, many hyperspectral models are still trained almost from scratch, so the geometric and interactive priors learned by modern vision foundation models are not fully reused. To alleviate these issues, we \highlight{present} \textbf{HyperSAM}, a promptable hyperspectral foundation model that couples a data-centric hyperspectral synthesis pipeline with a spectral adaptation architecture based on Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3). On the data side, HyperSAM synthesizes full-spectrum hyperspectral cubes from high-resolution SpaceNet multispectral imagery through a physics-informed abundance-transfer generator, while SAM3-derived pseudo-masks provide object-centric supervision. On the model side, the latest implementation uses a frozen SAM3 RGB image branch, a trainable hyperspectral side encoder initialized from the RGB vision transformer (ViT), ControlNet-style zero-initialized feature injection, and a lightweight mixture-of-experts mask refiner. To enhance training robustness against noisy pseudo-labels, Cross-modal Sample Selection (CromSS)-style confidence selection is incorporated for noisy-label weighting. Extensive experiments show that HyperSAM obtains strong generalization on diverse hyperspectral tasks (e.g., classification, anomaly detection, change detection, target detection, and airborne oil-spill mapping) and that high-quality synthetic hyperspectral data can be more effective than simply scaling noisy hyperspectral supervision.

</details>


### [145] [When to Retrieve, When to Stay: Uncertainty-Aware Temporal Evidence Allocation for Streaming Video-LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37345)
*Xiang Hu,Jiazuo Yu,Lu Zhang,Yunzhi Zhuge,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WRWS是一个免训练框架，通过不确定性自适应地在语义检索与近期偏好之间分配视觉证据选择，在保持精度的同时将平均视觉到回答耗时降至SOTA方法的47.93%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频理解中视觉历史不断增长，而视觉处理预算有限，需要在时间近期性与查询相关性之间平衡证据选择。仅取近期会遗漏相关历史证据，仅做语义检索在相关性分数模糊时会挤占有用的近期上下文，因此需要自适应策略。

Method: 提出免训练的WRWS框架：用轻量外部视觉语言编码器对历史打分查询相关性，自适应分配模块以相似度分布的归一化熵作为检索不确定性代理；不确定性低时偏向语义检索，不确定性高时强化近期先验。采用"先检索、后编码"流程，在目标模型视觉编码前选定证据，仅处理被选中的观测。

Result: 在四种Video-LLM家族、多种模型规模上实验，在StreamingBench和OVO-Bench上取得有竞争力的准确率；效率评估中平均视觉到回答时间降至SOTA方法的47.93%。

Conclusion: WRWS通过不确定性自适应的证据分配，无需训练即可在流式视频理解中兼顾准确率与效率，为Video-LLM的有限视觉预算处理提供了有效方案，代码将开源。

Abstract: Streaming video understanding requires Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) to reason over continuous visual streams under causal constraints. As the visual history grows, a bounded visual?processing budget requires evidence selection that balances temporal recency with query relevance. Recent-only selection excludes potentially relevant historical evidence, whereas Semantic-only retrieval can displace useful recent context when relevance scores are ambiguous. We introduce WRWS (When to Retrieve, When to Stay), a training-free framework for uncertainty-adaptive evidence allocation. A lightweight external vision-language encoder scores query relevance across the observed history, while an adaptive allocation module uses the normalized entropy of the similarity distribution as a proxy for retrieval uncertainty. WRWS favors semantic retrieval when relevance cues are reliable and strengthens the recency prior under uncertainty. Following a retrieve-first, encode-later pipeline, WRWS selects evidence before target-model visual encoding, such that only the selected observations are processed by the costly target Video-LLM. Experiments across four Video-LLM families and multiple model scales demonstrate competitive accuracy on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench. In our efficiency evaluation, WRWS reduces average vision-to-answer time to 47.93% of the state-of-the-art method. Code will be released.

</details>


### [146] [TAEC: Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination for Multi-Step Visual RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37349)
*Yalun Wu,Bingzhou Wang,Boyang Wang,Peiying Wang,Shaojie He,Yunhan Wang,Shaozu Yuan,Jiawei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出免训练的轨迹感知证据协调框架TAEC，围绕未解决的答案需求协调视觉RAG中的证据使用，缓解多步推理中的轨迹级证据利用退化问题，并在三个基准上取得最佳整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步视觉RAG通过反复检索视觉证据、更新中间状态并决定是否继续搜索来回答复杂问题，但检索到相关证据并不意味着其在推理轨迹中被有效利用。随着推理推进，冗余来源占用上下文容量，与已解决需求相关或无效的观察持续残留，视觉来源被重复访问但细节不足，导致"轨迹级证据利用退化"。

Method: 提出Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination (TAEC)，一个免训练框架。它在共享的轨迹状态中跟踪未解决的答案需求，以此指导三方面：哪些证据进入上下文、累积记忆如何保留、以及视觉证据以何种细节层次被检视。

Result: 在ViDoSeek、SlideVQA和MMLongBench-Doc上采用统一评测协议，TAEC在主流免训练视觉RAG基线中取得最佳整体性能，并在多个专有视觉语言模型上获得最高平均准确率。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将证据与不断演化的推理需求对齐，能够改善多步视觉RAG整个过程中的证据利用效果。

Abstract: Multi-step visual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answers complex questions by repeatedly retrieving visual evidence, updating an intermediate state, and deciding whether to continue searching or answer. Yet retrieving relevant evidence does not ensure its effective use throughout the reasoning trajectory. As multi-step reasoning progresses, redundant sources occupy context capacity needed for missing evidence, observations tied to resolved requirements or unproductive searches linger in context, and visual sources are revisited with insufficient detail for fine-grained reading. We term this loss of usable evidence over a reasoning trajectory trajectory-level evidence utilization degradation. To address it, we propose Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination (TAEC), a training-free framework that coordinates evidence use around unresolved answer requirements. TAEC tracks these requirements in a shared trajectory state to guide which evidence enters the context, how accumulated memory is retained, and at what level of detail visual evidence is examined. Under a unified evaluation protocol on ViDoSeek, SlideVQA, and MMLongBench-Doc, TAEC achieves the best overall performance against leading training-free visual RAG baselines, with the highest average accuracy across multiple proprietary vision-language models. These results demonstrate that aligning evidence with evolving reasoning needs improves evidence use throughout multi-step visual RAG.

</details>


### [147] [PCaPaint: Prostate Cancer Inpainting by Mitigating Shortcut Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37350)
*Levente Lippenszky,Hongxu Yang,Marcell Dömötör,Krisztian Koos,László Ruskó*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 PCaPaint，一种基于潜在扩散模型（LDM）的前列腺癌 MRI 合成肿瘤修补方法，通过高斯噪声填充条件图像、病灶区域加权训练目标及多序列潜在设计，克服捷径学习并提升合成质量与下游任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 系统在肿瘤专用应用中受限于标注数据稀缺。合成肿瘤修补是有前景的方案，但前列腺癌 MRI 具有高分辨率多序列特点，面临挑战。现有基于 LDM 的方法虽能合成大体积肿瘤，但易出现捷径学习，即简单复制由掩膜病灶区域生成的条件图像，导致合成肿瘤纹理失真。

Method: 1）提出简单高效的条件策略：将条件图像用高斯噪声填充，并提供理论论证以克服捷径学习；2）提出新的 LDM 训练目标，强调病灶区域内的误差；3）引入多序列潜在设计，用两个独立自编码器分别压缩 T2w 扫描与 DWI&ADC 扫描，以保留其不同频率特性。

Result: 大量实验表明，生成的合成数据提升了前列腺病灶分割、患者级分类和病灶级检测的下游性能；且在合成图像质量和下游性能两方面均显著优于近期最先进的基于 LDM 的肿瘤修补方法。

Conclusion: PCaPaint 通过显式应对捷径学习问题，有效改善前列腺癌 MRI 合成肿瘤修补的质量与下游任务表现，为标注稀缺场景下的肿瘤 AI 应用提供了可行路径。

Abstract: The development of AI systems for tumor-specific applications is limited by the scarcity of labeled data. Synthetic tumor inpainting offers a promising approach but faces challenges for prostate cancer MRI which contains high-resolution multi-sequence data. Although methods leveraging latent diffusion models (LDMs) enable large-volume synthesis, they are prone to shortcut learning, simply reproducing the condition image created by masking the lesion region. In this work, we introduce PCaPaint, a prostate cancer inpainting method based on LDMs that explicitly addresses this failure mode. To overcome shortcut learning that compromises synthetic tumor texture, we propose a simple yet efficient conditioning strategy in which the condition image is filled with Gaussian noise, and we provide theoretical justification. In addition, we propose a novel training objective for LDM that emphasizes the error within the lesion region. Furthermore, we introduce a multi-sequence latent design, in which T2w scans and DWI&ADC scans are compressed using two separate autoencoders to preserve their distinct frequency characteristics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the generated synthetic data improves downstream performance in prostate lesion segmentation, patient-level classification and lesion-level detection. Furthermore, our method significantly outperforms a recent state-of-the-art LDM-based tumor inpainting method both in downstream performance and in synthetic image quality.

</details>


### [148] [Visual Anomaly Synthesis for Model Selection in Data Scarcity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37360)
*Daniel Pröll,Thomas Kraxner,Tobias Schaefer,Sebastian Hegenbart*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个无需目标资产缺陷参考的框架，在真实无缺陷图像上合成不同严重程度的缺陷，用于异常检测模型的选型与验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业状态监测中的缺陷检测系统必须经过验证才能被信赖，但缺陷样本极为稀少，对特定资产甚至完全不存在，因此无法获得真实缺陷数据来进行模型选型和验证。

Method: 从文献中提炼常见失效模式的缺陷分类体系，转化为不同严重程度的规范化提示词；在无缺陷图像中裁剪感兴趣区域，用预训练图像生成模型（FLUX.2 [klein]）进行编辑；通过颜色匹配与融合提升与原始图像的结构一致性；再用评分器和估计的检测难度过滤生成结果。

Result: 在MVTecAD上的模型选择实验显示，图像AUROC的选型遗憾相比在测试数据上选出的最佳固定模型几乎减半；在Pelton水轮机转轮案例中，基于PatchCore的异常检测模型用合成图像选型与验证后表现良好（最优阈值正确检测率94%，AUROC 0.97），能可靠检出中度和晚期缺陷，但早期缺陷仍具挑战。

Conclusion: 严重程度分级的异常合成对模型选型和验证是必要的，合成数据能有效检验检测器灵敏度，为真实缺陷稀缺场景下的工业监测提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Defect detection systems for industrial condition monitoring can only be relied upon if they are validated, yet defective samples are rare and, for a specific asset, often nonexistent. We present a framework that synthesizes severity-graded defects on real non-defective images without any defect references for the target asset, that can be used for model selection and validation. A defect taxonomy for common failure modes is distilled from literature into prescriptive prompts at varying defect severities. Regions of interest are cropped from in defect-free images and edited with a pre-trained image generation model ("FLUX.2 [klein]"). Color-matching and blending are employed to improve structural coherence with the original image. Generations are filtered out by a scorer and by estimated detection difficulty. Model selection experiments on MVTecAD show image AUROC choice regret over model selection can be nearly halved compared to the best fixed model chosen with access to test data. Experiments show the need for severity-graded anomaly synthesis. A case study investigates the proposed method for in-situ monitoring of Pelton turbine runners in hydropower, where real defect images are rare and expensive to collect. A PatchCorebased anomaly detection model is fit on Pelton turbine images and selected and validated using synthetic images, showing strong detection performance (94 % correct detection at optimal threshold and AUROC 0.97). The model reliably detects moderate and advanced defects, while early-stage defects remain challenging, indicating the synthetic data meaningfully stresses detector sensitivity.

</details>


### [149] [Think Before You Score: Thinking Reward Model for Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37372)
*Xuehai Bai,Zhenchen Tang,Yang Shi,Dianyi Wang,Tengfei Liu,Wanshun Su,Xuanyu Zhu,Ruohui Wang,Haiwen Diao,Haotian Wang,Xiaoling Gu,Yuanxing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"先思考再评分"范式与Thinking Reward Model (TRM)，动态生成案例自适应评分标准并输出细粒度逐点奖励，配合PD-GRPO缓解评分极化，在视觉生成评测与强化学习中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉奖励模型直接将任务条件与候选输出映射为标量奖励，未显式说明每个案例应评估什么，缺乏对个体案例的针对性评估。

Method: 提出TRM：先为每个案例制定自适应评分标准（rubrics），再进行标准引导的评估，输出细粒度逐点奖励；并识别出传统成对偏好优化导致的评分极化问题，提出PD-GRPO，利用成对监督提升奖励区分度，同时保留细粒度逐点评分。

Result: 在图像生成与编辑的奖励建模基准上，TRM达到开源奖励模型中的SOTA水平，并与专有模型相比极具竞争力；作为强化学习奖励可持续提升多种视觉生成模型。

Conclusion: 显式、案例自适应的细粒度奖励能转化为有效的视觉生成优化信号，验证了"先思考再评分"范式的有效性。

Abstract: Visual reward models are essential for evaluating and improving visual generation models, yet existing approaches typically map task conditions and candidate outputs directly to scalar rewards, leaving implicit what should be evaluated for each individual case. We introduce Think Before You Score, a paradigm that explicitly determines what matters for each case before judging how well the candidate performs. Following this principle, we propose the Thinking Reward Model (TRM), which formulates case-adaptive rubrics, performs rubric-guided assessment, and produces fine-grained pointwise rewards. We further observe that conventional pairwise preference optimization can induce score polarization, and introduce Pairwise Dual-Group Relative Policy Optimization (PD-GRPO), which leverages pairwise supervision to improve reward discrimination while preserving fine-grained pointwise scoring. Extensive experiments on image generation and editing reward-modeling benchmarks demonstrate that TRM achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source reward models while remaining highly competitive with proprietary alternatives. Moreover, using TRM as a reward for reinforcement learning consistently improves diverse visual generation models, demonstrating that its fine-grained, case-adaptive rewards translate into effective optimization signals for visual generation.

</details>


### [150] [Do-JEPA: From Masking to Intervention in Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37378)
*Hossein Resani,Javen Qinfeng Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Do-JEPA，通过让模型预测"动作导致的潜在未来差异"而非单纯预测下一时刻，从目标函数层面区分因果与共现，实验证明其能定位被干预对象、恢复传播图并降低效应误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在世界模型仅以"预测下一步"为目标，目标函数中没有任何部分区分"由动作引起的变化"与"恰好与动作共现的变化"。已有的对象掩码方法（如C-JEPA）是干预模型"能看到什么"，而本文主张应干预"物理上实际发生了什么"，从而在目标层面引入因果性。

Method: 从同一保存的模拟器状态出发，分别在动作a和参考动作a∅下运行动力学，训练模型预测两个潜在未来之差Δz=z^a−z^{a∅}。由此得到Do-JEPA目标，包含效应损失、支撑损失（动作在何处进入）、传播损失（效应如何传播）以及不变性损失（哪些不应改变）。

Result: 在对象对齐变量的合成系统中，支撑监督在99.95%测试案例中找到被直接干预对象（稀疏动作掩码则在所有案例中把动作误送至干扰槽），响应起始监督恢复出环形传播图（边AUROC 0.975 vs. 0.624）。在像素输入下，效应损失超过用完全相同数据训练的对照：端到端LeWM上潜在效应误差降低28.4%，自然动作序列上物理效应误差降低13.5%；在三个独立生成的CausalWorld基准上，物理偏移下响应效应误差降低约20%，预测效应的潜在上下文敏感性降低66%。从头训练会损害事实准确性，而微调现有模型可消除该代价。

Conclusion: 干预"世界本身"而非"模型所见"，有助于潜在世界模型预测其动作所导致的结果，说明将因果干预引入训练目标对世界模型学习具有实际价值。

Abstract: Latent world models are trained to predict what happens next, so nothing in their objective separates what an action caused from what merely co-occurred with it. Object-masking models such as C-JEPA intervene on what the predictor can see; we intervene on what physically happens. From one saved simulator state we run the dynamics under an action $a$ and under a reference action $a_{\varnothing}$, and train the model to predict the difference $Δz=z^{a}-z^{a_{\varnothing}}$ between the two latent futures. The resulting objective, Do-JEPA, has an effect loss, a support loss (where the action enters), a propagation loss (where its effect travels) and invariance losses (what must not change). In a synthetic system with object-aligned variables, support supervision finds the directly intervened object in 99.95% of test cases, where a sparse action mask sends the action to a nuisance slot in every case, and response-onset supervision recovers the ring-shaped propagation graph (edge AUROC 0.975 vs. 0.624). From pixels, the effect loss beats a control trained on exactly the same data: it lowers latent effect error by 28.4% on an end-to-end LeWM model and physical effect error by 13.5% when trained and tested on natural action sequences, and on three independently generated CausalWorld benchmarks it lowers responsive effect error by about 20% under physics shifts and the latent context sensitivity of predicted effects by 66%. Trained from scratch it costs factual accuracy; fine-tuning an existing model with it removes this cost. Together, these results show that intervening on the world, rather than on what the model sees, helps latent world models predict what their actions cause.

</details>

# cs.MM [[Back]](#toc)

### [151] [Toward Generative Video Communication: A Dual-Stream Digital Transmission Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36565)
*Bingyan Xie,Longyu Zhou,Tianhao Liang,Yongpeng Wu,Zehui Xiong,Wenjun Zhang,Tony Q. S. Quek*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文提出双流数字生成视频通信（DGVC）框架，将传统数字链路与生成链路相结合，以实现带宽受限下的个性化视频传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式视频通信在带宽受限的无线传输中具有潜力，并有望支持个性化内容交付，但如何在传统传输与生成式方法间取得平衡仍是关键问题。

Method: 提出DGVC框架：传统链路提供基于源的真实视觉参考，生成链路传递紧凑的语义与感知信息供接收端生成；并讨论三种带宽相关运行模式及双流协调、同步、可靠性与时延控制等关键技术，结合无线衰落信道案例进行研究。

Result: 案例研究表明，DGVC在无线衰落信道下能够带来感知质量与时域质量方面的提升。

Conclusion: DGVC可提升无线信道下的视频感知与时域质量，但生成式视频通信仍存在开放挑战与未来研究方向。

Abstract: Generative video communication has shown promise for bandwidth-constrained wireless transmission and has the potential to support personalized content delivery. In this article, we propose a dual-stream digital generative video communication (DGVC) framework that integrates a traditional digital link with a generative link. The traditional link provides source-grounded visual references, while the generative link conveys compact semantic and perceptual information for receiver-side generation. We further discuss three bandwidth-dependent operating regimes and key technologies for dual-stream coordination, synchronization, reliability, and latency control. A practical case study demonstrates the perceptual and temporal-quality benefits of DGVC under wireless fading channels. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future research directions for generative video communication.

</details>

### [152] [Sage: Formalization with Semantic Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35790)
*Thomas Hirtz,Farzad Jafarrahmani,Abdelmouksit Sagueni,Xiang Zhou,Wengping Deng,Liang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Sage（语义智能体引导的形式化引擎）是一个智能体框架，用四阶段分解式生成流程和双信号语义纠错循环，替代传统的单体式翻译，在保证句法合法性的同时强化数学忠实度，并大幅抑制答案泄漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经定理证明器依赖已提供忠实的 Lean 4 形式化陈述，而从自然语言到形式语言的翻译是关键数据瓶颈，且存在"严谨性幻觉"：类型检查器会接受那些虽能编译但丢失假设、引入空洞真值或悄然改变数学边界的陈述。现有形式化流程还容易通过猜测未验证答案来获得高形式化率。

Method: Sage 用四阶段分解式生成管线取代单体式翻译，并配备双信号语义纠错循环：将 Lean 4 编译器诊断与多维语义反馈相结合，同时显式建模开放式查询与声明式形式目标之间的差距。

Result: 在 Omni-MATH（无证明版）上达到 73.3% 的 pass@4 联合编译与语义忠实度，基线微调版 Goedel-Formalizer-V2 为 42.0%；答案泄漏率从 70.9% 降至 2.7%。在含 175 道未形式化 IMO 题目的 IMO-Unformalized 上实现零样本泛化，pass@4 验证忠实度达 87.4%（基线仅 19.4%），并在超过 79% 的盲测成对评估中胜出。

Conclusion: Sage 表明，结合编译诊断与语义反馈的分解式智能体流程能有效解决自然语言形式化中的严谨性幻觉与答案泄漏问题，在标准基准与未形式化前沿题目上均显著优于强基线，并具备良好的零样本泛化能力。

Abstract: While neural theorem provers have achieved impressive milestones in formal mathematics, they largely operate on the assumption that faithful Lean 4 formal statements are already provided. Translating informal natural language into a formal language is a critical data bottleneck plagued by an "illusion of rigor": standard type-checkers accept statements that compile but drop hypotheses, introduce vacuous truths, or subtly alter mathematical bounds. To resolve this, we introduce Sage (Semantic Agent-Guided Formalization Engine), an agentic framework that replaces monolithic translation with a four-stage decomposed generation pipeline coupled with a dual-signal semantic correction loop. By pairing Lean 4 compiler diagnostics with multi-dimensional semantic feedback, our correction loop enforces mathematical fidelity alongside syntactic validity. By explicitly accounting for the gap between open-ended queries and declarative formal targets, our pipeline prevents models from achieving high formalization rates by guessing unverified answers (exhibiting a 70.9% answer leakage rate). Consequently, Sage suppresses leakage to 2.7% while achieving 73.3% pass@4 joint compilation and semantic fidelity on the Omni-MATH without proofs (compared to 42.0% for a fine-tuned Goedel-Formalizer-V2 baseline). Finally, on IMO-Unformalized, a novel frontier of 175 unformalized International Mathematical Olympiad problems, Sage demonstrates effective zero-shot generalization with 87.4% pass@4 verified fidelity compared to just 19.4% for the baseline, winning over 79% of blind pairwise evaluations.

</details>


### [153] [Serverless gossip training of LSTM failure detectors: A matched-protocol comparison with federated, local and centralized learning on NASA C-MAPSS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35792)
*Yusuf Öztürk,Enes Göktekin,Bengisu Atlı,Akın Öztürk,Zhixiang Wang,Ulas Bagci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在NASA C-MAPSS涡扇发动机基准上，对比同步环形gossip学习与FedAvg、本地训练、中心化训练用于堆叠LSTM故障检测，gossip在无中心服务器下达到接近FedAvg的性能，适用于中等数据异构场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业预测性维护中设备数据分布在各地难以集中，FedAvg依赖中心聚合服务器，而gossip学习虽去中心化，但其在循环故障检测模型上的表现尚未在受控条件下被测量。

Method: 在NASA C-MAPSS涡扇基准上，用统一的开放实现、架构、初始化、优化器、数据划分和训练预算，比较同步环形gossip、FedAvg、孤立本地训练和中心化参考方法（堆叠LSTM预测即将失效）；主终点采用每台测试引擎单一终端窗口以避免重叠窗口的统计依赖。

Result: FD001（5个随机种子）：gossip终端窗口F1为89.6±1.3%，FedAvg为89.9±1.1%，本地训练83.6±6.7%，中心化93.5±2.1%，且gossip传输负载与FedAvg相同但无协调者。节点模型高度一致但不完全相同（成对决策分歧1.8% vs 无通信5.6%）。FD002-FD004中，对等通信使F1比本地训练提高13-28个点；gossip在FD003、FD004与FedAvg持平，在多工况FD002上低4.3个点。模拟消息丢失、节点故障和服务器中断对两种方法影响不大，但更大环形会更快降低gossip性能。

Conclusion: 在数据异构性中等时，环形gossip是实用的无服务器替代方案；随着异构性增大，更快混合的拓扑变得重要。

Abstract: Industrial predictive maintenance increasingly depends on learning from equipment spread across sites whose sensor data cannot easily be pooled. Federated averaging (FedAvg) solves this with a central aggregation server; gossip learning removes the server, but its behaviour for recurrent failure-detection models has not been measured under controlled conditions. We compare synchronous ring gossip with FedAvg, isolated local training and a centralized reference for a stacked LSTM that detects imminent failure on the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan benchmark. All methods share one open implementation, architecture, initialization, optimizer, data split and training budget, and the primary endpoint uses one terminal window per test engine to avoid the statistical dependence of overlapping windows. On FD001 (five seeds), gossip reached a terminal-window F1 of 89.6 +/- 1.3%, compared with 89.9 +/- 1.1% for FedAvg, 83.6 +/- 6.7% for local training and 93.5 +/- 2.1% for centralized training, while transmitting the same payload as FedAvg without a coordinator. Node models agreed closely but not exactly (1.8% pairwise decision disagreement versus 5.6% without communication). Across FD002-FD004, peer communication improved terminal-window F1 over local training by 13-28 points; gossip matched FedAvg on FD003 and FD004 but was 4.3 points lower on the multi-condition FD002 subset. Simulated message loss, node failure and server outage changed neither method appreciably, whereas larger rings degraded gossip faster. Ring gossip is therefore a practical serverless alternative when data heterogeneity is moderate, and faster-mixing topologies become important as heterogeneity grows.

</details>


### [154] [Learning from the Gap Between Pass@K and Pass@1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35793)
*Xuan Liu,Jingbin Qian,Haosheng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 GapFT，一种基于“单样本失败但 K 样本内可解”（Pass@K-Pass@1 差距）来选择训练样本的微调方法，将搜索能力蒸馏进单样本解码，在逻辑推理任务上显著提升 Pass@1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 越来越多采用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），精确验证器还能通过多样本搜索提升测试时性能。但部署中往往只做单样本解码，作者想探究：搜索所暴露的行为能否被吸收进模型本身。现有基于验证响应的后训练方法通常不区分“首次解码就解决”和“K 次采样内恢复”的问题，在固定预算下会浪费样本去重复模型已具备的行为。

Method: 提出 GapFT：根据源检查点的单样本结果选择训练证据，专门微调于 Pass@K 与 Pass@1 之间的差距样本——即策略单样本失败但在 K 样本内可解决的问题。保持训练样本数、处理 token 数和优化步数匹配，目标函数不变。用精确分解将“恢复失败”和“遗漏失败”的纠正与对首次解码成功的回归区分开来。

Result: 在 LogiQA 2.0 和 ReClor 上使用 Llama-3.1-8B，GapFT 相比源模型 Pass@1 分别提升 14.4 和 13.9 个点；在相同学习率下优于预算匹配的均匀验证 RFT；仅用三分之一数据即达到全验证池微调效果；单次解码达到源模型验证器选择的 Pass@4 精度。随机对照实验表明增益来自覆盖不同的失败案例。Qwen2.5-7B 三随机种子复现同样保持正向增益。

Conclusion: GapFT 通过针对性地利用搜索可恢复的失败样本来提升单样本解码能力，是一种高效、预算友好的微调策略。分析表明可用增益与可迁移的失败支持相关，为将测试时搜索能力蒸馏进模型提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR). An exact verifier can also support test-time scaling by selecting a passing response from multiple samples, while other deployments use beam search, adaptive sampling, or tools. We study single-sample decoding, where each query receives one response without search, to ask whether search-exposed behavior can be absorbed into the model. Existing verified-response post-training recipes do not generally distinguish problems already solved on the first decode from failures recovered within K samples. Under a fixed budget, this can spend examples repeating behavior the deployed policy already has. We introduce GapFT, which selects training evidence by the source checkpoint's single-sample outcome and fine-tunes on the Pass@K-Pass@1 gap: problems the policy fails on one sample but solves within K samples. We match training examples, processed tokens, and optimizer steps while keeping the objective unchanged. GapFT fills the matched budget with recovered failures and uses an exact decomposition to distinguish corrections of recovered and missed failures from regressions on first-decode successes. On LogiQA 2.0 and ReClor with Llama-3.1-8B, GapFT improves Pass@1 by 14.4 and 13.9 points over the source model, outperforms budget-matched uniform verified RFT at the same learning rate, and matches fine-tuning on the full verified pool using one third of the data. A single decode matches the source model's verifier-selected Pass@4 accuracy. A randomized control attributes gains to covering distinct failures, and our analysis relates available gains to transferable failure support. A three-seed Qwen2.5-7B replication retains positive gains over uniform RFT on both logic tasks.

</details>


### [155] [Calibration-First Cross-Cohort Multimodal Temporal Learning for Transferable Asthma-Risk Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35795)
*Taimoor Ahmad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CALIBRA：一个以校准为先的多模态时序框架，用于短时哮喘恶化风险预测，在跨队列迁移时保持可靠校准；在受控的三队列半合成基准上验证，AUPRC 0.224、AUROC 0.717、Brier 0.098，但未证明临床有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 哮喘恶化预测需在患者群体、传感器生态与可用模态跨队列变化时保持可靠。现有模型多优化队列内区分度，迁移后概率校准差，故需以校准为先、可处理不完整数据的框架。

Method: 专用循环编码器处理环境、肺功能、症状、用药、可穿戴与情境等多模态流；可靠性条件门控抑制过期或缺失模态；梯度反转训练减少可避免的队列特征。基于收缩的分层逻辑层用患者不相交目标子集校准概率，分裂共形预测提供可弃权的预测集。

Result: 在具受控分布偏移、信息性缺失与封存目标患者的三队列半合成基准上，五个随机种子下CALIBRA目标测试平均AUPRC为0.224（最强非消融对照TemporalTransformer为0.240），平均AUROC 0.717，Brier 0.098。实验还评估了全模态失效、校准、共形覆盖、决策曲线、亚组行为、消融、运行时间与参数量。

Conclusion: 结果在受控偏移下验证了方法与可复现流程，但未确立临床效果。仍需在统一化的真实哮喘数据上做外部验证，该工作为审慎管理的真实队列验证提供证据。

Abstract: Asthma deterioration forecasting must remain reli- able when patient populations, sensor ecosystems, and available modalities change across cohorts. Existing models commonly optimize within-cohort discrimination and may produce poorly calibrated probabilities after transfer. We present CALIBRA, a calibration-first multimodal temporal framework for short- horizon risk prediction with incomplete data. Dedicated recurrent encoders process environmental, pulmonary, symptom, medication, wearable, and context streams; a reliability-conditioned gate suppresses stale or absent modalities, while gradient-reversal training discourages avoidable cohort signatures. A shrinkage- based hierarchical logistic layer calibrates probabilities using a patient-disjoint target subset, and split conformal prediction provides abstention-capable prediction sets. To avoid fabricating clinical evidence, we evaluate the complete implementation on a documented three-cohort semi-synthetic benchmark with controlled distribution shift, informative missingness, and sealed target patients. Across five configured seeds, CALIBRA achieved mean target-test AUPRC 0.224 versus 0.240 for the strongest non-ablation comparator, TemporalTransformer; mean AUROC was 0.717, and Brier score was 0.098. Experiments additionally assess complete-modality failures, calibration, conformal coverage, decision curves, subgroup behavior, ablations, runtime, and parameter count. The results verify the method and reproducible pipeline under controlled shift, but do not establish clinical effectiveness. External validation on harmonized real asthma. Overall this artifact provides evidence for carefully governed real-cohort validation.

</details>


### [156] [Binarization Flattens the Score Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35797)
*Jacob Cole*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将LLM评判的二值化通过/不通过视为对未报告连续尺度上单一阈值的判定，存在仿射拉伸盲点；保留三档评分可消除该盲点，但仍有无法区分的方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM评判常被用作奖励信号，但奖励坍缩为0/1的通过/不通过，只报告结论而非满足标准的程度，形成一个系统性的评估盲点。

Method: 把每个通过/不通过判定建模为未报告尺度上的分数与某个阈值比较；证明尺度仿射拉伸不改变任何判定。采用联合高斯模型，引入第二个阈值（三档评分）以消除该拉伸歧义。在MATH与SciBench上，用一个七准则评判构造14个逐准则拉伸，比较二值化与三档下的可检测性，并做n=1,024、1.5倍压力下的功效检验。

Result: 14个构造的逐准则拉伸在二值化后全部不可见，在三档评分下均可见；n=1,024时检验功效至少96.5%。但保留三档后仍存在不可区分变化，包括档内任意变化与固定协方差、载荷对齐的均值漂移（一种被读作能力提升的谄媚式提升）。共享因子参考近似在MATH、SciBench上拟合良好，在HealthBench上不成立。

Conclusion: 建议保留至少三档评分（如完全、部分、未满足并奖励{0, 0.5, 1}），并沿剩余不可消除的方向对增益做外部验证；仅靠判定不足以区分真实改进。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) judges are often used as rewards to train policies on objectives that deterministic verifiers cannot capture. However, these rewards are often collapsed to pass/fail ({0, 1}), which reports the verdict but not how well a response met each criterion.
