We model each pass/fail verdict as a score on an unreported scale, compared with one cutoff. A stretch of that scale moves every score proportionally toward or away from the cutoff, but never across it, so no verdict changes. A policy is therefore free to apply any stretch without changing anything the panel reports. Under a joint-Gaussian model, a third grade adds a second threshold and removes this affine stretch ambiguity. On MATH and SciBench outputs from one seven-criterion judge, all 14 constructed criterionwise stretches were invisible after binarization but visible with three grades. At $n=1{,}024$, a test given both population laws had at least 96.5% power at a $1.5\times$ stress. Retaining grades closes one blind spot created by binarization, but verdicts alone remain insufficient as some changes are still indistinguishable from genuine improvement. These include arbitrary within-grade changes and fixed-covariance, loading-aligned mean shifts -- the signature of a sycophancy-shaped lift the panel reads as competence. The shared-factor reference approximation fit MATH and SciBench but not HealthBench, delineating its empirical scope. We recommend keeping at least three grades (for example, asking the judge whether each criterion is fully, partially, or not met and rewarding {0, 0.5, 1}), and externally validating gains along the remaining direction, which no finer scale removes.

</details>


### [157] [HeadGuard: Selective Head Protection for Low-Bit VLM KV-Cache Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35800)
*Nenad Banfic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HeadGuard通过固定高精度掩码保护约1/8的KV头，缓解低比特KV缓存量化对VLM精度的损害，可组合于现有量化器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特KV缓存量化虽节省存储，但会显著降低视觉-语言模型（VLM）精度，需要一种不替换底层量化器就能提升精度的方案。

Method: 提出HeadGuard，一种可组合的头保护方法：通过图像敏感性和输出敏感性分数离线选择物理KV头，约保护1/8的头，其图像键（可选值）保持BF16，其余未保护图像条目由基础量化器量化。

Result: 在8个VLM、3种基础量化器、8个基准（6判别+2生成）上评估。2比特时，最弱基础量化器下8模型六任务判别均值从0.436升至0.580；在Qwen和InternVL上增益最强；还能改善生成答案与字幕对BF16输出的保真度；均值增益在两种校准数据集上均持续；仅保护键时以较低建模存储成本保留显著恢复。

Conclusion: HeadGuard为通过模拟量化评估的方法，提供了一种可组合方式，在不替换底层量化器的前提下提升低比特VLM精度。

Abstract: Low-bit key-value (KV) cache quantization saves storage but can sharply degrade vision-language model (VLM) accuracy. We introduce HeadGuard, a composable head-protection method that augments a base KV-cache quantizer with a fixed high-precision mask. Image-sensitivity and output-sensitivity scores select physical KV heads offline, with approximately 1/8 protected in the main experiments; their image keys and optionally values remain in bfloat16 (BF16), while the base quantizes unprotected image entries. Across eight VLMs, three base quantizers, and eight benchmarks (six discriminative and two generative), HeadGuard recovers a substantial fraction of lost accuracy on weaker quantizers, with the strongest gains for Qwen and InternVL. At 2 bits, the six-task discriminative mean over eight models rises from 0.436 to 0.580 on the weakest base; protection can also improve generated answers and caption fidelity to BF16 outputs. Mean accuracy gains persist across all three quantizers with both tested calibration datasets. Keys-only protection retains substantial recovery at lower modeled storage cost. Evaluated through simulated quantization, HeadGuard offers a composable way to improve low-bit VLM accuracy without replacing the underlying quantizer.

</details>


### [158] [Learned Compression of SAR Phase-History Data: A Rate-Honest Feasibility Study on GOTCHA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35848)
*Alizishaan Khatri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文测试小型卷积自编码器（编码器置于传感器端）能否在SAR相位历史压缩上媲美BAQ，结论是否定的，并给出面向学习型雷达压缩的评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 星载SAR相位历史压缩对带宽要求极高，块自适应量化（BAQ）仍是实际运行标准。作者希望检验小型卷积自编码器能否在真实相位历史数据上与之竞争。

Method: 在AFRL GOTCHA数据的复数相位历史块上，将自编码器（编码器仅28,656参数）与8位BAQ、16×16块KLT对比；所有方法按全部传输比特计费，速率以比特/复样本（b/cs）计，并用CA-CFAR检测的一对一匹配评分；额外尝试在压扩傅里叶域运行网络。

Result: 自编码器在所有速率下均落后：16 b/cs时NMSE为-2.87 dB，而±3σ截断的8位BAQ为-35.5 dB，调优截断范围为-41.0 dB；也不及参数成本仅十分之一的16×16块KLT（-5.39 dB）。压扩傅里叶域有改善，但检测F1仍限于33%。此外发现：原始64×64块上97%的CFAR越界为零填充检测器的边界伪影；内部单元上BAQ截断范围决定检测，8位BAQ调优截断F1为69%而±3σ仅17%，且8 b/cs及以下自适应FFT阈值化保留的检测多于BAQ。

Conclusion: 失败源于该模型、其归一化与目标函数，而非学习型编码的根本极限；逐块数据的lag-1相干性较低（|ρ|≈0.3）且谱集中度具块特异性。评估本身有两点需要注意：零填充检测器边界伪影，以及截断范围对BAQ检测的决定性影响。作者据此提出面向学习型雷达压缩的评估协议。

Abstract: On-board compression of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) phase history is bandwidth-critical, and block-adaptive quantization (BAQ) remains the operational standard. We test whether a small convolutional autoencoder, with its encoder on the sensor, can compete with BAQ on complex phase-history patches from the AFRL GOTCHA collection. Every method is charged for all transmitted bits, rates are reported in bits per complex sample (b/cs), and detection is scored by one-to-one matching of CA-CFAR detections. The autoencoder (28,656 encoder parameters) loses at every rate. At 16 b/cs it reaches -2.87 dB NMSE, against -35.5 dB for 8-bit BAQ with $\pm 3σ$ clipping and -41.0 dB with a tuned clipping range. It also loses to a $16 \times 16$ block Karhunen-Loève transform (KLT), a local linear coder with a tenth of its encoder cost (-5.39 dB). Running the network in a companded Fourier domain helps, but its detection F1 remains bounded at 33%. The evidence points to this model, its normalization, and its objective, not to a fundamental limit of learned coding. Per patch, the data have modest lag-1 coherence ($|ρ| \approx 0.3$) and patch-specific spectral concentration. Two findings concern evaluation itself. First, 97% of CFAR crossings on raw $64 \times 64$ patches are border artifacts of the zero-padded detector. Second, on interior cells BAQ's clipping range decides detection: 8-bit BAQ keeps 69% F1 with tuned clipping but 17% at $\pm 3σ$, and at 8 b/cs or less adaptive FFT thresholding preserves more detections than BAQ. We close with an evaluation protocol for learned radar compression.

</details>


### [159] [A Mesoscopic View of Transformer Weights Through Row and Column Scale Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35852)
*Tiexin Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究Transformer权重的"介观"结构——行/列尺度场（信道上的中位数中心对数RMS剖面），发现不同规模与初始化下平衡核幅度剖面相似，并揭示其与功能信道、RoPE频率及AdamW二阶矩的组织关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 汇总统计（pooled statistics）掩盖了权重幅度在功能信道上的分布，而逐一比较单个权重又因数量过多而不可行；因此需要一个介于两者之间的"介观"分析层级来刻画训练后的权重结构。

Method: 提出行与列尺度场，即权重矩阵在信道上中位数中心化的对数RMS剖面，配合全局尺度与完整平衡核可精确表示原矩阵。分析覆盖四个规模的公开Pythia检查点及三个初始化家族的受控实验，并用预先固定形式、拟合系数的混合桥模型预测池化形状偏离；进一步把信道分析扩展到AdamW二阶矩的对数空间行列因子，以及对冻结检查点做权重编辑实验。

Result: 平衡后测得的核幅度剖面在不同规模与初始化下相似；混合桥模型能在留出的受控网格运行与数据分支上预测形状偏离。索引场保留额外结构：共享功能信道的投影之间对齐，query/key剖面跟随重分配的RoPE频率而非固定矩阵坐标；训练轨迹显示早期场形成后出现依赖组分的展宽或收缩；AdamW二阶矩呈现相关的功能组织。编辑实验可将保前向计算的互反尺度平衡与相对信道增益分离：展平增益会提高分布内损失，同时保持矩阵范数与平衡核。

Conclusion: 行列尺度场把池化幅度统计与信道组织联系起来，为追踪和检验训练后权重结构提供了坐标框架。

Abstract: Pooled statistics of Transformer weights obscure how magnitude is distributed across functional channels, while individual weights are too numerous to compare directly. We study the mesoscopic level between them: row and column scale fields, the median-centred log-RMS profiles of a weight matrix over its channels, which together with a global scale and a full balanced core represent the matrix exactly. Across public Pythia checkpoints at four sizes and controlled runs from three initialization families, balancing reveals similar measured core magnitude profiles. A mixture bridge, with its form fixed before the analysis and its coefficients fitted, predicts the pooled-shape departure from field width on held-out runs and data arms of the controlled grid. The indexed fields retain further structure: they align across projections that share a functional channel, and query/key profiles follow reassigned RoPE frequencies rather than fixed matrix coordinates. Training trajectories show early field formation followed by component-dependent broadening or recession. Extending the channel-based analysis to AdamW's second moment reveals related functional organization in its log-space row and column factors. Finally, edits of a frozen checkpoint separate reciprocal scale balance, which preserves the forward computation, from relative channel gain: flattening the gain increases in-distribution loss while preserving matrix norms and the balanced core. Row and column scale fields thus connect pooled magnitude statistics to channel organization and provide coordinates for tracking and testing trained weight structure.

</details>


### [160] [Position: Let's Strengthen Verifiability If We Can't Enforce Reproducibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35854)
*Samet Hicsonmez,Nermin Samet,Renaud Marlet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出现有机器学习论文中实证结果难以复现、代码常不公开、阻碍研究发展，并通过量化分析与具体建议来提升结果的可核查性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习领域的许多论文包含支持其论点或展示方法性能的实证结果，但实践中普遍存在结果难以复现（且情况日益恶化）、代码不常公开等问题，这些问题阻碍了研究发展，因此有必要分析并量化这些现状。

Method: 作为一篇立场论文（position paper），作者对上述问题进行分析与量化，并提出具体建议，以改进结果的"可核查性"（即使不能完全做到可复现）。相关代码与支撑材料已公开。

Result: 论文对结果难以复现、代码不易获取等问题进行了量化分析，并给出了具体建议；代码与支撑材料公开发布于 GitHub 仓库。

Conclusion: 作者主张应努力提升机器学习研究结果的可核查性，至少接近可复现，并提出具体措施；所有代码与材料已公开以便查证。

Abstract: In the field of Machine Learning, many papers contain empirical results supporting claimed statements or illustrating the performance of a proposed method. However, most practitioners know that (1) results are generally hard to reproduce, and increasingly so, (2) code is not often available to do so, and (3) it hinders the development of research. In this position paper, we analyze and quantify these issues, and make concrete proposals to improve result checkability, if not reproducibility. Code and supporting materials are available at https://github.com/giddyyupp/position-enforce-verifiability.

</details>


### [161] [Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35855)
*Yubin Lyu,Fu Li,Jiawei Fei,Yang Zhao,Weixing Mei,Yinan Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Mara Chain 将优化过程中被淘汰的候选配置保留并迭代精炼，配合固定深度链与 Pareto 过滤 Top-N 选择，在多个任务上以更少 rollout 获得更高性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对已部署 AI 系统的优化主要体现为编辑 prompt、技能、harness 和代码，而非模型权重。主流方法采用"提议-评估-选择"流程，只保留满足接受标准的候选，但被丢弃的候选往往蕴含对后续优化至关重要的信息，直接丢弃会导致后续提议重复相同的失败模式。

Method: 提出 Mara Chain 精炼过程：不丢弃被拒绝的候选，而是保留并利用前序尝试积累的证据对其进行迭代精炼，将其转化为前进的基石。每条精炼链限定固定深度，并采用 Pareto 过滤的 Top-N 选择来约束候选池规模。

Result: 在 AppWorld 技能优化、TerminalBench 2.1 harness 优化和 MuSiQue 检索流水线优化中，Mara Chain 以更少 rollout 取得更大任务性能提升。AppWorld 上相对性能比 GEPA、ACE、SkillOpt-Lite 最高提升 20.5%，比 GEPA 少 65.5% rollout 即达目标分数；TerminalBench 2.1 上 pass rate 分别比 AHE 和 Meta-Harness 提升 20.2 和 22.5 个百分点；MuSiQue 上相比手写检索流水线，test nDCG@10 与 Recall@10 分别提升 0.104 和 0.131。

Conclusion: 将被拒绝的候选视为可精炼的中间产物而非应丢弃的失败品，能够有效利用其中信息、避免重复失败模式，从而在更少评估预算下实现更强的优化效果，为面向 prompt、技能、harness 与代码的 AI 系统优化提供了一种高效的新范式。

Abstract: Optimizing deployed AI systems increasingly amounts to editing prompts, skills, harnesses, and code rather than model weights. Existing approaches commonly optimize these artifacts through propose-evaluate-select procedures, where candidate configurations are evaluated and only those meeting an acceptance criterion are selected. Yet our analysis shows that discarded candidates often contain information critical for subsequent optimization. Discarding them causes later proposals to revisit the same failure modes. We introduce Mara Chain, a refinement procedure that turns rejected candidates into stepping stones. Rather than discarding a rejected candidate, Mara Chain retains and iteratively refines it using evidence accumulated across preceding attempts. The procedure limits each refinement chain to a fixed depth and applies Pareto-filtered Top-N selection to bound the candidate pool. Across AppWorld skill optimization, TerminalBench 2.1 harness optimization, and MuSiQue retrieval-pipeline optimization, Mara Chain delivers greater task-performance gains with fewer rollouts. It outperforms GEPA, ACE, and SkillOpt-Lite by up to 20.5% in relative performance on AppWorld, reaching the target score with 65.5% fewer rollouts than GEPA. It improves the pass rate by 20.2 and 22.5 percentage points over AHE and Meta-Harness on TerminalBench 2.1, respectively, and improves MuSiQue test nDCG@10 and Recall@10 by 0.104 and 0.131 over a hand-written retrieval pipeline.

</details>


### [162] [Beyond Keywords: Leveraging Generative LLMs and Label Aggregation to Classify Economic Policy Uncertainty in News Articles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35856)
*Paul Trust*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出基于弱监督与经济政策不确定性（EPU）的方法，利用生成式LLM通过提示创建合成标签，实现公共部门经济监测中文章的EPU自动判定与多标签、层级分类，兼具成本效益与可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EPU判定方法存在两类问题：关键词方法常产生大量假阳性；机器学习方法依赖大量高质量人工标注数据，获取成本高且耗时长。因此需要一种低成本、可扩展的方案。

Method: 采用弱监督技术，基于生成式大语言模型（LLM）通过提示（prompting）生成合成标签，从而自动判断文章是否讨论EPU并识别其具体类型；同时提出面向EPU相关文章的多标签与层级分类方法。

Result: 提出了一套兼具成本效益与可扩展性的EPU自动识别与分类方法，并实现了多标签与层级分类的解决方案。摘要未提供具体量化实验结果。

Conclusion: 利用生成式LLM生成的合成标签进行弱监督训练，可有效替代昂贵的人工标注，为公共部门经济监测中的EPU识别与多标签、层级分类提供可行途径。

Abstract: This research describes the adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs) for economic monitoring in the public sector to automatically determine whether an article discusses Economic Policy Uncertanity (EPU) and to identify its specific type. Previous studies either rely on keywords, which often result in a high count of false positives, or use machine learning approaches that require a large number of quality human labeled data that is costly and time consuming to acquire. In this study, we propose approaches based on weak supervision techniques, using generative LLMs to create synthetic labels through prompting, making the approach both cost-effective and scalable. Additionally, we propose methods for for multi-label and hierarchical classification of articles related to EPU.

</details>


### [163] [ReLOBGen: Replayable Limit Order Book Message Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35867)
*Junoh Kang,Kiseop Lee,Bohyung Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ReLOBGen，一种"构造即回放"的限价订单簿（LOB）消息生成方法，生成时即保证可回放性，100% 回放率并实现 2.7-3.6 倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭环市场模拟要求 LOB 消息可回放，但现有生成器会产生与当前市场状态不一致的原始消息，需要事后修正或重采样，可能改变消息分布或增加推理成本。

Method: ReLOBGen 在生成过程中直接保证可回放性：先从当前 LOB 的挂单中采样被引用订单（基于缓存订单表示与上下文相关查询学习得到的合法挂单分布），再通过屏蔽无效 token 来保证其余字段与该订单及市场状态一致。

Result: 在 500 条消息的回放中达到 100% 可回放率，提升了市场真实性（尤其是盘口顶部统计与 LOB 消息相对价格），相比 LOBS5 基线每条回放消息提速 2.7-3.6 倍。

Conclusion: 无需事后修正或重采样，ReLOBGen 即可高效生成真实且构造上可回放的 LOB 消息。

Abstract: We propose ReLOBGen, a method for generating limit order book (LOB) messages that are replayable by construction. Replayability is required for closed-loop market simulation, yet existing LOB message generators may produce non-replayable raw messages, i.e., messages inconsistent with the current market state. These generators therefore rely on post-hoc correction or rejection followed by resampling, which may alter the replayed message distribution or increase inference cost. ReLOBGen instead ensures replayability during generation: it selects the referenced order from the resting orders in the current LOB and then generates the remaining message fields to be consistent with that order and the market state. For realistic reference selection, ReLOBGen samples from a learned distribution over eligible resting orders, efficiently computed from cached order representations and a context-dependent query. It then enforces the consistency of the remaining fields by masking out invalid tokens. Together, these components enable efficient generation of realistic messages without post-hoc correction or resampling. In 500-message rollouts, ReLOBGen achieves 100% replayability, improves market realism, particularly for top-of-book statistics and the relative prices of LOB messages, and provides a $2.7\text{-}3.6\times$ speedup per replayed message over the LOBS5 baseline.

</details>


### [164] [Hybrid Ensemble Learning for EEG-Based Epileptic Seizure Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35876)
*Mason Dana,Khandaker Mamun Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种校准的混合集成方法用于EEG癫痫发作预测，结合5个深度学习模型和3个经典机器学习模型，通过逻辑回归堆叠元学习器融合，在CHB-MIT数据集上采用严格的留一患者交叉验证，实现了74.2%的癫痫发作级别敏感度和1.24次/小时的误报率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 癫痫发作预测旨在在发作前提供可操作的预警，但患者无关的泛化能力和误报控制仍是主要挑战。现有方法难以在不同患者间保持稳定性能，且误报率往往较高。

Method: 提出一种校准的混合集成框架：结合五个深度学习模型与三个经典机器学习模型，通过逻辑回归堆叠（stacking）元学习器进行融合。流程整合了信号预处理、手工特征提取、类别不平衡处理、概率校准和临床启发的后处理。在CHB-MIT数据集上使用严格的留一患者交叉验证（LOPO），阈值和后处理参数仅在保留的元数据上选择。

Result: 在过滤后的队列上（排除发作前比率低于1%或高于15%的异常患者），模型在每小时1.24次误报下达到74.2%的发作级别敏感度，平均预警时间为16.9分钟。受限于目标误报预算的测试调优oracle在每小时0.951次误报下达到60.9%敏感度，突显了同时报告敏感度与实际误报率的重要性。

Conclusion: 该混合集成框架在患者无关的癫痫发作预测中展现出较好的敏感度与误报控制平衡，并强调在报告中应同时呈现敏感度和实际误报率。代码已开源。

Abstract: Epileptic seizure forecasting aims to provide actionable warnings before seizure onset, yet patient-independent generalization and false-alarm control remain major challenges. We propose a calibrated hybrid ensemble for EEG-based seizure forecasting that combines five deep learning models and three classical machine learning models through a logistic regression stacking meta-learner. The proposed pipeline integrates signal preprocessing, handcrafted feature extraction, class-imbalance handling, probability calibration, and clinically motivated post-processing. We evaluate the framework on CHB-MIT using strict Leave-One-Patient-Out (LOPO) cross-validation, with threshold and post-processing parameters selected only on held-out meta data. On the filtered cohort, excluding patients with anomalous preictal rates below 1\% or above 15\%, the model achieves 74.2\% seizure-level sensitivity at 1.24 false alarms per hour, with an average warning time of 16.9 minutes. A test-tuned oracle constrained to the target false-alarm budget achieves 60.9\% sensitivity at 0.951 false alarms per hour, highlighting the importance of reporting sensitivity together with realized false-alarm rates. Our code is available at: https://github.com/DanaMason/IEEE-CARS-Hybrid-Ensemble-Learning-for-EEG-Based-Epileptic-Seizure-Forecasting

</details>


### [165] [From Static Policies to Adaptive Priors in Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35880)
*Tianwei Ni,Vineet Jain,Akash Karthikeyan,Pierre-Luc Bacon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一篇立场论文，主张当离线训练的策略随后要经过在线交互更新时，离线RL的目标应从"直接部署"转向学习"自适应策略先验"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代智能系统中越来越多出现测试时自适应与在线微调，离线训练的策略往往需要后续在线更新。传统的保守目标只关注直接部署下的鲁棒性，在需要后续交互改进时显得不完整，因此需要重新界定离线RL的目标。

Method: 作者提出"自适应离线强化学习（AORL）"的形式化视角，将其与"离线到在线RL（offline-to-online RL）"区分开来，并论述在分布偏移、数据覆盖有限和测试时条件变化下适应性的重要性；进一步讨论贝叶斯离线RL作为构建自适应策略先验的原则性方向，通过保留对可能环境的认知不确定性来实现。

Result: 论文为这一新视角提供了形式化表述与概念区分，论证了适应性需求的来源，并指出了贝叶斯离线RL作为构造自适应先验的一种可行路径，同时梳理了与其他方向的联系。

Conclusion: 应把离线RL视为对未来经验的准备，而非静态部署问题；论文最后给出了开放挑战与研究方向的展望。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally focused on learning policies for direct deployment under conservative objectives, where uncertainty outside the offline dataset is treated pessimistically to ensure robustness. We argue that this formulation becomes incomplete when an offline-trained policy is subsequently updated through online interaction, as increasingly occurs in modern intelligent systems through test-time adaptation and online fine-tuning. This position paper argues that, in such settings, the objective of offline RL should extend beyond immediate deployment and instead prioritize learning adaptive policy priors: policies that preserve the capacity to improve during subsequent interaction through memory, exploration, and self-correction. We formalize this perspective as adaptive offline reinforcement learning (AORL), distinguish it from offline-to-online RL, and explain why adaptability becomes important under distributional shift, limited dataset coverage, and changing test-time conditions. We further discuss Bayesian offline RL as one principled direction for constructing adaptive policy priors by preserving epistemic uncertainty over plausible environments. Finally, we outline connections, open challenges, and research directions for treating offline RL as preparation for future experience rather than as a static deployment problem.

</details>


### [166] [Learning in the Transverse Subspace: A Minimal Representation for Divergence-Free Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35884)
*Yifei Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种将 \(D\) 维无散向量场最小化表示为同域上 \((D-1)\) 分量场的方法，利用 Fourier 空间横截结构与 Householder 正交变换构造可逆、等距的约化坐标，使神经算子直接在约化空间学习时间演化并在推理时直接解码为无散场，从而获得更低预测误差和更强鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无散向量场是不可压缩流和许多 PDE 系统的基本状态变量。现有冗余参数化（如 NCL 势）会把多个辅助表示映射到同一物理场，这种多对一映射虽能扩大等价解集、降低静态拟合误差，但无法为算子学习提供唯一状态，从而不利于时间动力学建模。

Method: 提出最小表示：将 \(D\) 维域上的实 \(D\) 分量无散向量场编码为同域上的实 \((D-1)\) 分量场。利用不可压缩性在 Fourier 空间施加的横截结构，通过 Householder 正交变换直接构造约化坐标。对周期与闭合不可渗透场，该变换可逆、等距且保角；对开放非周期流，用 Fourier 扩展构造兼容周期场，并用最小能量规则选出唯一约化表示。神经算子完全在约化空间学习时间演化，推理时直接将预测的 \((D-1)\) 分量场解码为物理无散 \(D\) 分量场，无需预测环境场或后处理投影。

Result: 静态拟合与时间预测实验揭示任务相关的权衡：冗余有利于静态优化，而唯一可逆坐标能为时间动力学提供良定义状态。通过从学习状态空间中去除无约束的纵向或零方向，所提公式在构造上保持无散性的同时，实现了更低的预测误差和更强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 唯一可逆的最小约化坐标比冗余参数化更适合无散场的时间算子学习，可避免多对一映射带来的状态不唯一问题，并在保证散度自由的同时提升预测精度与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Divergence-free vector fields are fundamental state variables in incompressible flows and many PDE systems. Redundant parameterizations, including Neural Conservation Law (NCL) potentials, map multiple auxiliary representations to the same physical field. Our experiments show that this redundancy can reduce static representation-fitting error by enlarging the set of equivalent solutions, but the resulting many-to-one mapping does not provide a unique state for operator learning.
  We introduce a minimal representation that encodes a real \(D\)-component divergence-free vector field on a \(D\)-dimensional domain as a real \((D-1)\)-component field on the same domain. Exploiting the transverse structure imposed by incompressibility in Fourier space, we use a Householder orthogonal transformation to construct the reduced coordinates directly. For periodic and closed impermeable fields, the transform is invertible, isometric, and angle-preserving. For open nonperiodic flows, Fourier extension constructs a compatible periodic field, and a minimum-energy rule selects a unique reduced representation.
  Neural operators then learn temporal evolution entirely in this reduced space. At inference, the predicted \((D-1)\)-component field is decoded directly into a physical divergence-free \(D\)-component field, without predicting an ambient field or applying post-hoc projection.
  Experiments on static fitting and temporal prediction reveal a task-dependent trade-off: redundancy facilitates static optimization, whereas unique invertible coordinates provide a well-defined state for temporal dynamics. By removing unconstrained longitudinal or null directions from the learned state space, the proposed formulation achieves lower prediction error and greater robustness while preserving divergence freedom by construction.

</details>


### [167] [The Decision Value of Perception Compute](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35910)
*Hoang Pham Cong,Ho Viet Duc Luong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"感知计算决策价值"概念与DEEP基准，发现自适应感知升级常损害下游决策，仅轻量路由器在高延迟预算下仍优于随机分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应感知通常假设更精细的感知输出必然带来更好的下游决策，从而在预期收益高的输入上投入更多算力。然而当感知服务于下游决策系统时，更好的感知未必产生更好的决策，现有评估缺乏以决策价值为标准的衡量方式。

Method: 定义感知计算的决策价值为：将输入从廉价感知模式升级到昂贵模式时下游损失的变化。以预算受限的决策oracle为评判标准（而非以统一全精度推理为上限）。提出DEEP基准，在选择性、延迟和能耗预算下对升级前的分配器打分，并将分配器自身计算计入成本。在KITTI、nuScenes的单目几何及nuPlan的PDM-Closed规划器上评估。

Result: 34–54%的改变下游损失的升级反而使其变差；PDM-Closed规划器在nuPlan上也出现有害升级。nuScenes上感知级增益与决策价值符号经常不一致。按感知增益而非决策价值选择固定信号，会使实际测试决策增益平均下降7.4%（相对全廉价损失）。学习型分配器能恢复部分oracle价值但选出的有害升级接近随机水平；计入自身计算、在20%延迟预算下，仅轻量路由器（约全检测器一遍的3.5%）仍优于随机。

Conclusion: 感知升级的收益不能简单以感知指标衡量，必须以决策价值为准。DEEP提供了相应评估框架，并表明高效的自适应感知分配仍具挑战，轻量路由器是目前少数有效的方案。

Abstract: Adaptive perception spends extra computation on inputs where perception is expected to improve. When perception feeds a downstream decision system, a better perception output need not produce a better decision. We define the decision value of perception compute as the change in downstream loss from escalating an input from a cheap to an expensive perception mode. Because this value can be negative, the allocation of perception compute should be judged against a budget-constrained decision oracle, with uniform full-fidelity inference as a baseline rather than an upper bound. We introduce DEEP (Decision Evaluation for Escalated Perception), a benchmark that scores pre-escalation allocators against this oracle under selection, latency and energy budgets, charging each allocator for its own computation. With deployed monocular geometry on KITTI and nuScenes, we find that 34--54% of the escalations that change downstream loss make it worse; harmful escalations also occur for the published PDM-Closed planner, evaluated open-loop on nuPlan with real detector outcomes. On nuScenes, perception-level gain frequently disagrees in sign with decision value. This mismatch has practical consequences: choosing among fixed deployable signals by missed-object perception gain rather than by decision value reduces realized test decision gain by 7.4% of the all-cheap loss on average. Learned allocators recover part of the oracle's value by finding beneficial escalations but select nearly as much harm as random, and once their own computation is charged at a 20% latency budget, only the lightweight routers, at about 3.5\% of a full detector pass, still beat random.

</details>


### [168] [Learn Now, Use Next, Trust Later: Prequential Test-Time Learning for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35911)
*Tong Zhao,Reed Li,Yuyang Hu,Yutao Zhu,Haijin Liang,Haibo Shi,Yu Lu,Zhicheng Dou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: StepLearn：一种非参数框架，将"即时使用"与"持久信任"分离，把有信息量的转移转化为可指导下一步的假设，并要求跨情节复用前需经前瞻性验证，仅在外部知识更新而模型参数固定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署阶段的LLM智能体不仅需保留过往经验，还需将新观察及时转化为指导。许多测试时学习方法从已完成的整段情节中获取知识，反馈无法及时蒸馏用于下一次决策；若以单步转移为粒度获取知识虽可降低延迟，但存在新挑战：单个情节内有效的规则未必足够可靠以指导未来情节，等待验证会丧失即时收益，而无限制复用会传播偶然或被错误归因的指导。

Method: StepLearn为非参数框架，分离即时使用与持久信任：将有信息量的转移转化为假设以指导下一步；在跨情节复用前要求前瞻性验证，将其预测效果与源情节之外的后续观察进行比对，只有获得充分支持的假设才可用于持久指导。整个过程更新外部知识而保持所有模型参数不变。

Result: 在WebArena-Lite与ALFWorld上经五轮实验：GPT-5-mini平均成功率59.9%和84.0%，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B为57.8%和88.1%，在四种设置下均超过最强基线EvoTest达2.2–12.7个百分点。学习动态显示收益不限于最终轮次，多数设置中首次任务尝试即已具备优势。

Conclusion: 通过分离即时使用与持久信任并引入前瞻性验证，StepLearn在不更新模型参数的前提下实现了及时且可靠的测试时知识获取，显著优于现有基线，且优势在早期尝试中即已显现。

Abstract: Adapting large language model agents during deployment requires not only retaining past experience, but also turning new observations into timely guidance. Many test-time learning methods, however, acquire knowledge from completed episodes. Feedback from an ongoing interaction may therefore not be distilled into knowledge soon enough to help the next decision. Acquiring knowledge at the granularity of individual transitions could reduce this delay, but raises a separate challenge: a rule that is useful within one episode may not be reliable enough to guide future episodes. Waiting for validation can forfeit immediate benefits, whereas unrestricted reuse can propagate accidental or misattributed guidance. We introduce StepLearn, a nonparametric framework that separates immediate use from persistent trust. It turns informative transitions into hypotheses that can guide the next step, while requiring prospective validation before reuse across episodes. Their predicted effects are checked against subsequent observations outside the source episodes, and only sufficiently supported hypotheses become available for persistent guidance. This process updates external knowledge while keeping all model parameters fixed. Over five rounds on WebArena-Lite and ALFWorld, StepLearn achieves average success rates of 59.9% and 84.0% with GPT-5-mini, and 57.8% and 88.1% with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, respectively. It outperforms EvoTest, the strongest baseline, by 2.2-12.7 percentage points across the four settings. Learning dynamics further shows that these gains are not restricted to the final repetition, with advantages already present on first task attempts in most settings.

</details>


### [169] [Replication Failure and Trivial Baselines in Road-Level Crash Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35917)
*Maurya Patel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文独立复现了一个不确定性感知的道路级碰撞预测模型的数据流程，发现其多数设计决策无法在其他行政区重现，且图神经网络相对历史基线的优势主要来自基线回看窗口过短这一人为因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络在道路级碰撞预测中被广泛应用，但其报告的性能增益的稳健性缺乏审查。作者希望检验这些增益是否真实、可复现，并揭示评估协议中的潜在偏差。

Method: 独立重建近期一个不确定性感知模型的数据流程，在伦敦三个行政区、扩展窗口协议下评估其十一个设计决策；采用多种子评估；并将两个网络与一个无参数基线（按累计历史碰撞数排名路段）对比，同时扫描基线的回看时间跨度。

Result: 十一个设计决策中四个在第二个行政区成功复现，七个未能复现，其中四个符号反转。多种子评估显示单行政区内不同随机种子间出现符号反转，参考架构的行政区种子波动最高达35.7个百分点，而作者模型仅4个百分点。在匹配历史深度下，作者模型与基线统计上无差异（−0.90点，p=0.61），参考架构在18/18个留出窗口上均输给基线（−17.37，p<10⁻⁶）。基线准确率随回看时间跨度从22.71%变化到83.94%，且该领域所有已发表数字都能在1至5年跨度下被该基线达到。

Conclusion: 该任务中图网络相对历史基线的表面优势主要是基线在过短时间跨度上计算所造成的人为产物。作者建议将时间跨度匹配的基线和多种子报告作为最低实验标准。

Abstract: Graph neural networks are increasingly applied to road-level crash prediction, but the stability of their reported gains has received little scrutiny. We independently reconstruct the data pipeline of a recent uncertainty-aware model and evaluate eleven of its design decisions across three London boroughs under an expanding-window protocol. Four survive replication on a second borough; seven do not, and four of those reverse sign rather than attenuate. Multi-seed evaluation is decisive: one effect reverses sign between random seeds within a single borough, and the reference architecture exhibits per-borough seed spreads of up to 35.7 points against 4 points for ours. We further compare both networks against a parameter-free baseline that ranks segments by cumulative past crash count. At matched history depth our model is statistically indistinguishable from that baseline ($-0.90$ points, $p=0.61$), and the reference architecture loses to it on 18 of 18 held-out windows ($-17.37$, $p<10^{-6}$). Sweeping the baseline's lookback horizon shows it spans 22.71% to 83.94% accuracy on that variable alone, and that every published figure in this line of work is matched by the baseline at a horizon of one to five years. We argue that the apparent margin of graph networks over historical baselines in this task is substantially an artefact of the short horizons those baselines were computed over, and recommend horizon-matched baselines and multi-seed reporting as minimum practice.

</details>


### [170] [Normative Loss Landscape Navigation: A Trajectory-Based Approach to Mitigating Forgetting in Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35926)
*Isabelle Aguilar,Zayn Andre Zainal,Luis Fernando Herbozo Contreras,Zhaojing Huang,Omid Kavehei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TMLN，将连续学习形式化为弯曲损失景观上的最优控制问题，利用对角经验Fisher信息矩阵构建局部黎曼流形，并通过参数历史轨迹动态调节预条件器，梯度更新中直接屏蔽历史关键参数方向，减少任务间损失障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续学习在非平稳数据分布上顺序训练时面临灾难性遗忘。既有方法分为两类：权重正则化施加僵化的标量欧氏惩罚，完全忽略参数空间的黎曼几何结构；而预条件梯度方法虽能缓解遗忘，但现有方案是短视的，缺乏对历史轨迹的全局视角。两者之间存在空白。

Method: 提出TMLN（轨迹调节景观导航），将连续学习形式化为弯曲损失景观上的最优控制问题，作为规范性导航策略。使用内存高效的对角经验Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）定义局部黎曼流形；为补偿对角近似在空间上的局限，利用网络参数值的归一化历史轨迹动态调节预条件器；将该基于轨迹的预条件直接整合进梯度更新中，而非依赖加性惩罚来主动屏蔽历史关键参数方向。

Result: 在类别增量和域增量基准上的实证评估表明，该方法显著降低了相邻任务之间的损失障碍（loss barrier）。

Conclusion: TMLN通过将黎曼几何预条件与历史轨迹动态调节相结合，直接在梯度更新中屏蔽历史关键参数方向，避免了加性惩罚的僵化性，有效缓解连续学习中的灾难性遗忘，显著减少任务间损失障碍。

Abstract: Continual learning models suffer from catastrophic forgetting when trained sequentially on non-stationary data distributions. Previously, this has been addressed through weight regularization. While preconditioning gradients offer a promising alternative to mitigate forgetting, current approaches are myopic. Conversely, standard regularization methods apply rigid, scalar Euclidean penalties that entirely ignore the underlying Riemannian geometry of the parameter space. To overcome this gap, we propose TMLN (Trajectory-Modulatory Landscape Navigation), a normative navigation policy that formalizes continual learning as an optimal control problem over a curved loss landscape. TMLN utilizes a memory-efficient diagonal empirical Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) to define a localized Riemannian manifold. To compensate for the spatial limitations of the diagonal approximation, TMLN dynamically modulates a preconditioner using the normalized historical trajectory of the network's parameter values. By integrating this trajectory-based preconditioning directly into the gradient update, we actively shield historically critical parameter directions without relying on additive penalties. Empirical evaluations on class- and domain-incremental benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly reduces the loss barrier between consecutive tasks.

</details>


### [171] [CADENCE: A Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for Fast and Accurate Time Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35929)
*Onisa Mpaunda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CADENCE提出一种CPU原生的双专家架构，在精度接近SOTA元集成的同时保持极快的运行速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列分类存在精度与计算可扩展性之间的尖锐权衡：元集成方法（如HIVE-COTE 2.0）精度最高但计算量巨大，而超快随机卷积变换（如MiniRocket、Hydra）运行仅需数秒，但在相位无关分布、信号运动学以及大类数下的决策树碎片化问题上表现不佳。因此需要一种兼顾精度与效率的统一方案。

Method: CADENCE（置信自适应双专家网络）将表示学习解耦为两条专用路径：(i) 卷积线性专家，将10,000个确定性膨胀特征与闭式L2正则化Woodbury岭回归分类相结合；(ii) 分布区间专家，将竞争性膨胀核（Hydra）与跨信号运动学及FFT频谱带的二进Cornish-Fisher矩近似配对，并使用ExtraTrees集成拟合。内部验证元路由器带稀有类保留机制，动态选择纯专家路由或置信加权软融合，最后在100%训练数据上完整重拟合。

Result: 在全部109个等长UCR档案数据集、30次重采样（共3,270次运行）上评估，CADENCE取得总平均精度0.8864，在档案中排名第2，仅次于HIVE-COTE 2.0（0.8895，p_Holm=0.295，无统计显著差异），同时优于Hydra+MultiRocket（0.8818）、MultiRocket（0.8797）和HIVE-COTE 1.0（0.8786，p_Holm=0.048）。

Conclusion: CADENCE将相对HIVE-COTE 2.0的差距缩小至0.31个百分点，而平均每个数据集仅需17.53秒（双核CPU），实现了接近最先进精度的同时大幅降低计算成本。

Abstract: Time series classification (TSC) exhibits a sharp trade-off between accuracy and computational scalability. Meta-ensembles like HIVE-COTE 2.0 reach state-of-the-art accuracy but require extensive compute, whereas ultra-fast random convolutional transforms (e.g., MiniRocket, Hydra) run in seconds but struggle with phase-independent distributions, signal kinematics, and decision tree fragmentation on large class counts.
  In this work, we present CADENCE (Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for time series Classification Excellence), a unified, CPU-native dual-expert architecture. CADENCE decouples representation learning into two specialized pathways: (i) a Convolutional Linear Expert pairing 10,000 deterministic dilated features with closed-form L2-regularized Woodbury ridge classification, and (ii) a Distributional Interval Expert pairing competing dilated kernels (Hydra) with dyadic Cornish-Fisher moment approximations across signal kinematics and FFT spectral bands, fitted with an ExtraTrees ensemble. An internal validation meta-router with rare-class preservation dynamically selects between pure expert routing and confidence-weighted soft blending, followed by a full refit on 100% of training data.
  Evaluated across all 109 equal-length UCR Archive datasets over 30 resamples (3,270 total runs), CADENCE achieves a grand mean accuracy of 0.8864. This ranks #2 across the archive, surpassed only by HIVE-COTE 2.0 (0.8895, p_Holm = 0.295, no statistically significant difference), while outperforming Hydra+MultiRocket (0.8818), MultiRocket (0.8797), and HIVE-COTE 1.0 (0.8786, p_Holm = 0.048). CADENCE closes the gap to HIVE-COTE 2.0 to 0.31 percentage points while taking an average of only 17.53 seconds per dataset on a dual-core CPU. Source code and evaluation scripts: https://github.com/onisa-jr/CADENCE.git

</details>


### [172] [Graph neural networks for sampling-invariant embeddings of organized signal sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35934)
*Martin Bauw,Santiago Velasco-Forero,Jesus Angulo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究面向"organized signal sets"（有序/网格/图结构信号集合）的神经网络编码器，目标是将异构采样参数下的信号集合投影到固定维度向量空间，从而消除采样差异、支持任意拓扑感知处理，并以波形分离为任务评估其判别能力（实验仅用合成复值射频信号）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传感器网络与雷达产生的信号常以有组织集合形式出现（有序信号、网格内距离单元信号、图节点信号），且集合中各个信号的采样参数可能各不相同。这种"异构采样"会给后续处理带来约束，因此需要一个能消除采样差异的表示空间，使信号集合可以像普通向量一样被任意拓扑感知方法处理，而不受信号处理约束限制。

Method: 提出并研究用于"organized signal sets"的神经网络编码器，将异构采样的信号集合投影到一个任意固定大小的向量空间；在该表示空间中设计并评估表示的相关性，通过信号集合的判别潜力（聚焦波形分离）来衡量编码与嵌入的质量，实验基于合成的复值射频信号。

Result: 在设计的表示空间内，以波形分离为焦点评估了信号集合表示的判别潜力，并开展了编码与嵌入判别实验；实验全部基于合成复值射频信号，用于验证该编码器在削弱异构采样参数影响方面的效果。

Conclusion: 该工作提出了面向异构采样organized signal sets的神经网络编码思路，目标是构建一个消除采样差异的固定维向量表示空间，以支持无信号处理约束的任意拓扑感知处理；评估重点在于波形分离等判别能力，结论基于合成复值射频信号实验。

Abstract: Sensor networks and radars can deliver signals as organized sets, e.g. ordered signals, signals describing range cells within a grid or signals perceived as graph nodes. Within such sets, individual signals may be characterized by distinct sampling parameters. This paper investigates organized signal sets neural network encoders. In the context of this work, the purpose of such encoders is to project heterogeneously sampled signal sets into an arbitrary fixed-size vectors space. This new representation space is designed so that signal sets can be processed as vectors rid of sampling differences to allow for arbitrary topology-aware processing with no signal processing constraints. Within this representation space designed to reduce the influence of heterogeneous sampling parameters, the relevance of signal sets representations is evaluated by considering signal sets discrimination potential with a focus on waveforms separation. The encoding and embeddings discrimination experiments conducted rely exclusively on synthetic complex-valued radiofrequency signals.

</details>


### [173] [KernelOnet: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Kernel Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35938)
*Yuan Guo,Hanshu Chen,Qiang Xi,Timon Rabczuk,Zhuojia Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出可解释神经算子框架 KernelOnet，将核函数显式嵌入神经算子结构中，使其匹配边界型核展开方法的形式。通过数据驱动核、物理信息核与混合核三种互补核，在多个基准与浅水波导工程问题上取得高精度，参数更少、可无监督训练，推理成本远低于逐实例求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经算子（如 DeepONet）通过深层网络隐式学习基函数，缺乏可解释性，且难以处理无界外域声传播等问题；需要一种结构上显式对应核展开、可嵌入物理先验的神经算子。

Method: 提出 KernelOnet，用显式核函数替代 DeepONet 的 trunk 网络，包含三种互补核：(1) 数据驱动可学习核，由神经网络参数化从数据学习的径向基函数，对常系数线性问题可视为非奇异基本解；(2) 物理信息核，将解析基本解等物理信息嵌入网络结构，使展开自动满足控制方程，仅需边界条件监督、无需内部解数据；(3) 混合核，按控制方程线性主部分解为解析基本解张成的齐次部分与低秩学习修正核承载的源项部分，平衡物理先验与数据拟合。

Result: 在三个基准与一个浅水波导工程问题上，KernelOnet 达到高精度；在与 DeepONet 可比较的场景中，以更少可学习参数取得更高精度；无监督配置无需内部解标签；单次查询推理成本远低于逐实例求解器。

Conclusion: KernelOnet 为无界外域声传播等通用神经算子难以处理的问题提供了有效途径，兼具可解释性、物理一致性与计算效率。

Abstract: This paper proposes an interpretable neural operator framework, the Kernel Operator Network (KernelOnet), which incorporates kernel functions explicitly into the neural operator architecture, so that the operator structure matches the kernel-expansion form used in boundary-type kernel-expansion methods. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which learn basis functions implicitly through deep networks, KernelOnet replaces the trunk network with explicit kernels and offers three complementary kernels: a data-driven learnable kernel, in which a neural network parameterizes a radial basis function learned from data, and which for constant-coefficient linear problems can be regarded as a non-singular fundamental solution; a physics-informed kernel, which embeds physical information such as analytic fundamental solutions into the network structure, so that the expansion satisfies the governing equation automatically and can be trained without supervision on boundary conditions alone, with no interior solution data; and a hybrid kernel, which splits the solution, according to the linear principal part of the governing equation, into a homogeneous part spanned by analytic fundamental solutions and a source part carried by low-rank learned correction kernels, thereby balancing physical priors against data fitting on nonlinear problems lacking an analytic fundamental solution. On three benchmarks and one engineering problem in a shallow-water waveguide, KernelOnet attains high accuracy; where comparable with DeepONet, it is more accurate with fewer learnable parameters. Its unsupervised configuration needs no interior solution labels, and its per-query inference cost is far below that of per-instance solvers, offering an effective route to acoustic propagation in unbounded exterior domains that general-purpose neural operators struggle to handle.

</details>


### [174] [EnJoi: Ensemble Joint Score Filter for Generative Data Assimilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35944)
*Julien Moreau,Marc Lelarge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的数据同化算法，通过动态平衡当前状态置信度与新观测置信度，并学习包含过去与未来的联合状态分布，改进稀疏非均匀观测下的重建性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据同化旨在从部分观测中恢复动力系统的完整状态。现有的自回归扩散模型虽能生成与观测一致且物理自洽的轨迹，但仅以先前状态为条件进行训练，未考虑过去预测的不确定性，因而在观测稀疏或非均匀时性能受限。

Method: 提出一种新的基于扩散的同化算法，能够动态平衡对当前状态的置信度与对新观测的置信度；关键在于学习同时包含过去与未来的联合状态分布，并据此使用经典数据同化算法En4DVar的改进版本，该版本依赖粒子集合的协方差。

Result: 在流体与交通流模拟实验中，该方法取得了更优的重建性能，尤其在观测稀疏且非均匀的情况下提升明显。

Conclusion: 通过学习联合状态分布并结合改进的En4DVar，该方法有效解决了现有自回归扩散同化中忽略历史预测不确定性的问题，提升了困难观测条件下的重建效果。

Abstract: Data Assimilation (DA) aims to recover the full state of a dynamical system that is only partially observed. A solution is to use Score-based models to generate physically consistent trajectories that agree with the observations. These Autoregressive Diffusion models are trained by conditioning on the previous state; however, they do not take into account the uncertainty of their past predictions. We propose a new diffusion-based assimilation algorithm that dynamically balances the confidence in the current state and the new observations. Crucially, we choose to learn the distribution of the joint state containing both the past and future. This allows us to use a modified version of En4DVar, a classical DA algorithm that relies on the covariance of an ensemble of particles. Experiments on fluid and traffic flow simulations show improved reconstruction performance, especially in situations where observations are sparse and non-homogeneous.

</details>


### [175] [FluxLite: Inference-Time Proposal Control for Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35947)
*Yinuo Ren,Haoxuan Chen,Grant M. Rotskoff,Jiequn Han,Lexing Ying*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FluxLite：一种免训练、轻量的离散扩散提议控制框架，通过在预训练反向速率的稀疏图上扰动跳率并用图散度项精确补偿，使Feynman-Kac SMC的权重退化问题得到缓解，显著提升采样精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型与扩散语言模型的许多推理任务等价于从预训练分布的倾斜分布中采样。Feynman-Kac SMC理论上可精确校正，但提议动态与倾斜不匹配时权重退化，增加粒子数也难有实际收益。因此需要一种能控制提议、降低重加权方差的方法。

Method: 在预训练反向速率的稀疏有向图上，任何稀疏跳率扰动都可通过Feynman-Kac势中的q_t加权图散度项精确补偿，从而保持目标路径不变，并将残余重加权方差化为局部凸目标。据此提出两种采样器：单跳局部重分配规则HEU，以及在预训练速率基上的小型非负二次规划D-VCG。还证明了在标准score-entropy训练损失下的总体稳定性，识别出控制对score误差鲁棒性的倾斜路径覆盖因子，并给出固定受控Feynman-Kac递推的有限粒子收敛性。

Result: 在可解析的有限状态CTMC基准上，相比标准Feynman-Kac SMC基线，终端KL最高改进了两个数量级；在2D Ising采样上，行相关MSE的几何平均降低5-7倍，峰值降低最多55倍。

Conclusion: FluxLite为离散扩散模型提供了一种免训练的提议控制机制，通过精确补偿跳率扰动来缓解SMC权重退化，兼有理论保证与实证收益，可提升推理时倾斜采样任务的效率与精度。

Abstract: Many inference-time tasks for pretrained discrete diffusion models and diffusion language models reduce to drawing samples from a tilted version of the pretrained distribution. Feynman-Kac sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) makes this correction exact in principle, but its prescribed weights routinely degenerate when the proposal dynamics are misaligned with the tilt, capping the practical gains from additional particles. We introduce FluxLite, a lightweight, training-free proposal-control framework for discrete diffusion. On the sparse directed graph of pretrained reverse rates, any sparse jump-rate perturbation can be exactly compensated by a $q_t$-weighted graph-divergence term in the Feynman-Kac potential; the target path is therefore preserved while the residual reweighting variance becomes a local convex objective. We instantiate this principle as two practical samplers: a one-hop local reallocation rule (HEU) and a small nonnegative quadratic program over pretrained-rate bases (D-VCG). We further prove population stability under the standard score-entropy training loss, identifying a tilted-path coverage factor that governs robustness to score error, together with finite-particle convergence for a fixed controlled Feynman-Kac recursion. Empirically, FluxLite improves over standard Feynman-Kac SMC baselines by up to two orders of magnitude in terminal KL on an analytically tractable finite-state CTMC benchmark, and reduces row-correlation MSE on 2D Ising sampling by 5-7x in geometric mean and up to 55x at peak.

</details>


### [176] [Intrinsic Associative Memory on Riemannian Manifolds: Curvature, Capacity, and Emergent Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35948)
*Krishnakumar Balasubramanian,Zhaoyang Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将联想记忆建模为黎曼流形上的Epanechnikov核密度模态搜索，证明曲率决定记忆的保持与创生，并给出容量标度与一步召回机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何不仅约束联想记忆，还决定其记住什么、创造哪些状态；作者希望把曲率从数据的被动属性变为联想记忆的主动设计变量。

Method: 在黎曼流形上构建内在稠密联想记忆，将记忆视为Epanechnikov核密度模态搜索；对比测地能量与体积校正能量，并利用Ricci曲率阈值分析；推导容量标度，研究重叠如何创生新模式，并用黎曼均值漂移实现一步召回。

Result: 测地记忆总能保留孤立模式；校正记忆服从Ricci曲率阈值：正曲率在高维可抹除记忆，负曲率则强化记忆。保持全部模式的容量标度为q_β^{-1/2}，典型模式为q_β^{-1}。设计的N模式配置可实现全部2^N-1个子集模态，而随机数据在存储阈值下仅得泊松数量。仿真验证了曲率转变与所有设计模态；在WordNet名词层级上体积校正改善了低容量检索。

Conclusion: 曲率是联想记忆的设计变量，而不仅是数据的属性。

Abstract: Geometry does more than constrain an associative memory: curvature determines what it remembers and which states it creates. We develop intrinsic dense associative memories on Riemannian manifolds by casting memory as Epanechnikov kernel-density mode seeking. We compare geodesic and volume-corrected energies and show that curvature separates their behavior. We prove that geodesic memory always retains an isolated pattern, while corrected memory obeys a sharp Ricci-curvature threshold: positive curvature can erase memories in high dimensions, while negative curvature reinforces them. We derive geodesic capacity scalings of $q_β^{-1/2}$ for retaining every pattern and $q_β^{-1}$ for a typical one, where $q_β$ is the pairwise kernel-overlap probability. We show how overlap \emph{creates} novel memories: designed $N$-pattern configurations realize all $2^N-1$ subset modes, but random data at the storage threshold yield only a Poisson number. We establish exact one-step recall using Riemannian mean shift. In simulations, we recover the predicted curvature transition and every designed mode. On WordNet's full noun hierarchy, we demonstrate that volume correction improves low-capacity retrieval. Together, our work shows that curvature is a design variable for associative memory, not merely a property of the data.

</details>


### [177] [ROSS: Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35954)
*Zhiwei Zhang,Huayu Deng,Fei Zhao,Jiayan Fu,Bin Liang,Kam-Fai Wong,Mu Chuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ROSS方法，通过选择性监督从历史自生成轨迹中离线学习，无需额外采样即可提升模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型后训练产生的自生成轨迹在策略更新后常被视为过时数据而被丢弃，但历史轨迹可能仍与当前策略兼容且保留有用行为，同时也含错误与冗余动作，因此需要细粒度的选择性监督。

Method: ROSS保留完整历史轨迹作为上下文，仅对选定的模型生成续写部分计算损失，从而在离线SFT中复用自生成轨迹进行选择性监督学习。

Result: 在领域特定强化学习、多教师在线策略蒸馏和智能体强化学习三类场景中，ROSS持续提升上游检查点，并在数学、代码生成、指令遵循、软件工程任务上优于基线；在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上六基准MOPD平均分从58.40%升至62.20%，SWE-bench Verified从64.20%升至68.40%。

Conclusion: 自轨迹训练可留下可复用的行为经验，通过离线SFT即可进一步获得性能增益，且无需额外策略采样。

Abstract: Large language model post-training generates self-generated rollouts through reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation, yet this experience is often treated as stale once the policy advances. Historical rollouts can remain compatible with a later policy while preserving behaviors that the policy no longer expresses reliably. However, they may also contain mistakes, abandoned attempts, and redundant actions that should not be imitated, motivating finer-grained selective supervision. We introduce ROSS (Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision), which preserves the full historical trajectory as context while applying loss only to selected model-generated continuations. Across domain-specific reinforcement learning, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning, ROSS consistently improves upstream checkpoints and outperforms baselines across mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and software engineering. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, ROSS improves the six-benchmark MOPD average from 58.40% to 62.20% and SWE-bench Verified from 64.20% to 68.40%. These results show that self-rollout training leaves behind reusable behavioral experience that can yield further gains through offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT), without additional policy rollouts.

</details>


### [178] [Making Cross-Continental Federated Learning Repeatable with FLIP: a Multi-Application Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36001)
*Rafael Garcia-Dias,Alexandre Triay Bagur,Chayanin Tangwiriyasakul,Virginia Fernandez,Parhom Esmaeili,Piyalitt Ittichaiwong,Yang Li,Lawrence Adams,Wason Buncharoen,Martin Chapman,Benjamaporn Chayanond,Sadthavud Chunrod,Tanawat Fongsri,Kass Gibson,Supat Plungprasertkul,Supawit Tangpanithandee,Kanyakorn Veerakanjana,Vicky Goh,Michela Antonelli,Joe Zhang,Kongkiat Kespechara,Sebastien Ourselin,M. Jorge Cardoso*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出开源多应用联邦学习平台FLIP，通过可组合服务实现可重复的联邦训练与评估，并在英国与泰国的双节点合成胸片队列上验证了两个用例，强调其运维层面的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗领域的联邦学习面临治理难题：每次合作都需重建治理保障机制，高昂开销使多数项目止步于概念验证阶段。

Method: FLIP将常见联邦学习流程实现为一组可组合服务：针对各站点结构化数据库的队列查询、从机构PACS按需检索DICOM、各站点项目审批以及可复用的联邦学习任务类型。作者在两个客户端节点（英国、泰国）的合成胸片队列上运行了联邦微调与联邦评估两个用例，各机构独立审批参与并依据本地IT安全流程运营自身节点。

Result: 平台支持国际联邦学习协作，并提升了可重复性、可审计性与站点特定的治理能力；同时提供了对现有平台的全面比较，帮助研究者与运营者选择合适平台。

Conclusion: 本研究做出的是运维层面而非算法层面的论断，未比较联邦与集中式训练，该问题应参考现有系统综述与元分析；核心贡献在于证明此类平台可实现国际联邦学习协作并改善可重复性、可审计性与治理。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) in healthcare remains challenging, as the overhead of rebuilding governance guarantees for every collaboration stops most projects at the proof-of-concept stage. Here we present FLIP (Federated Learning Interoperability Platform), an open-source, multi-application platform that makes FL training and evaluation repeatable. FLIP implements common FL workflows as a set of composable services: cohort queries against per-site structured databases, on-demand DICOM retrieval from institutional PACS, per-site project approval, and reusable FL job types. To demonstrate FLIP, we ran two distinct use cases, federated fine-tuning and federated evaluation, on synthetic chest X-ray cohorts across two client nodes based in the United Kingdom (UK) and Thailand. In FLIP, each institution independently approves its participation in each project and operates its own node under local IT security processes. This study makes an operational rather than an algorithmic claim. It does not compare federated with centralised training; for that question, we refer the reader to existing systematic reviews and meta-analyses. The central result is evidence that such platforms enable international FL collaboration and improve repeatability, auditability, and site-specific governance. We also present a comprehensive comparison of existing platforms to help researchers and operators choose the right platform for their use case.

</details>


### [179] [Preferent Compression Bounds Are Tight](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36030)
*Dario Paccagnan,Marius Tirlea*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了偏好压缩（preferent compression）最新界是可紧的（tight），通过基于均匀分布与顺序统计量的显式构造在极限下达到该界，并给出了更简短初等的证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代学习方法的部署瓶颈在于缺乏严格的安全与性能证书。样本压缩是推导此类证书的有力工具，对满足偏好性质（即学习理论中的稳定性）的算法尤其能给出尖锐界，并应用于Scenario Approach、Pick-to-Learn、支持向量方法等领域。但这些界的紧性一直是未决问题，本文旨在解决该问题。

Method: 通过构造一个基于均匀分布和顺序统计量的显式例子，证明其可在极限下达到偏好压缩的最新界；同时给出仅依赖初等计数论证、无需无穷维对偶性的更简短且更易理解的证明。

Result: 证明了偏好压缩的最先进界是可证紧的（provably tight），所给显式构造在极限下达到该界。

Conclusion: 偏好压缩的界紧性问题得到肯定解决，并提供了更简洁的证明方式，有助于证书的推导与应用。

Abstract: The lack of rigorous safety and performance certificates remains a key bottleneck to the deployment of modern learning-based methods. Sample compression has recently emerged as a powerful tool for deriving such certificates, with particularly sharp bounds available for algorithms satisfying a so-called preference property -- also known as stability in the learning theory literature. These bounds find direct application across domains as different as the Scenario Approach, Pick-to-Learn, and Support Vector methods. However, whether they are tight has remained an open problem. In this paper we resolve this question affirmatively and show that the state-of-the-art bound for preferent compressions is provably tight. We establish this by exhibiting an explicit construction based on the uniform distribution and order statistics that attains the bound in the limit. Along the way, we also provide a considerably shorter and more accessible proof of this bound, requiring only elementary counting arguments and no infinite-dimensional duality.

</details>


### [180] [TORQUE: Optimizing What (not) to Quantize Before and After Rotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36032)
*Ran Ben Basat,Michael Mitzenmacher,Shay Vargaftik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TORQUE 框架，在固定比特预算下联合优化旋转前与旋转后保留的高精度坐标数量与位置，以提升量化精度与存储效率的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 均匀随机旋转是量化的有效预处理，可使归一化坐标分布近似高斯，从而使用离线优化码本。但已有使用随机旋转的量化方法未联合优化旋转前后应保留哪些坐标及其数量，存在改进空间。

Method: TORQUE 在固定总体期望比特预算下，联合优化旋转前后以高精度保留的坐标数量与选择。推导量化误差上界，并证明对每个 k，旋转前保留 top-k 坐标可最小化该上界，从而将坐标子集搜索简化为对 k 的优化；采用离线码本与并行参数选择实现快速优化器。

Result: 在固定比特预算下，TORQUE 在重构精度与存储成本之间取得更优的权衡。通过高斯模型下的数值评估，以及最近邻检索、KV-cache 压缩和激活压缩实验验证了效果。

Conclusion: 联合优化旋转前后高精度保留坐标可在有限比特预算下显著改善量化误差与存储成本的权衡，理论分析与多任务实验均支持该方法的有效性。

Abstract: Uniform random rotations are an effective preprocessing step for quantization: they make normalized coordinate distributions approximately Gaussian, enabling the use of codebooks optimized offline. We introduce TORQUE, a framework that improves on previous quantization works that use random rotations by jointly optimizing how many and which coordinates to preserve at high precision both before and after rotation, under a fixed overall expected bit budget.
  Intuitively, before rotation, preserving large input coordinates at high precision can reduce overall error by preventing the rotation from spreading their values across many coordinates. Likewise, after rotation, preserving a small fraction of the largest-magnitude coordinates at high precision allows the remaining values to be quantized more accurately using codebooks optimized offline for the resulting truncated Gaussian distribution.
  We derive a quantization error upper bound and prove that top-$k$ pre-rotation retention minimizes it for each $k$. This reduces the search over coordinate subsets to an optimization over $k$, enabling a fast optimizer that uses offline codebooks and parallel parameter selection for practical implementation. We demonstrate an improved tradeoff between reconstruction accuracy and storage cost through numerical evaluation under the Gaussian model and experiments on nearest-neighbor retrieval, KV-cache compression, and activation compression.

</details>


### [181] [Neural networks for spectral optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36047)
*Alexis de Villeroché,Beniamin Bogosel,Stéphane Breuils,Dorin Bucur,Jacques-Olivier Lachaud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出两种神经网络代理模型，直接从域几何预测微分算子谱，用于谱相关的形状优化，精度达0.2%~1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接使用PDE求解器进行谱优化计算成本高昂，需要高效的、可微的谱预测代理模型来加速优化。

Method: 模型一：用傅里叶系数编码域配合轻量MLP，对星形几何高效；通过系数重缩放满足特征值缩放律，对旋转和反射输出取平均实现不变性。模型二：输入landscape函数、指示函数及其梯度，经Gram-Schmidt过程输出正交特征函数及对应特征值。

Result: 傅里叶模型精度0.2%；landscape模型前十个特征值平均相对误差1%，优于FNO的4%；用SDF替换landscape使预测和优化误差变差。模型可从合成形状泛化到经典图像数据集，并能恢复经典谱最优解（如一特征值的圆盘、高阶特征值的猜想极小值）。

Conclusion: 所提模型能提供准确、可微的特征值估计，可有效用于涉及谱量的形状优化问题。

Abstract: Given a functional dependent on the spectrum of a differential operator, we address the problem of finding a domain which optimizes this functional. PDE solvers might be used to tackle this optimization. It is however computationally expensive. We propose two neural network models which learn the spectrum directly from the geometry of the domain and can be used to optimize the domain from one or more eigenvalues. We investigate two representations. The first encodes the domain through Fourier coefficients and a light MLP, which is efficient on star-shaped geometries, achieving a precision of 0.2\%. Through a rescaling of the coefficients the designed models satisfy the scaling law of the eigenvalues. Additionally, averaging the outputs of the trained surrogates over rotations and reflections induces invariance for these transformations. The second is a model that takes the landscape function, the indicator function and the gradient of the landscape function. A Gram-Schmidt process produces orthogonal eigenfunctions as output of the model along with the associated eigenvalues. The landscape model reaches 1\% mean relative error on the first ten eigenvalues, compared with 4\% for an FNO model. Replacing the landscape by an SDF worsened both prediction and optimization errors. The trained model also generalizes from synthetic shapes to domains given as classical image dataset. The resulting surrogates of both approaches recover classical spectral optima such as the disk for the first eigenvalue or the conjectured minima of higher eigenvalues. This confirms that our models produce accurate differentiable estimates of eigenvalues, which can be used in shape optimization problems involving spectral quantities.

</details>


### [182] [Improving scalable oversight with co-trained monitors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36049)
*Joseph H. Rudoler,Kevin Tan,Benedict Tessler,Timothy Kong,Enric Boix Adserà*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究AI监督中worker-monitor框架下worker通过训练逃避固定monitor的问题，探索通过协同训练monitor来避免此失效模式，涵盖监督学习与自监督两种方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: worker-monitor是一种有前景的AI监督方法，但针对固定monitor训练worker会激励其逃避监督。论文探究协同训练monitor能否避免这一失效模式。

Method: 监督设置下，证明monitor可行的刻画条件：当可能monitor函数类具有有限Littlestone维度时，可实现误差与查询率趋零的监督。自监督下提出基于测试时蒸馏的协同训练：monitor利用额外测试时算力生成训练标签，再在其标准算力策略上训练。针对多数投票标签，在带动作覆盖的自适应worker分布下给出有限样本锐化保证。

Result: 理论证明：监督监控可行当且仅当monitor函数类Littlestone维度有限，将其与对抗在线学习文献相联系。多数投票标签下保证monitor判决收敛到其初始众数判决。在代码安全环境中压力测试：自适应monitor更能跟上演化的worker策略，固定monitor更易被逃避。

Conclusion: 协同训练的自适应monitor在应对worker不断演化的策略上优于固定monitor，固定monitor更易受逃避影响。

Abstract: Worker-monitor setups are a promising approach to AI oversight, but training workers against fixed monitors can incentivize monitor evasion. We study whether this failure mode can be avoided by co-training the monitor alongside the worker, and explore both supervised and self-supervised approaches. In the supervised setting, we prove a characterization: monitoring is possible with vanishing error and query rates exactly when the class of possible monitor functions has finite Littlestone dimension. This connects worker monitoring with an established literature on adversarial online learning. For self-supervision, we propose a co-training procedure based on test-time distillation: the monitor uses additional test-time compute to generate training labels, then trains its standard-compute policy on those labels. For majority-vote labels, we give a finite-sample sharpening guarantee under adaptive worker distributions with action coverage, that shows that the monitor's verdicts converge to its initial modal verdicts. We stress-test the former in code-security settings where the worker is trained adversarially to fool the monitor. Our results suggest that adaptive monitors are better at keeping pace with evolving worker strategies, while fixed monitors are more vulnerable to evasion.

</details>


### [183] [ABC: Advantage-Based Control Variates for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36058)
*Hsiao-Ru Pan,Florent Draye,Bernhard Schölkopf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC)，通过 advantage-value 形式重新审视轨迹级控制变量，并将其与 Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE) 结合为一种 actor-critic 算法，在离线到在线的 RLVR 设定中取得与 GRPO 相当的性能且在线优化步骤大幅减少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 中无 critic 的策略梯度方法（如 GRPO）表现优异，而 actor-critic 方法因价值函数近似误差（如时序差分误差带来的偏差）而不受青睐。作者希望重新审视轨迹级控制变量，探索能否在保留 critic 优势的同时减少偏差。

Method: 提出 advantage-value 形式的 Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC)，揭示其协方差结构与 Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE) 中回报分解的关系；将 ABC 与 DAE 结合为单一 actor-critic 算法，在离线到在线 RLVR 设定中：critic 先在已收集轨迹上训练，再在在线学习中自适应。

Result: 在数学推理任务上，ABC 使用显著更少的在线优化步骤即可达到与 GRPO 相当的性能。

Conclusion: 轨迹级控制变量的 advantage-value 形式为 actor-critic 方法提供了新的理论视角，ABC 与 DAE 的结合在 RLVR 中展示了 critic 方法的可行性，能以更低在线成本匹配主流无 critic 方法的性能。

Abstract: Recent progress in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has highlighted the effectiveness of simple critic-free policy-gradient methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). In contrast, actor-critic methods rely on learned value functions whose approximation error can introduce bias through commonly used advantage estimators such as temporal-difference error. Motivated by this observation, we revisit trajectory-level control variates through an advantage-value formulation, which we call Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC). This formulation reveals that the covariance structure is closely related to the return decomposition used in Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE). Finally, we combine ABC with DAE into a single actor-critic algorithm and evaluate it in an offline-to-online RLVR setting, where the critic is first trained on previously collected trajectories and adapted during online learning. On mathematical reasoning tasks, ABC achieves performance competitive with GRPO using substantially fewer online optimization steps.

</details>


### [184] [Introducing the CZAR Loss: A Tailored Objective Function for Financial Log-Return Predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36061)
*Joel Pfeffer,J. M. Diederik Kruijssen,Florian Stecker,Steven N. Longmore*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对金融收益预测中对称损失与经济学目标错配的问题，提出CZAR分段二次损失函数，证明其凸性并给出闭式梯度/Hessian，实验显示其能降低零收益偏差并提升大幅收益方向准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融对数收益的条件均值接近零，导致均方误差、平均绝对误差等对称损失下，常数零预测近乎最优，从而在训练中使预测向零收缩，在评估中让平凡预测器占据排名优势，惩罚了具有真实但含噪方向预测能力的模型。

Method: 在高斯线性预测模型下，证明所有对称单调损失对零预测器存在统一的盈亏平衡方向准确率，且随预测噪声接近收益标准差而急剧上升。据此提出CZAR损失，基于五项要求构建分段二次损失：对预测凸、非对称性随真实收益方向且在零处消失、对低估和方向错误近似线性惩罚、大误差时发散、评估时具自适应损失下限。

Result: CZAR在固定真值下对预测可证凸，具闭式梯度与Hessian，适用于梯度提升库的自定义目标，四个超参数通过相关默认值简化为单一选择。理想测试中，CZAR评估下超越零预测器所需最低方向准确率接近50%随机水平，而对称损失阈值随噪声急剧上升，且在重尾收益分布下优势仍保持。LightGBM日内BTC对数收益实验中，CZAR训练模型降低零收益偏差并提升大幅收益的方向准确率。

Conclusion: CZAR通过非对称分段二次设计解决了对称损失与收益预测经济目标的错配，在理论与实验上均显示出更稳健的方向预测评估与训练优势。

Abstract: In quantitative finance, standard regression losses are misaligned with the economics of return prediction. As the conditional mean of financial log-returns is close to zero, symmetric losses such as the mean squared and mean absolute errors make the constant zero forecast a near-optimal solution, penalizing models with genuine but noisy directional skill. This applies both during training, where predictions shrink toward zero, and during evaluation, where trivial forecasters can lead loss-based rankings. Under a Gaussian linear prediction model, we show that all symmetric monotonic losses share a universal breakeven directional accuracy against the zero predictor, which rises sharply and becomes unobtainable as the prediction noise approaches the standard deviation of the returns. We introduce the CZAR (Composite Zero-Agnostic Return) loss function, a piecewise quadratic loss built around five key requirements: convexity in the prediction, asymmetry with true return direction that vanishes at zero, near-linear penalization of undershoots and wrong-direction predictions, divergence for large errors, and an adaptive loss floor for evaluation. CZAR is provably convex in the prediction at fixed true value, has closed-form gradient and Hessian suitable for custom objectives in gradient-boosted libraries, and its four hyperparameters reduce to a single choice through correlated defaults. In idealized tests, the minimum directional accuracy required for a CZAR-evaluated forecaster to outperform the zero predictor under mean log loss remains near the 50% chance level, whereas the corresponding threshold for symmetric losses rises sharply with prediction noise. This advantage persists under heavy-tailed return distributions. In a LightGBM experiment on intraday BTC log-returns, CZAR-trained models reduce the `zero-returns bias' and improve directional accuracy on large-magnitude returns.

</details>


### [185] [Understanding Decision-Making Mechanisms in Neural Routing Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36063)
*Fatemeh Askari,Mazdak Teymourian,Mohammad Izadi,Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对三种代表性自回归NCO模型（AM、POMO、LEHD）进行行为分析、表示探测与因果干预，揭示其决策机制差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经组合优化（NCO）虽取得实证成功，但其模型决策的内部机制尚不明确，缺乏可解释性分析。

Method: 针对两种编码器-解码器配置下的三个代表模型（AM、POMO为重型编码器-轻型解码器；LEHD为轻型编码器-重型解码器），采用行为分析、表示探测和因果干预三类方法，并在TSP和CVRP上进行验证。

Result: AM和POMO在整个解构建过程中主要遵循持续的几何模式；LEHD则包含关于多个未来动作的线性可及信息，且因果实验支持未来节点表示在其决策中的作用。LEHD强依赖当前节点表示进行即时局部决策，起始节点表示对后续路径起更广泛的导航作用。跨实例对齐分析表明LEHD将当前节点表示映射到相对共享的潜在区域，为评估后续决策提供稳定参考。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了架构不同的求解器具有各自独特的决策模式，为NCO求解器更可解释的分析奠定了基础，并提供了代码与可视化。

Abstract: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) has achieved strong empirical success, yet the internal mechanisms driving model decisions remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate three representative autoregressive NCO models spanning two encoder-decoder configurations: AM and POMO (heavy-encoder, light-decoder), and LEHD (light-encoder, heavy-decoder). Through behavioral analyses, representation probing, and causal interventions, we examine how these models construct solutions and use internal representations during decoding. Our results suggest that AM and POMO predominantly follow a persistent geometric pattern throughout solution construction, whereas LEHD contains linearly accessible information about multiple future actions. Causal experiments further provide evidence for the role of future-node representations in LEHD's decision-making. We also observe that LEHD relies strongly on the current-node representation for immediate local decisions, while the start-node representation plays a broader navigational role over the subsequent route. Cross-instance alignment analyses additionally indicate that LEHD maps current-node representations into a relatively shared latent region, which may provide a stable reference for evaluating subsequent decisions. Across the Traveling Salesman Problem and the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem, these results reveal distinct decision-making patterns across these architecturally distinct solvers and provide a foundation for more interpretable analyses of NCO solvers. Code and additional visualizations are provided in the https://github.com/NCO-Interpretability/NCO-Interpretability.

</details>


### [186] [FLOORA: A Human-Aligned Domain-Specific Language Model for Architectural Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36064)
*Sahand Rezaei-Shoshtari,Patryk Wozniczka,Shu Ishida,Gregg Streuber,Farnoosh Javadi,Jeffrey Landes,Angela Ju,Muhammad Azam,Bryan Lim,Johan Luttun,Indrajeet Haldar,Jonathan Shaw,Beatriz Guerra,Ivan Sosnovik,James Stoddart,Robert Giaquinto,Adam Gaier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FLOORA，一系列面向建筑布局生成的小型领域专用语言(DSL)模型；通过专门数据与对齐，0.6B模型在真实与合成建筑上超越大型前沿模型，VLM评判胜率达92.0%–96.0%，人工评估89.3%选其为最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用基础模型虽是强大生成器，但在需要结构化表示的工程领域中表现不佳，建筑布局等任务需要结构化的、可验证的输出，因此需要领域专用的小模型与训练配方。

Method: FLOORA结合了token高效的DSL、定制分词、领域专用预训练、监督微调(SFT)，以及带有人类偏好学习奖励与可验证奖励的强化学习(RL)进行对齐。

Result: 0.6B的FLOORA在分布外真实建筑上VLM评判胜率最高达92.0%，合成建筑上达96.0%；人工评估中89.3%的评测将其选为最佳模型；消融与大量实证评估验证了其在建筑与几何有效性上的提升。

Conclusion: 尽管聚焦建筑领域，该结果表明类似的领域专用配方可能适用于其他具有结构化、可验证输出的工程领域；数据集、模型与推理代码已开源。

Abstract: Foundation models are powerful generators, but many engineering domains require structured representations that general-purpose systems handle poorly. We introduce FLOORA (Floor Layout Optimization with RL Alignment), a family of small domain-specific language (DSL) models for architectural layout generation. With specialized data and alignment, our 0.6B model outperforms much larger frontier models, achieving VLM judge win rates up to 92.0% on out-of-distribution real-world buildings and 96.0% on synthetic buildings. Human evaluations further corroborate these results, with FLOORA selected as the best model in 89.3% of evaluations. FLOORA combines a token-efficient DSL, custom tokenization, domain-specific pretraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL) with learned human-preference and verifiable rewards. This pipeline improves architectural and geometric validity, supported by extensive empirical evaluation and ablation studies. Although focused on architecture, our results suggest that similar domain-specific recipes may be useful in other engineering domains with structured, verifiable outputs. Datasets, models, and inference code are available at https://github.com/AutodeskAILab/floora.

</details>


### [187] [GEM-KMeans: Memory-Efficient and Accurate Clustering on Massive Scale with GPU Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36074)
*Peng Xu,Nihar Koganti,Volodymyr Kindratenko,Xiaohui Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GEM-KMeans，通过谱归一化且数学等价的NLR公式，将多种操作融合进矩阵乘法尾处理，显著降低GPU显存占用并保持聚类精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模数据聚类需要在内存效率与统计精度之间取得平衡。非负低秩矩阵分解用于K-means具有可扩展性和最优精确恢复保证，但其GPU直接实现需要多个大尺寸因子缓冲区及大量数据搬运，受内存带宽限制。

Method: 提出GEM-KMeans，一种谱归一化但数学等价的NLR公式，将梯度更新、非负投影以及归一化和迭代移动所需的充分统计量融合进矩阵乘法的尾处理（epilogue）。采用IO感知的GPU实现，在HBM中仅物化单个因子及少量tile归约数组，而非保留三个大因子数组，并推导了显式内存开销与谱归一化平滑性界。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集的大规模场景下实现了准确聚类，性能相对现有GPU加速Lloyd算法呈现依赖运行时间的权衡。

Conclusion: GEM-KMeans通过融合计算与精简存储，在保证统计精度的同时提升大规模聚类在GPU上的内存效率。

Abstract: Memory-efficient scaling on clustering problems without sacrificing statistical accuracy is of central interest for large-scale data analysis and machine learning problems. Nonnegative low-rank (NLR) matrix factorization for $K$-means is a scalable clustering method, which connects to semidefinite relaxations with optimal average-case exact recovery guarantees. However, a direct GPU implementation of NLR requires multiple large factor-sized buffers and substantial data movements that are essentially memory-bound. In this paper, we introduce GEM-KMeans, a spectrally normalized yet mathematically equivalent NLR formulation that fuses the gradient update, nonnegative projection, and sufficient statistics for normalization and iterate movement into a matrix-multiplication epilogue. Instead of retaining three massive factor-sized arrays, our IO-aware GPU implementation materializes only one single factor with small tile-reduction arrays as additional storage in the High Bandwidth Memory (HBM). We derive explicit memory costs and spectrally normalized smoothness bounds for optimizing the clustering objective function. Accurate clustering is demonstrated at massive scales on synthetic and real datasets, where performance gains of GEM-KMeans over existing GPU-accelerated Lloyd's algorithms involve data-dependent runtime tradeoffs.

</details>


### [188] [Early Learning Shapes Later Directions Of Representation Change In Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36081)
*Yuantao Deng,Jinnuo Liu,Kaizhen Tan,Yuchen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 早期表征漂移形成的低维子空间（"脚手架"）会被网络在后续任务中持续复用，且这种复用依赖学习历史。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表征会随网络学习新任务而不断变化，作者希望探究早期表征变化是否自然形成一种几何结构，并持续影响后续学习。

Method: 在四种预训练视觉编码器和两个数据集上，识别早期表征漂移的低维子空间（称为 scaffold），并检验其是否在后续任务中被复用；比较其与随机匹配子空间的差异，并考察历史依赖性及优化器单步更新中的表现。

Result: 后续表征变化一致地偏好该早期子空间而非随机替代；复用具有历史依赖性，不同早期任务的网络各自偏好自身历史诱导的 scaffold；该偏好在优化器单步更新中同样出现，尽管网络主导的局部响应方向已偏离原 scaffold；将运动约束在 scaffold 内比随机约束更明显地减慢新任务学习，但对旧任务保持的影响不一致。

Conclusion: 早期经验会在神经网络如何适应未来任务方面留下持久的几何印记。

Abstract: Representations continually change as a network learns new tasks. We ask whether early representational changes naturally form a geometric structure that continues to shape later learning. We identify a low-dimensional subspace of early representation drift, which we call a scaffold, and test whether it is reused across subsequent tasks. Across four pretrained visual encoders and two datasets, later representational changes consistently favor this early-defined subspace over matched random alternatives. This reuse is history-dependent: when networks experience different early tasks but identical later training inputs, each network preferentially reuses the scaffold induced by its own learning history. The same preference appears in individual optimizer updates, even though the network's dominant local response directions shift away from the original scaffold. Finally, constraining motion within the scaffold slows new-task acquisition more than matched random constraints, while effects on old-task retention are less consistent. In summary, these results suggest that early experience leaves a persistent geometric imprint on how neural networks adapt to future tasks.

</details>


### [189] [PHASE: A Physiology-Guided Hierarchical Foundation Model for Intracranial EEG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36087)
*Yipeng Zhang,Chenda Duan,Yuanyi Ding,Tianyi Wang,Atsuro Daida,Masaki Izumi,Yuta Tanoue,Naoto Kuroda,Shaun A. Hussain,Nishant Sinha,Eishi Asano. Hiroki Nariai,Vwani Roychowdhury*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PHASE是一种生理学引导的iEEG基础模型，通过将临床可识别的生理特征显式作为学习目标，结合时域和时空两阶段掩码潜在预测，在Omni-iEEG五项临床任务上刷新了最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有iEEG基础模型主要依靠重建或预测输入来学习，导致重要生理特征只是隐式保留；评估也多局限于认知解码和癫痫检测等窄任务，且在Omni-iEEG这类临床基准上冻结使用时不如任务专用模型。

Method: 提出PHASE，将生理特征显式设为学习目标，并与掩码潜在预测结合：时域阶段PHASE-T在单通道内建模，时空阶段PHASE-ST在同步通道间建模；在9个临床站点、222名参与者的异质记录上预训练。

Result: 在Omni-iEEG全部五项临床任务上，冻结PHASE-T比所有对比基础模型最高提升31%，微调后超越任务专用模型；PHASE-T优于仅潜在预测或辅助波形重建的变体，并能泛化到未见机构；PHASE-ST在癫痫起始区识别上优于PHASE-T，冻结时在BrainTreebank上的音量和音高解码也超过已发表模型。

Conclusion: PHASE能学习并封装临床医生所识别的生理特征，包括癫痫起始及传播、解剖区域身份等，尽管其预训练数据不含癫痫发作记录和解剖标签，显示出显式生理监督的有效性和可迁移性。

Abstract: Clinicians and neuroscientists have long analyzed intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) through directly measurable physiological characteristics, which carry much of the information that downstream tasks depend on. Recent iEEG foundation models learn by reconstructing or predicting their inputs, which leaves the retention of these characteristics implicit. They are also evaluated mainly on cognitive decoding and a narrow clinical task, i.e., seizure detection. On a broad, clinically relevant benchmark such as Omni-iEEG, they remain below task-specific models when used frozen. We introduce PHASE, a physiology-guided foundation model that makes these characteristics explicit learning targets, pairing them with masked latent prediction in a temporal stage (PHASE-T) within each channel and a spatiotemporal stage (PHASE-ST) across synchronized channels. PHASE is pretrained on heterogeneous recordings from 222 participants at nine clinical sites. On all five Omni-iEEG clinical tasks, frozen PHASE-T outperforms every evaluated foundation model by up to 31\%, and fine-tuned PHASE-T surpasses the task-specific models, setting a new state of the art. PHASE-T benefits from physiological supervision, outperforming variants trained with latent prediction alone or auxiliary waveform reconstruction on every task in matched ablations. PHASE-T generalizes to unseen institutions, outperforming the compared models with few or no local labels. PHASE-ST further improves seizure-onset-zone identification over PHASE-T and, when frozen, decodes sound volume and pitch on BrainTreebank better than published models. Beyond task performance, PHASE learns to encapsulate the physiological characteristics clinicians recognize, from seizure onset and its propagation to anatomical region identity, even though its pretraining contains no ictal recordings or anatomical labels.

</details>


### [190] [Data Unlearning via Inverse Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36099)
*Aleksei Leonov,Nikita Kornilov,Zhenhe Zhang,Evgeny Burnaev,Iaroslav Koshelev,Alexander Korotin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出逆蒸馏遗忘（IDU）统一框架，可同时将多步匹配模型蒸馏为高效单步生成器，并抑制指定训练子集的生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步匹配模型（流匹配与扩散模型）生成质量高，但推理成本大，且可能复现训练数据中不想要的成分。现有方法难以同时解决效率与遗忘问题。

Method: 将蒸馏建模为数据分布上的min-max目标，并把该分布表示为遗忘集与生成分布的混合，从而与教师训练分布比较，在最优处仅恢复保留数据。仅需预训练的全数据教师模型和遗忘集数据，无需保留样本、额外特征提取器或分类器。

Result: 在MNIST和CIFAR-10上，于流匹配与基于分数的扩散设置下实验表明，IDU大幅降低遗忘类别的生成频率，同时保持保留类别的生成质量。

Conclusion: IDU是首个在无条件流匹配与基于分数模型中同时实现遗忘与蒸馏的统一框架。

Abstract: Multi-step matching models, including flow and diffusion models, produce high-quality outputs but incur substantial inference costs and may reproduce unwanted components of their training datasets. We introduce Inverse Distillation Unlearning (IDU), a unified framework that simultaneously distills a teacher multi-step matching model into an efficient one-step student generator and suppresses outputs corresponding to a designated training subset. We first formulate distillation as a min-max objective over a data distribution and then represent this distribution as a mixture of the forget-set and the generated distributions. This allows us to compare this mixture with the teacher's training distribution and recover only the retained data at the optimum. Our method requires only a pretrained full-data teacher and data from the forget set, without access to retained training examples, extra feature extractors or classifiers. Extensive experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets under flow-matching and score-based diffusion settings demonstrate that IDU substantially reduces the generation frequency of forgotten classes while preserving generation quality on the retained classes. To the best of our knowledge, IDU is the first unified framework for simultaneous unlearning and distillation in unconditional flow-matching and score-based models.

</details>


### [191] [LoopICL: Looping a single transformer block to solve tabular tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36108)
*Amir Rezaei Balef,Katharina Eggensperger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LoopICL是一种循环（looped）transformer表格基础模型，通过将核心块设计为单一块并解耦参数量与计算深度，在同等FLOPs下以少近90%参数达到与TabICLv2相当的性能，并支持推理成本与性能的灵活权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有使用上下文学习（in-context learning）的表格基础模型已在预测任务上超越梯度提升树，但机制的深入分析表明这些模型的参数在很大程度上是冗余的，因此需要一种更参数高效的设计。

Method: 提出LoopICL，一个循环transformer，其核心是单一块（single block），通过两条耦合流处理数据：cell流捕获每个单元的特征表示，row流捕获上下文样本表示，二者通过列内（within-column）与跨列（cross-column）注意力联合精炼。预训练时变化循环次数，使该块在测试时可展开不同迭代次数，并用学习到的exit-gate自动退出。

Result: 在标准设置下，LoopICL在TabArena与TALENT上与TabICLv2性能相当，计算成本（FLOPs）相同，但参数减少近90%。其循环设计还允许用户在推理成本与性能之间进行权衡，提供资源感知的表格基础模型。

Conclusion: LoopICL通过解耦参数量与计算深度的循环设计，实现了高参数效率的表格基础模型，并赋予用户按资源需求调节推理成本与性能的能力。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models using in-context learning have recently surpassed gradient-boosted trees on predictive tabular tasks. However, recent mechanistic insights suggest that parameters in these models are largely redundant. We introduce LoopICL, a looped transformer whose core design decouples parameter count from computational depth. LoopICL consists of a single block, processing data through two coupled streams: a cell stream capturing per-cell feature representations and a row stream capturing in-context example representations, jointly refined through within-column and cross-column attention. During pre-training, we vary loop counts, allowing the block to be unrolled for a varying number of iterations at test-time and use a learned exit-gate to automatically exit. In its standard setting, LoopICL performs competitively with TabICLv2 on TabArena and TALENT at the same computational cost (FLOPs), while using nearly 90% fewer parameters. Furthermore, its recurrent design enables users to also trade off inference cost and performance, providing a resource-aware TFM.

</details>
