With suitable compression levels, AFL-Com retains the same convergence rate as AFL-BR at a lower per-round communication cost, yielding reductions in total communication complexity by factors of $(\log m)^{1/4}$ with Top-$k$ and $(\log m)^{1/2}$ with Rand-$k$ and SR. Experiments validate the improved synchronization and communication efficiency of our methods.

</details>


### [262] [Do LLMs Really Forget? Hidden-State Leakage in Model Unlearning and How to Fix it](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36612)
*Hadi Reisizadeh,Jiajun Ruan,Sijia Liu,Mingyi Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示大模型"遗忘"评估存在假象：输出层面抑制不等于表征层面擦除，并提出PARS方法对抗性地消除隐藏表征中的敏感信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM遗忘研究通常在输出层面评估，模型看似抑制了敏感内容，但这种评估可能造成"遗忘假象"——即使输出层面泄漏被消除，敏感信息仍可能编码在隐藏表征中，导致遗忘并不彻底。

Method: 1) 理论分析：证明输出抑制与表征擦除存在根本性分离，可将解码器对敏感方向变得任意不敏感使输出泄漏降为零，而隐藏表征仍保留信息；2) 实证验证：在各transformer层训练生成式探针解码器，逐层测量信息泄漏；3) 提出PARS（Probe-Adversarial Representation Suppression），通过对抗方式最小化隐藏表征中可提取的信息。

Result: 在TOFU、MUSE、WMDP三个基准和多个SOTA遗忘方法上，即使标准输出指标显示遗忘成功，隐藏表征中仍可恢复大量敏感信息。PARS在对抗探测和再学习攻击下提供显著更强的擦除保证，优于所有对比基线。

Conclusion: 现有遗忘范式存在根本局限，真正的遗忘不仅需控制模型输出，还需控制隐藏表征中编码的信息。

Abstract: Unlearning in large language models (LLMs) is typically evaluated at the output level, where a model appears to suppress sensitive or undesirable content. In this work, we show that such evaluations can create an illusion of forgetting: even when output-level leakage is eliminated, sensitive information can remain encoded in the model's hidden representations. We first provide a theoretical analysis establishing a fundamental separation between output suppression and representational erasure. Specifically, we show that the decoder can be made arbitrarily insensitive to sensitive directions, driving output-level leakage to zero, while the hidden representations retain the underlying information. To empirically validate this phenomenon, we train generative probe decoders on hidden states across transformer layers, enabling layer-wise measurement of information leakage. Across three widely used benchmarks, TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP, and state-of-the-art unlearning methods, we find that substantial sensitive information remains recoverable from hidden representations, even when standard output-level metrics indicate successful unlearning. To address this gap, we propose Probe-Adversarial Representation Suppression (PARS), an unlearning objective that adversarially minimizes the extractable information from hidden representations. PARS directly targets representational leakage and provides significantly stronger guarantees of erasure under adversarial probing and relearning attacks, outperforming all evaluated baselines. Our results highlight a fundamental limitation of existing unlearning paradigms and suggest that true forgetting in LLMs requires controlling not only model outputs, but also the information encoded in hidden representations. Codes are available at https://github.com/OptimAI-Lab/HiddenStateUnlearning.

</details>


### [263] [Selective Elicitation as a Commercial Influence Channel: A Reproducible Synthetic Shopping-Agent Stress Test](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36614)
*Jiapeng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在合成实验环境中研究了商业激励如何通过影响购物助手提问偏好问题的方式（而非最终排序算法）改变推荐结果，发现对抗性提问指令会提高赞助产品被选中的概率并降低用户效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商业激励未必需要进入最终排序算法才能影响推荐结果，它可能通过影响助手选择提出哪个偏好问题来间接产生作用。作者希望在可控的小型合成环境中使这种区别可被实验观测。

Method: 每个任务包含两个产品、三个已验证的数值属性、一个价格限制和一个私有的固定偏好向量。模拟用户回答一个成对问题，独立的推荐器接收产品信息与该答案但不获知赞助分配。对比三种提问条件：中性提问、软性商业指令、以及明确对抗性指令（询问赞助方优势而省略竞争对手优势）。使用40个保留的赞助分配案例（20个不同目录-偏好情境），涉及一个语言模型推荐器、一个固定贝叶斯推荐器以及第二个模型。

Result: 软性指令不改变任何选择。对抗性指令使赞助产品选择率上升0.30，使某语言模型推荐器的平均合成效用下降0.0547（95%情境bootstrap区间[-0.0828, -0.0291]）。固定贝叶斯推荐器呈现类似效应，第二个模型在全部120个冻结问答输入上做出相同选择。终端答案一致性评判器认为20个抽样对抗性答案全部一致，尽管其中五个的合成后悔值高于0.05；单独的问题覆盖维度标记了这些答案的单侧诱导。稳健部分偏好证书在所设定的合成效用下仍然有效，但仅认证40个对抗性案例中的16个，且并不比直接询问中性问题更好。

Conclusion: 这些结果既不能确立广告激励下的典型行为，也不能说明对真实消费者的影响。

Abstract: A commercial incentive need not enter the final ranking algorithm to affect a shopping assistant's recommendation: it may instead influence which preference question the assistant asks. We make this distinction experimentally observable in a deliberately small, synthetic setting. Each task has two products, three verified numerical attributes, a price limit, and a private fixed preference vector. An honest simulated user answers one pairwise question. A separate recommender receives the products and this answer but not the sponsorship assignment. We contrast a neutral question, a soft commercial instruction, and an explicitly adversarial instruction to ask about the sponsor's advantage while omitting the rival's advantage. Across 40 held-out sponsorship-assignment cases (20 distinct catalog-preference contexts), the soft instruction changes no selections. The targeted instruction raises sponsored selection by 0.30 and reduces mean synthetic utility by 0.0547 relative to neutral questioning (95% context-bootstrap interval [-0.0828, -0.0291]) for one language-model recommender. A fixed Bayesian recommender shows a similar effect; a second model makes the same choices on all 120 frozen question-answer inputs. A terminal-answer consistency judge rates all 20 sampled targeted answers consistent, although five have synthetic regret above 0.05; a separate question-coverage dimension flags their one-sided elicitation. A robust partial-preference certificate remains valid under the stipulated synthetic utility but certifies only 16 of 40 targeted cases and is not better than asking a neutral question directly. These results establish neither typical behavior under advertising incentives nor effects on actual consumers.

</details>


### [264] [SemPSG: A Semantic Channel-Aware Foundation Model for Polysomnography Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36619)
*Junyu Chen,Chenxi Liu,Shiqin Tang,Hao Miao,Wanyun Ling,Ziyue Li,Hongbin Liu,Gaofeng Meng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SemPSG，一个语义通道感知的基础模型，用于异构PSG分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSG整合多生理信号，但不同中心的通道配置异构，给可迁移表示学习带来挑战。现有基础模型多关注生理建模或时间学习，将通道身份视为固定结构索引，忽略了信号模态和参考配置所编码的生理语义。

Method: 显式表征通道身份的生理语义，并将其融入信号表示学习与通道聚合。包含语义条件的时序编码器（捕捉信号特异的时间动态与跨信号交互）和多视图图像编码器（从同一记录提取互补的时频与形态模式）。

Result: 在睡眠分期、睡眠呼吸障碍分析、疾病预测、认知与情绪识别、人口统计估计等睡眠与健康任务上，持续优于通用时序基础模型和PSG专用基础模型，并在多样通道配置的异构数据集上具有泛化性。

Conclusion: SemPSG通过语义通道感知实现了跨异构PSG配置的灵活、可迁移建模。

Abstract: Polysomnography (PSG) integrates multiple physiological signals to provide a comprehensive characterization of human sleep, yet its heterogeneous channel configurations across centers pose substantial challenges for transferable representation learning. Existing foundation models mainly focus on physiological modeling or temporal learning, while channel identity is often treated as a fixed structural index, overlooking the physiological semantics encoded by signal modality and reference configuration. To this end, we propose SemPSG, a Semantic channel-aware foundation model for heterogeneous PSG analysis. SemPSG explicitly represents the physiological semantics of channel identity and incorporates them into both signal representation learning and channel aggregation, enabling flexible modeling across diverse data configurations. Specifically, a semantic-conditioned time-series encoder captures signal-specific temporal dynamics and cross-signal interactions, while a multi-view image encoder extracts complementary time-frequency and morphological patterns from the same physiological recordings. We evaluate SemPSG on sleep and health-related tasks, including sleep staging, sleep-disorder breathing analysis, disease prediction, cognition and emotion recognition, and demographic estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over both general-purpose time series foundation models and PSG-specific foundation models, together with generalization across heterogeneous datasets across diverse channel configurations.

</details>


### [265] [Physics-Aware Machine Unlearning for Cyber-Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36633)
*Mohammad Zakaria Haider,Muhammad Nadeem,Mohammad Ashiqur Rahman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种物理引导的梯度上升机器遗忘方法，将遗忘信号与物理残差耦合，使遗忘过程的权重更新朝向物理可行区域，实现在IEEE 34节点配电系统上同时去除毒化并恢复物理合规性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全攸关的信息物理系统中，机器遗忘若仅做普通梯度上升，可能把模型推向任意替代解，仍违反领域物理约束，无法安全部署，因此需要物理引导的遗忘机制。

Method: 将遗忘信号与目标信息物理系统的物理残差耦合，以物理残差作为梯度上升过程中的"安全围栏"，引导模型远离被投毒的行为盆地并同时进入物理合规区域；在两个基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的分布式能源控制器上验证，并与四种基线（朴素梯度上升、精确遗忘、SISA、完全重训练）对比，采用高保真OpenDSS潮流联合仿真。

Result: 在IEEE 34节点配电系统上，所提物理引导模型能够同时去除毒化并恢复物理合规性。

Conclusion: 物理引导的机器遗忘对安全攸关信息物理系统的安全部署具有必要性，可兼顾遗忘效果与物理约束满足。

Abstract: This paper proposes a physics-guided gradient-ascent-based machine unlearning method that couples the forgetting signal with the physical residual of the target cyber-physical systems, ensuring that weight updates during unlearning are steered toward physically feasible regions of the weight space. The physics residual acts as a safety fence during gradient ascent: the model is steered away from the poisoned behavioral basin and simultaneously toward physics-compliant territory, rather than toward an arbitrary alternative that may still violate domain constraints. We evaluate the proposed method against four baselines: naive gradient ascent, exact unlearning, SISA, and full retraining on an IEEE 34-bus distribution system, driven by two physics-informed neural network-based distribution energy resource controllers and validated through high-fidelity OpenDSS power-flow co-simulation. From the evaluation, we found that our proposed physics-guided model simultaneously removes poison and restores physical compliance, which are essential for the safe deployment of safety-critical cyber-physical systems

</details>


### [266] [What Makes Recurrence Effective in Looped Language Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36636)
*Xinlin Zhuang,Siyuan Wang,Imran Razzak,Weiyang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了循环语言模型（LoopLMs）中循环计算何时有益、应施加于何处以及条件注入方式如何影响性能，并提出history-state injection以提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoopLMs通过参数共享增加计算深度，可在不增加参数的情况下扩展推理计算。然而，额外循环何时有益、架构选择如何影响其有效性尚不明确，缺乏系统性的设计指导。

Method: 通过受控实验，在低于、处于和超出训练范围的推理预算下，针对知识与推理任务，系统考察三个问题：(1)循环何时有益；(2)循环应施加在何处；(3)循环的条件注入如何影响性能。并提出history-state injection，特别是逐通道history-state injection结合timestep conditioning。

Result: (1)循环可提升超出训练范围的推理能力，但会损害知识性能，且更难的推理实例未必获益更多；(2)性能取决于不同层与循环迭代的分配，有效深度不足以预测行为；非循环输出层提升了对欠展开的鲁棒性，输入输出层的最佳位置随推理预算变化；(3)常规初始状态注入对循环深度变化的鲁棒性有限，而逐通道history-state injection结合timestep conditioning成本低且更有效。

Conclusion: 研究阐明了循环计算何时有益、何处失效，并为在不同推理预算下设计LoopLMs提供了实用指南。

Abstract: Looped language models (LoopLMs) increase computational depth through parameter sharing, offering a path to scale inference computation without adding parameters. However, it remains unclear when additional recurrence is beneficial and how architectural choices affect its effectiveness. Through controlled experiments, we systematically examine (1) when recurrence helps, (2) where it should be applied, and (3) how its conditioning affects performance. Our evaluation covers inference budgets below, within, and beyond the training horizon under knowledge and reasoning tasks. (1) We find that recurrence can improve reasoning beyond the training horizon while degrading knowledge performance, but harder reasoning instances do not consistently benefit more. (2) Performance also depends on how distinct layers and recurrent iterations are allocated, showing that effective depth alone is insufficient to predict behavior. Non-recurrent output layers improve robustness to under-unrolling, while the preferred placement of input and output layers varies with inference budget. (3) Finally, we find that conventional initial-state injection offers limited robustness to varying recurrence depth. We therefore propose history-state injection as an alternative, and show that channel-wise history-state injection combined with timestep conditioning offers a low-cost and more effective design, better preserving knowledge under extended unrolling while improving robustness across inference budgets. Overall, our results clarify when recurrent computation helps, where it fails, and offer practical guidelines for designing LoopLMs across variable inference budgets.

</details>


### [267] [PE-OPSD: Internalizing Prompt Enhancement into Flow-matching Models via On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36638)
*Mingfeng Lin,Chengfei Cai,Lin Xu,Chengqian Ma,Yuxiang Wei,Liang Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PE-OPSD方法，通过在线策略自蒸馏将"提示增强"的效果内化到文生图模型中，推理时无需增强器即可直接用原始提示生成高质量图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文生图用户通常提供简短、欠明确的提示，而生成模型需要详细文本条件才能可靠地遵循指令。现有系统用提示增强器（PE）在推理时重写原始提示来弥合这一差距，但这带来了额外的推理延迟，且提示细化过程外置于生成器之外。

Method: 将增强后的提示视为特权训练信息，提出Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation（PE-OPSD）。训练时，使用原始提示的学生模型沿自身生成轨迹采样，增强提示的教师模型在学生访问的状态上提供向量场目标；这种在线策略监督将增强提示所诱导的行为蒸馏进学生模型，且无需额外的文本-图像对。

Result: 在多种模型族、多种提示增强器和多个基准上，PE-OPSD在所评估基线中取得最强的综合提示保真度，综合视觉吸引力获得正向提升，同时保留了基座模型的推理效率。

Conclusion: 提示增强的收益可以被内化到生成器中：推理时移除PE和教师模型，学生模型可直接从原始提示生成，兼顾了生成质量与推理效率。

Abstract: Text-to-image users often provide concise and underspecified prompts, whereas generative models benefit from detailed textual conditions for reliable instruction following. Existing systems bridge this gap with Prompt Enhancers (PEs) that rewrite raw prompts at inference time, introducing additional latency and leaving prompt elaboration external to the generator. We instead view enhanced prompts as privileged training information and ask whether their benefits can be internalized. We propose Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation (PE-OPSD) for text-to-image flow-matching models. During training, a raw-prompt student follows its own generation trajectory, while an enhanced-prompt teacher provides vector-field targets at the states visited by the student. This on-policy supervision distills the behavior induced by enhanced prompts into the raw-prompt student without requiring additional text--image pairs. At inference, both the PE and teacher are removed, and the student generates directly from raw prompts. Across multiple model families, PEs, and benchmarks, PE-OPSD achieves the strongest aggregate prompt fidelity among the evaluated baselines, yields positive aggregate visual appeal gains, and retains the base-model inference efficiency.

</details>


### [268] [A Digital Simulation Toolkit for Physics-Based Generation of Realistic Experimental Scanning Tunneling Microscopy Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36639)
*Huanhuan Zhao,Laxmi Bhurtel,Connor Vernachio,Fahmy Paiziah,Wonhee Ko,Arpan Biswas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文开发了一种低成本、物理驱动的数字工具包，用于生成大量逼真的STM图像，以解决监督去噪中配对干净-噪声数据难以获取的问题，并在Cu(111)和Pb(111)图像上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: STM具有原子级分辨率，但对噪声极为敏感。现有无监督去噪方法训练成本低，但主要侧重去噪而难以恢复关键物理信息；监督方法性能更优，但瓶颈在于需要大量配对的干净-噪声实验图像，而这些图像实际中难以获得。因此需要一种能快速生成逼真STM图像的低成本方案。

Method: 提出一个物理驱动的数字工具包：首先从选定材料体系模拟干净图像；然后基于STM实验中伪影与噪声的物理特性先验知识，构建多种伪影-噪声函数（高斯电子噪声、1/f闪烁噪声、扫描线噪声、背景倾斜和机械漂移）；将这些物理信息化的噪声分量叠加到模拟干净图像上，生成逼真的STM图像，从而为AI去噪提供就绪数据。

Result: 该工具包能够为铜和铅的(111)表面去噪生成AI就绪数据，并保留原子、缺陷和电子波。对Cu(111)图像中量子干涉诱导的电子波图案的学习分析验证了下游图像分析质量。结果表明，在数字生成的AI就绪数据上训练的监督模型，比基准无监督方法能更有效地去噪并学习Cu(111)图像上的电子波图案。

Conclusion: 所提出的物理驱动数字工具包能够生成逼真的STM图像数据，使监督去噪模型表现优于无监督基准方法，有助于促进电子波图案学习等科学发现。

Abstract: Scanning Tunneling Microscopy (STM) is a widely used tool for characterizing surfaces of materials at the atomic scale, playing a crucial role in discoveries across condensed matter physics and materials science. Despite its extreme spatial resolution, STM is one of the most sensitive microscopy techniques and is highly prone to noise. While existing unsupervised denoising methods are very cheap to train, these are primarily focused on removing the noise with minimal recovery of key physical information. While supervised methods can offer superior performance, the major bottleneck is that a large amount of paired clean-noisy experimental images is required which are impractical to obtain. Thus, we developed a low-cost physics-driven digital toolkit to rapidly generate large volume of realistic STM images. Firstly, we simulate clean images from a chosen material system. Then, with prior knowledge of the physical characteristics of the artifacts and noise present in STM experiments, we formulate several artifact-noise functions such as Gaussian electronic noise, 1/f flicker noise, scan-line noise, background tilt and mechanical drift. These physically informed noise components are then added to the simulated clean images to generate realistic STM images. We demonstrated the capability of the proposed digital toolkit to generate AI-ready data for denoising images of the (111) surfaces of copper and lead, while preserving atoms, defects, and electron waves. We also validated the quality of the downstream image analysis of learning electron wave patterns induced by quantum interference from Cu(111) images. Results show that the supervised models trained on digitally generated AI-ready data can more effectively denoise and learn electron wave patterns on Cu(111) images than benchmarked unsupervised approaches, indicating that the proposed toolkit facilitate scientific discovery.

</details>


### [269] [Inducing Process Supervision from Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36641)
*Shengda Fan,Xin Cong,Zhong Zhang,Haotian Chen,Yankai Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TIPS，一种仅使用结果标签的强化学习框架，用于低成本训练生成式过程奖励模型（PRM），在多个基准上达到领先效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练高质量的过程奖励模型（PRM）成本高昂：人工逐步标注难以规模化，蒙特卡洛估计计算昂贵且可能偏离步骤本身的内在正确性。因此需要一种低成本获得有效 PRM 的方法。

Method: 提出 TIPS（Thinking-Induced Process Supervision），一种仅依赖结果监督的强化学习框架。模型先生成思维链（CoT），随后输出步骤级标签与结果标签；奖励仅取决于预测结果是否与真值匹配，并将由此得到的分组相对优势用于优化整个生成响应。当检查中间步骤有助于判断结果时，更准确的步骤检查会带来更好的结果判断与更高奖励，从而在无显式过程监督下强化步骤级验证。

Result: 在数学与智能体（agent）基准、四种骨干模型家族上验证有效性。TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 仅用 3.2K 结果标注轨迹即在 ProcessBench 上达到 85.2 F1，超过所有已评估的训练型 PRM 以及 GPT-5.4-Instruct、Claude-4.7-Opus 等强提示型评判模型，但仍落后于 o1-mini。

Conclusion: 仅用结果标签的强化学习即可有效强化步骤级验证，无需显式过程监督，从而以低成本获得强生成式 PRM；代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) have become a key component for LLMs, as their step-level feedback supports both post-training and test-time reasoning. However, training strong PRMs remains costly: human step annotation is difficult to scale, while Monte Carlo estimation is computationally expensive and can drift from the intrinsic correctness of steps. To get effective PRMs at low cost, we introduce TIPS (Thinking-Induced Process Supervision), an outcome-only reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training generative PRMs. In TIPS, the model generates a chain-of-thought (CoT) followed by step-level labels and an outcome label. The reward depends solely on whether the predicted outcome matches the ground truth, and the resulting group-relative advantage is used to optimize the entire generated response. Intuitively, when checking intermediate steps helps determine the outcome, more accurate checks can lead to better outcome judgments and higher rewards. Outcome-only RL can therefore reinforce step-level verification without explicit process supervision. We validate the effectiveness of TIPS across math and agent benchmarks and four backbone families. Notably, TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 reaches 85.2 F1 on ProcessBench with only 3.2K outcome-labeled trajectories, surpassing all evaluated trained PRMs and strong prompt-only judges such as GPT-5.4-Instruct and Claude-4.7-Opus, while still trailing o1-mini. Code and data are available at https://github.com/RUCBM/TIPS.

</details>


### [270] [PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36642)
*Muyang Li,Jie Yang,Zhengyu Fang,Junchao Zhu,Zhengkun Xiao,Ruining Deng,Zhe Jiang,Shigang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文发现隐性技能信息主要体现在隐藏状态而非词元概率上，据此提出PR-OPD方法，通过特权表示在线自蒸馏对齐隐藏状态，在ALFWorld和WebShop上取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型智能体训练依赖每回合单一奖励，特权自蒸馏通过词元概率传递技能，但作者发现两个反常现象：一是"隐形优势"——技能虽显著提升成功率却仅改变不到四分之一采样词元的概率；二是"隐藏对齐"——技能改变了超过80%响应词元的隐藏状态，且线性探针可追溯至具体技能。这表明现有基于词元概率的蒸馏通道存在信息瓶颈。

Method: 提出PR-OPD（特权表示在线自蒸馏）。先用GRPO热启动，随后策略为每条轨迹写下事后技能（hindsight skill），以该技能为上下文重新阅读自己的响应，作为stop-gradient教师，在每一层将自身投影的隐藏状态与教师对齐，同时结合奖励目标优化，无需外部技能库、独立教师或推理开销。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop两个环境、两种骨干模型上，PR-OPD在所有设置中均取得最佳整体结果，相比GRPO在ALFWorld成功率上最高提升4.7个百分点，在WebShop准确率上最高提升14.0个百分点。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 技能带来的优势信息主要编码在隐藏状态而非词元概率中，因此在表示层进行在线自蒸馏比传统概率蒸馏更有效；PR-OPD以极低额外成本显著提升语言模型智能体的训练效果。

Abstract: Language-model agents are usually trained by reinforcement learning from one reward per episode, and privileged self-distillation enriches it by letting the same policy, given a skill, teach its skill-free self through token probabilities. However, we identify two phenomena that question this channel. Invisible Advantage: a skill in context lifts WebShop success from 42.2% to 56.2%, yet changes the probabilities of fewer than a quarter of the sampled tokens. Much to Align: a skill changes the hidden states of over 80% of response tokens, in a way that linear probes can trace back to the specific skill. To exploit this, we propose Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation (PR-OPD). After a GRPO warm start, the policy writes a hindsight skill for each trajectory, re-reads its own responses with that skill as a stop-gradient teacher, and aligns its projected hidden states to the teacher's at every layer alongside the reward objective, with no external skill library, separate teacher, or inference overhead. On ALFWorld and WebShop with two backbones, PR-OPD achieves the best overall results in every setting, improving over GRPO by up to 4.7 points in ALFWorld success and 14.0 points in WebShop accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/balibata/PR-OPD.

</details>


### [271] [Scheduling Recursive Reasoning in Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36653)
*Boyuan Wang,Chengyao Yu,Jiaxi Ren,Hongxin Wei,Bingyi Jing,Yuxin Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出轨迹自适应进展-波动调度器（TAPS），通过在线调节循环推理中的更新步长，减少终端损失并在更少循环内达到目标质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环推理模型通过共享参数迭代细化隐状态来扩展测试时计算，但现有方法以固定单位尺度施加每次学习到的更新，导致进展持续时过于保守、波动时过于激进，限制了额外循环带来的收益。因此需要理解更新尺度应如何沿轨迹变化。

Method: 作者首先分析终端损失对循环更新尺度的敏感性，证明其时间平均可精确分解为持续进展项与中心化波动项。基于此提出TAPS，在循环更新过程中跟踪二者的平衡并在线自适应调整步长；进一步将进展-波动原则引入训练。

Result: 理论上给出充分条件，说明TAPS可降低期望终端损失并在更少循环内达到目标质量。实验上，在结构化推理任务中无需重训练即提升终端准确率；引入训练后进一步带来准确率增益，在匹配基线准确率时实现最高1.56倍墙钟加速，并在多种循环架构与推理策略上有效。

Conclusion: TAPS确立更新尺度作为循环推理中与架构和深度并列的互补控制轴。

Abstract: Recurrent reasoning models have attracted growing attention for scaling test-time computation, typically by iteratively refining latent states with shared parameters. However, these models apply each learned update with a fixed unit scale, which can be conservative when updates make persistent progress and overly aggressive when they fluctuate, limiting the benefit of additional loops. To understand how the scale should vary along the trajectory, we first analyze the sensitivity of terminal loss to recurrent update scale. We show that its temporal average admits an exact decomposition into persistent-progress and centered-fluctuation contributions. Based on this, we introduce the Trajectory Adaptive Progress-Fluctuation Scheduler (TAPS), which tracks their balance across recurrent updates and adapts the step size online. Theoretically, we establish sufficient conditions under which TAPS reduces expected terminal loss and reaches a target quality in fewer recurrent loops. Empirically, we show that TAPS improves terminal accuracy across structured reasoning tasks without retraining. By further incorporating the progress-fluctuation principle into training, TAPS yields additional accuracy gains with up to 1.56 times wall-clock speedup at matched baseline accuracy. The broad applicability of TAPS is supported by its effectiveness across diverse recurrent architectures and inference strategies. Together, these results establish update scale as complementary control axis of recurrent inference alongside architecture and depth.

</details>


### [272] [Replay the Curvature: Accurate and Scalable NVFP4 Quantization for Large Language Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36654)
*Ruiyi Ding,Jie Li,Kang He,Ziyan Liu,Chengru Song,Yuedong Xu,Yuan Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Schur Replay 尺度选择算法与配套执行基础设施，用于低精度（NVFP4）大模型量化，在 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 与 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 上实现近乎无损的精度恢复并大幅加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的权重存储与内存传输是推理的主要开销，因此需要仅用几位比特表示权重的低精度格式。但低精度格式依赖 scale 将浮点值映射到小码本，而在 GPTQ 中量化一列会更新后续列，导致独立评估某个 block 的 scale 会错误估计其最终重构误差。此外大模型带来第二个挑战：全精度权重、校准激活与二阶状态无法同时驻留单张加速器，而将整层分配到设备又会使耗时的层求解串行化。

Method: 算法方面，Schur Replay 复现每个 block scale 引起的 GPTQ 更新，并在考虑未量化列补偿后对所得 block 误差打分，从而更准确地选择 scale。基础设施方面，仅保持当前活跃层常驻，将激活分层到设备、主机和磁盘，导出后即释放全精度层，并将独立的输出行分配到张量并行 rank 上。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 与 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 的七个基准上，相对 BF16 分别达到 99.35% 和 100.84% 的问题加权恢复率。在 397B 模型上，该基础设施相比 ModelOpt 将实测单层时间减少 15.17 倍，相比 LLM Compressor 减少 23.14 倍，且每 GPU 内存占用更低。

Conclusion: Schur Replay 通过更精确的 block scale 选择并结合分层内存与张量并行的执行基础设施，协同解决了 NVFP4 量化的精度与大模型可扩展性问题，在保持近乎无损精度的同时显著提升速度并降低显存占用。

Abstract: Large language models make weight storage and memory traffic major inference costs, motivating low-precision formats that represent each weight with only a few bits. Such formats use a scale to map floating-point values into a small codebook; NVFP4 improves local range utilization by letting every 16 E2M1 weights share an E4M3 block scale. Choosing that scale is difficult in GPTQ because quantizing one column updates those that follow, so evaluating a block independently can misestimate its final reconstruction error. Large models pose a second challenge: full-precision weights, calibration activations, and second-order state cannot all remain on one accelerator, while assigning complete layers to devices leaves each time-consuming layer solve serial. We introduce \emph{Schur Replay}, a scale-selection algorithm that reproduces the GPTQ updates caused by each block scale and scores the resulting block error after accounting for compensation from unquantized columns. Separately, our execution infrastructure keeps only the active layer resident, tiers activations across device, host, and disk, retires full-precision layers after export, and distributes independent output rows across tensor-parallel ranks. Together, the algorithm and infrastructure attain $99.35\%$ and $100.84\%$ question-weighted recovery from BF16 across seven benchmarks on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct. On the 397B model, the infrastructure reduces measured per-layer time by $15.17\times$ over ModelOpt and $23.14\times$ over LLM Compressor, with lower memory used per GPU.

</details>


### [273] [Constitutional adapters: Inference-time interventions for misalignment and misuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36657)
*Adam S. Lowet,Mark Kurzeja*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"宪法适配器"(CAs)：从合成语料中将符合显式原则(宪法)的行为蒸馏为轻量对象(低秩适配器与引导向量)，在不接触有害请求的前提下提升越狱防御与对齐度，并可零样本迁移与推理时缩放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于显式原则(宪法)训练模型行为是AI对齐中有前景的机制，但其通用性与灵活性尚不明确，作者希望验证这种行为能否被蒸馏为轻量、可迁移、可调控的组件。

Method: 从合成语料中蒸馏符合宪法的行为到低秩适配器与引导向量；训练过程中完全不接触有害请求或越狱样本；通过"宪法训练对象减去对照训练对象"进一步强化效果，得到宪法适配器(CAs)。

Result: 即使从未见过有害请求或越狱，蒸馏对象仍提升越狱防御成功率与对齐指标，尤其在长上下文与多轮攻击场景下优于提示与引导基线；CAs可从基座模型零样本迁移到后训练检查点，并可在推理时缩放以权衡防御与良性顺从。

Conclusion: CAs是一种轻量、可移植、可调优的手段，可用于缓解API部署中的失准与滥用问题。

Abstract: Training models to act in accordance with an explicitly defined set of principles, or "constitution," has shown promise as a robust and transparent mechanism for AI alignment. However, the generality and flexibility of such methods remain unclear. Here, we show that constitution-consistent behavior can be distilled from synthetic corpora into lightweight objects (low-rank adapters and steering vectors). Despite never seeing a harmful request or jailbreak during training, such objects increase jailbreak defense success and measured alignment -- particularly at long context lengths and against multi-turn attacks, where they outperform both prompted and steered baselines. Subtracting control-trained from constitution-trained objects further accentuates these effects, yielding defenses we call "constitutional adapters" (CAs). CAs can be trained on a base model, transferred zero-shot to its post-trained checkpoint, and scaled at inference time to predictably trade off defense for benign compliance. Taken together, these results recommend CAs as a lightweight, portable, and tunable lever for mitigating misalignment and misuse in API deployments.

</details>


### [274] [On-Policy Parameter Update Direction Underlies Generalization in LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36659)
*Shufan Shen,Zhongni Hou,Junshu Sun,Yufei Zhang,Wei Lin,Guojun Yin,Qingming Huang,Shuhui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 OPSFT，通过将 SFT 的更新约束到 on-policy 范式识别出的累积更新方向上，从而把 on-policy 的强泛化优势迁移到 SFT，兼顾高效训练与高质量轨迹利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究多把 on-policy 后训练的参数更新行为当作副产物，忽视其作为优化原则来提升 SFT 等其他范式泛化能力的潜力。作者希望探究是否存在某种 on-policy 更新行为可改善泛化。

Method: 首先分析发现：SFT 沿一致方向更新参数，而 on-policy 范式在训练中不断调整方向，由此关注每个参数的累积更新方向。随后提出 OPSFT（On-Policy direction-constrained Supervised Fine-Tuning），将 SFT 更新约束到由 on-policy 范式识别出的方向上。

Result: OPSFT 表现出强性能，说明 on-policy 范式的泛化优势可通过参数更新方向迁移到 SFT；即使 SFT 只在被识别方向上约束更新，也能获得良好泛化。

Conclusion: 该发现带来两方面实用收益：用少量 on-policy 训练步识别支持强泛化的更新方向再应用 OPSFT 以实现高训练效率；OPSFT 可利用高质量轨迹沿该更新方向继续优化后训练模型，而不破坏 on-policy 训练所学能力。

Abstract: The strong generalization performance of on-policy post-training paradigms has motivated studies of their parameter update behaviors. However, these studies treat the observed behaviors only as byproducts in on-policy training, overlooking their potential to serve as optimization principles for improving the generalization of other paradigms such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT). To address this limitation, we investigate whether there exists a specific on-policy update behavior that can achieve such improvements. First, our analyses reveal that SFT updates parameters along consistent directions, while the on-policy paradigm continuously adjusts the direction during training. This difference inspires us to focus on the cumulative update direction of each parameter as a promising behavior. Then, we evaluate its effectiveness for improving generalization by proposing On-Policy direction-constrained Supervised Fine-Tuning (OPSFT), which constrains SFT updates to the direction identified by on-policy paradigms. The strong performance of OPSFT indicates that the generalization advantage of on-policy paradigms can be transferred to SFT through the parameter update direction. Once such a direction is identified, even SFT can generalize with its updates constrained to this direction. This finding offers two practical benefits by combining the strong generalization of on-policy paradigms with the advantages of SFT, including the high training efficiency and ability to leverage high-quality trajectories. For efficiency, we identify update directions that support strong generalization using a few on-policy training steps, and subsequently apply OPSFT to achieve high training efficiency. For leveraging high-quality trajectories, OPSFT can utilize these trajectories to continue improving a post-trained model along its update direction without disrupting the ability learned from on-policy training.

</details>


### [275] [Byzantine-Robust Federated Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36660)
*Leonardo F. Toso,James Anderson,Rafael Pinot,Nirupam Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究含对抗客户端的联邦学习，提出通过表征学习（个性化线性头+协作共享非线性表征）来消除模型异质性偏差并提升拜占庭鲁棒性，给出非渐近参数恢复误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在数据异质性下，单一共享模型无法刻画各客户端不同的数据生成过程，会带来不可消除的模型异质性偏差，并严重削弱对对抗（拜占庭）客户端的鲁棒性。

Method: 采用表征学习框架：每个客户端学习个性化的线性头，同时通过拜占庭鲁棒聚合协作估计共享的非线性表征；在不知道诚实客户端身份的情况下最小化其平均损失，并分析诚实的表征梯度异质性。将回归分析扩展到多分类问题。

Result: 证明了诚实表征梯度间的异质性由表征误差与统计误差控制，二者分别随每客户端样本数τ或迭代次数T衰减。非渐近参数恢复误差界包含三项：依赖初始化的误差（随T消失）、有限样本噪声项（随τ和诚实客户端数量下降）、随机梯度方差项（随T减小），且界中不含不可消除的模型异质性偏差。在CIFAR-10、FEMNIST和School Exam Score数据集上进行了实证验证。

Conclusion: 通过表征学习实现个性化与共享表征的结合，可在异质和对抗环境下消除模型异质性偏差并保持鲁棒性，理论界与实验结果均支持该方法的有效性。

Abstract: We study federated learning (FL) with adversarial clients, where the goal is to minimize the average loss of the honest (non-adversarial) clients without knowing their identity. Under heterogeneity, a single shared model parameter is statistically inappropriate: it cannot capture the distinct data-generating processes across clients, incurring an irreducible model-heterogeneity bias and severely limiting robustness to adversarial clients (a.k.a. Byzantine-robustness). We address this problem through representation learning, where each client learns a personalized linear head, while collaboratively estimating a shared nonlinear representation through Byzantine-robust aggregation. We demonstrate that the heterogeneity among honest representation gradients is controlled by the representation error and statistical errors that decay either with the number of data samples per client ($τ$) or the number of iterations ($T$). In particular, our non-asymptotic parameter recovery error bound reveals three terms: (i) an initialization-dependent error that goes away with $T$, (ii) finite-sample noise terms that decreases with $τ$ and the number of honest clients, and (iii) a stochastic gradient variance term that also reduces with $T$. Importantly, with no irreducible model-heterogeneity bias in our bounds. We extend the regression analysis to multiclass classification, and empirically validate it on CIFAR-10, FEMNIST, and School Exam Score datasets.

</details>


### [276] [AutoLoCo: Communication Efficient Distributed LLM Training via Adaptive Synchronization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36662)
*Pengyu He,Yan Zhang,Ruien Li,Guangwen Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AutoLoCo：自适应局部更新框架，依据训练统计动态调整同步间隔并校正外层优化器，在保持性能的同时降低27%通信频率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM预训练日益跨多数据中心，加速器规模扩大使通信占比上升，频繁同步成为瓶颈。局部更新方法通过在同步间进行多次优化器步来降本，但多数方法预先固定间隔且全程不变，而最优间隔实际随训练过程变化。

Method: 提出AutoLoCo自适应框架：基于两个观察（1）合适局部间隔随训练阶段变化；（2）改变每间隔内步数会与不变的外层优化器产生不匹配。方法利用标量训练统计自适应调整局部间隔，并用累积的内层学习率对外层优化器的动量与学习率进行校正。

Result: 在通信受限条件下，AutoLoCo相较DiLoCo降低27%的通信频率，同时保持训练性能。

Conclusion: 通过自适应局部间隔与对外层更新的校正，可在不损失训练性能的前提下显著减少LLM训练中的通信开销。

Abstract: The pre-training of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly conducted across multiple data centers. As training scales to a larger number of accelerators, the fraction of time spent on computation decreases, while the fraction spent on communication increases. Therefore, frequent synchronization becomes a growing bottleneck. Local update methods reduce this cost by allowing workers to perform several optimizer steps between synchronizations. Most local update methods set the number of local optimizer steps between synchronizations before training and keep this interval fixed throughout the run. However, the best interval can change during the entire train process. If the interval and optimizer are adapted to the current training state, the communication frequency is reduced while maintaining the training performance. In this work, we introduce AutoLoCo, an adaptive training framework to reduce communication in LLM training. It adapts the local interval using scalar training statistics and corrects each outer update. Our method is motivated by two observations: 1) the appropriate local interval varies across training stages, and 2) changing the number of inner steps per interval creates a mismatch with an unchanged outer optimizer, requiring a correction to the outer update. We optimize this mismatch by correction of the outer optimizer for the momentum and the learning rate using the accumulated inner learning rate. Our experiments under communication constraints demonstrate that AutoLoCo reduces communication frequency by 27% relative to DiLoCo while maintaining training performance.

</details>


### [277] [GenLimitLib: A Formal Library for Language Generation in the Limit and AI-Assisted Mathematical Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36663)
*Shuangping Li,Peng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 GenLimitLib，一个面向“极限语言生成”领域的 Lean 4 形式化库，涵盖 30 篇论文，并展示其在人类数学研究与 AI 辅助研究中的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: “极限语言生成”由 Kleinberg 和 Mullainathan 于 NeurIPS 2024 提出，是受 LLM 启发的新兴理论研究领域，发展迅速但缺乏系统化的形式化整理，适合作为大规模形式化的试验平台。

Method: 构建源对齐的 Lean 4 库 GenLimitLib，提取跨论文的共享定义与可复用证明组件，同时保留各论文特定的假设与命题，并记录论文间的关联关系。

Result: 该库包含 30 篇论文的形式化发展，提供了该领域文献的具体且结构化的视图，并通过数学案例研究与 LLM 实验验证其支持能力。

Conclusion: GenLimitLib 能同时支持人类数学研究与 AI 辅助研究，为极限语言生成领域提供了系统化、可复用的形式化基础设施。

Abstract: We present GenLimitLib, a source-aligned Lean 4 library for language generation in the limit. Introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan at NeurIPS 2024, language generation in the limit studies a theoretical question motivated by LLMs: how to generate valid new strings from observed examples. This young and rapidly evolving field offers a natural testbed for studying large-scale formalization. GenLimitLib contains formal developments for 30 papers. It extracts shared definitions and reusable proof components while preserving paper-specific assumptions and statements, and records relationships across papers. In this way, GenLimitLib provides a concrete and structured view of the literature. We show through mathematical case studies and LLM experiments how our library can support both human mathematical research and AI-assisted research. Our Library: https://github.com/pengzhang91/generation-in-the-limit-lib.

</details>


### [278] [Stochastic Heavy Ball with Polyak Step Size and Armijo Line Search: A General Convergence Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36668)
*Jiawei Zhang,Qitan Shi,Yuantao Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为随机重球法(SHB)结合Polyak步长(PS)与Armijo线搜索(ALS)建立了统一的收敛性分析,涵盖强凸、凸与非凸目标,并在插值或强增长条件下给出几乎必然速率与末次迭代收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PS与ALS在随机优化中备受关注且实证与理论表现良好,但它们在随机重球法(SHB)中的收敛理论仍很有限,缺乏统一、不受动量参数限制的分析。

Method: 引入一种与Polyak步长高度对应的修正Armijo规则,并提出解耦分析以分离动量带来的历史依赖;据此对配备标准PS与ALS的SHB进行统一收敛分析,并进一步考虑PS与ALS的递减变体。

Result: 对标准PS与ALS的SHB,在强凸、凸及非凸目标下无需插值或对动量参数的额外限制即可得到期望收敛;在插值或强增长条件下可强化为几乎必然速率与末次迭代收敛;在插值之外的一般情形下,递减变体可证明几乎必然收敛到精确最优解或稳定点。

Conclusion: 该工作为随机重球法中的Polyak步长与Armijo线搜索提供了更完整的理论视角,拓展了其收敛性保证的适用范围。

Abstract: Polyak step size (PS) and Armijo line search (ALS) have received increasing attention in stochastic optimization, with encouraging empirical performance and theoretical guarantees. However, their convergence theory for stochastic heavy ball (SHB) methods remains limited. In this work, we develop a unified convergence analysis for SHB equipped with PS and ALS. To this end, we introduce a modified Armijo rule that closely parallels the Polyak step size, together with a decoupling analysis that isolates the historical dependence induced by momentum. For SHB with standard PS and ALS, we establish expected convergence for strongly convex, convex, and non-convex objectives without interpolation or restrictive conditions on the momentum parameter. Under interpolation or strong growth, we further strengthen the results to almost sure rates and last-iterate convergence. Moreover, for general settings beyond interpolation, we prove almost sure convergence to the exact optimum or to stationarity for SHB with diminishing variants of PS and ALS. These results provide a more comprehensive theoretical view of Polyak step size and Armijo line search for stochastic heavy ball methods.

</details>


### [279] [Human-inspired, Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration for Efficient Learning in High Dimensions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36672)
*Fanyu Zhu,Jiahui An,Ni Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 受人类在高维决策空间中"探测特征维度、识别奖励相关维度并压缩有效决策空间"这一行为机制启发，本文提出TDGE（Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration），一种具有自动构建"任务—维度—特征—物品"层级结构的、通用且与模型无关的探索算法，通过自上而下的层级探索提升高维决策空间中的探索效率与冷启动适应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维决策空间中的高效探索是决策系统的核心难题，而人类却能以极高的效率在其中导航。近期行为研究表明，人类会通过探测候选特征维度、识别与奖励相关的维度，并据此限制有效决策空间来降低维度。作者希望借鉴这一人类机制来改进机器决策系统的探索方式。

Method: 提出TDGE算法：自动构建"任务—维度—特征—物品"的层级结构，采用自上而下的探索策略——先选择与任务相关的特征维度，再在该维度内识别有信息量的特征，最后基于所选特征推荐具体物品。该算法为人类启发式、通用（model-agnostic）方法。

Result: 在MovieLens-20M、Last.fm与Amazon推荐数据集上的实验表明，TDGE在探索效率和冷启动适应方面显著优于基线算法；与其他结构化算法的对比及消融实验显示，这些收益归因于其层级结构与语义特征空间探索，且在多种聚类方法与不同层级深度下结果稳健；推荐轨迹可视化呈现与人类维度引导行为相似的探索模式。

Conclusion: TDGE验证了将人类维度引导的降维探索机制引入决策系统的有效性：层级化的语义特征空间探索能显著提升高维决策空间中的探索效率与冷启动表现，并为探索行为与人类认知机制之间的联系提供了可视化证据。

Abstract: Efficient exploration in high-dimensional decision spaces remains a central challenge for decision-making systems. Humans, in contrast, can navigate large decision spaces with remarkable efficiency. Recent behavioral studies suggest that humans reduce dimensionality in large decision spaces by probing candidate feature dimensions, identifying reward-relevant ones, and restricting the effective decision space. Inspired by this mechanism, we propose TDGE (Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration), a human-inspired, model-agnostic algorithm with an automatically constructed task-dimension--feature--item hierarchy. TDGE follows a top-down exploration strategy: it first selects task-relevant feature dimensions, then identifies informative features within those dimensions, and finally recommends concrete items based on the selected features. Experiments on MovieLens-20M, Last.fm, and Amazon recommendation datasets show that TDGE substantially improves exploration efficiency and cold-start adaptation over baseline algorithms. Comparisons with other structured algorithms and ablation studies attribute these gains to TDGE's hierarchical structure and semantic feature-space exploration, with robust results across clustering methods and hierarchy depths. Recommendation-trajectory visualizations also show exploration patterns similar to human dimension-guided behavior.

</details>


### [280] [Understanding Private Evolution as Learning-Augmented Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36678)
*Audra McMillan,Kunal Talwar,Felix Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将Private Evolution (PE)重构为"生成模型增强的Wasserstein学习"，理论上证明借助能捕捉真实分布信息的生成模型可获得更优的性能界（如样本复杂度依赖内在维度而非环境维度），并揭示了标准PE在良好聚类实例上无法收敛的问题，提出几何感知的PE变体保证收敛，实验上具有竞争力并能提升召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PE作为差分隐私合成数据生成算法在实践中表现远优于最坏情况下的Wasserstein分析预测，这一理论与实践之间的差距需要理论解释。同时，标准PE变体在某些简单实例上存在收敛性问题。

Method: 将PE重新表述为生成模型增强的Wasserstein学习，在理论分析中纳入生成模型对真实分布的捕捉能力；分析标准PE变体在良好聚类实例上的收敛失败问题；提出新的几何感知(geometry-aware)版PE。

Result: 理论上，若生成器给出的样本位于与分布相同的低维空间，样本复杂度依赖于内在维度而非环境维度；标准PE变体在简单良好聚类实例上可能无法收敛；新几何感知PE在此类实例上具有可证明的收敛性。实验上，新算法与标准基线相比具有竞争力，并能提升召回率(recall)。

Conclusion: 通过生成模型增强的Wasserstein学习视角，可解释并改进PE的性能，提出的几何感知PE在理论收敛性和实验召回率上均有优势。

Abstract: Private Evolution (PE) is a differentially private algorithm for synthetic data generation. While it can be viewed as a Wasserstein learning algorithm, it performs much better in practice than worst-case Wasserstein analyses would predict. We recast PE as generative model-augmented Wasserstein learning. We show theoretically that when we take into account the use of a generative model that is able to capture something about the true distribution, then we can obtain much better performance bounds. For example, if the generator gives samples in the same low-dimensional space as the distribution, then sample complexity depends on intrinsic, not ambient, dimension. We also show that standard variants of PE can fail to converge on simple well-clustered instances, and propose a new geometry-aware version of PE with provable convergence on such instances. Experimentally, we show that our new algorithm is competitive with standard baselines and can improve recall.

</details>


### [281] [MARCO: Multi-Round Agentic Reinforcement for Conditional Molecular Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36683)
*Shicheng Fang,Yuxin Wang,Zhuo Yang,Xiaohu Xu,Jiahao Lu,Chuanyuan Tan,Tong Zhu,Yining Zheng,Xipeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MARCO 是一个基于评估器反馈的强化学习框架，通过在受限的"提议—反馈—修订"轨迹上训练分子编辑器，在多目标分子优化中同时兼顾有效性、性质改进与相似度控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子优化本质上是迭代过程：提出候选分子、针对多个目标进行评估、在保持与源分子关系的前提下进行修订。然而多数指令跟随模型只输出一个编辑后的分子，把有效性、性质改进和相似度控制压缩到单次响应中，难以实现真正的迭代优化。

Method: 提出 MARCO 框架，在带边界的提议—反馈—修订轨迹上训练分子编辑器。它将每一轮的塑形奖励聚合成无折扣的轨迹回报，用于组相对策略优化（group-relative policy optimization）。并设计两种评估设定：Same-1 在单次响应预算下测试策略，Same-5 测试同一策略在最多五次响应下能否利用验证器反馈。

Result: 在三目标 MuMOInstruct 基准、三个 Qwen 主干模型以及已见/未见指令划分上，经 SFT 初始化的 MARCO 在所有报告的主要设定中都取得了性质成功率与相似度乘积的最高值。Same-5 在测试预算下进一步提升了观测分数；四目标实验和公开检查点实验则检验了跨约束集与初始化范式的迁移能力。

Conclusion: MARCO 通过基于评估器的强化学习与轨迹级优化，有效利用反馈实现迭代式分子编辑，在多目标约束下优于单次响应的做法，并展现出在更多目标与不同初始化条件下的迁移潜力。

Abstract: Molecular optimization is inherently iterative: a candidate is proposed, evaluated against several objectives, and revised while preserving a relationship to the source molecule. Most instruction-following models instead emit one edited molecule, forcing validity, property improvement, and similarity control into a single response. We introduce MARCO, an evaluator-grounded reinforcement-learning framework that trains molecular editors on bounded proposal--feedback--revision trajectories. MARCO aggregates shaped turn rewards into an undiscounted trajectory return for group-relative policy optimization. We evaluate two consequences of this training: Same-1 tests the trained policy under a one-response budget, while Same-5 tests whether the same policy can use verifier feedback when up to five responses are available. Across the three-objective MuMOInstruct benchmark, three Qwen backbones, and seen/unseen instruction splits, SFT-initialized MARCO obtains the highest product of property success rate and similarity in every reported primary setting. Same-5 further improves the observed score under the tested budget, while four-objective and public-checkpoint experiments test transfer across constraint sets and initialization regimes.

</details>


### [282] [Where Root Cause Analysis Fails: A Retrieval-Reranking Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36686)
*Hada Melino Muhammad,Luan Pham,Laure Barrière,Sachin Shetty,Leonardo Pulga,Flora D. Salim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出根因分析（RCA）常用的top@k指标存在盲点，会混淆“检索失败”和“重排序失败”两种失效模式；作者提出检索-重排序分解框架，审计四个基准，并提出结合多信号检索器与LLM重排序器的两阶段流程，在六个基准套件上达到或超过最佳基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RCA研究普遍使用top@k准确率评估方法，但该指标无法区分两种本质不同的失败：真实根因从未进入候选（检索失败）与进入候选但排名过低（重排序失败）。这一盲点导致对方法能力的误判，无法明确改进方向。

Method: 提出检索-重排序分解，将RCA性能拆解为检索与排序两个阶段，并据此审计四个知名基准。实验对比统计基线与图方法在不同故障窗口、候选池、正常数据条件下的表现。基于该分解，构建两阶段流程：多信号检索器 + LLM重排序器，固定配置且无需因果图或标注数据。

Result: 在复杂故障基准上，统计基线将真实根因排错的比例达79-100%，图方法未能明显超越最佳统计基线；在故障于源头显著显现的简单基准上，检索几乎已解决（98-100%）。两阶段流程在全部六个基准套件上匹配或超过最佳基线的top@1准确率（最高+12分）。当所有方法对同一候选排序且保证真因存在时，加入简短系统描述文档可使重排序器在每个基准上领先最佳基线+7至+18分。

Conclusion: top@k指标掩盖了RCA的真实瓶颈，检索-重排序分解能更准确诊断方法失效原因。LLM重排序器配合多信号检索无需因果图与标注数据即可取得领先性能，系统描述文档能显著提升重排序效果，为RCA评估与改进提供新范式。

Abstract: Identifying the root cause of an anomaly among hundreds of sensors is critical for preventing safety incidents and costly downtime in complex monitored systems. Existing studies evaluate root cause analysis (RCA) methods using top@k accuracy. We show that this metric has a fundamental blind spot: it conflates two failure modes, retrieval failure, where the true cause is never considered, and reranking failure, where it is considered but ranked too low. In this work, we introduce a retrieval-reranking decomposition and audit four well-known benchmarks to expose this blind spot. Our experiments show that, on benchmarks with complex faults, statistical baselines mis-rank the true cause 79-100% of the time, and graph-based methods never clearly beat the best statistical baseline, whether their causal graphs are learned on short fault windows, on retrieved candidate pools guaranteed to contain the cause, or on multi-day normal-operation data. Meanwhile, on simple benchmarks where faults manifest significantly at their origin, retrieval is nearly solved (98-100%). Guided by the decomposition, we build a two-stage pipeline combining a multi-signal retriever with an LLM reranker that, as one fixed configuration, matches or exceeds the best baseline's top@1 accuracy on all six benchmark suites (by up to +12 points), with no causal graph or labeled data required. When all methods rank the same retrieved candidates with the true cause guaranteed present, adding a short system-description document lets the reranker lead the best baseline by +7 to +18 points on every benchmark. Code is available at https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/DecompRCA.

</details>


### [283] [CHAIN: Calibrated LLM Forecasting via Causal-Temporal Hypergraph Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36689)
*Wenjin Liu,Chenxi Wang,Yue Lu,Zhe Cui,Haoran Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对大语言模型事件预测中概率输出的系统性校准偏差问题，提出CHAIN方法，将因果-时序超图上的概率预测分解为证据加权、证据聚合与来源融合三阶段，并设计阶段特定的偏差缓解机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在事件预测上取得进展，但其概率输出存在系统性校准偏差，且在不同领域和问题类型间存在异质性，削弱了不确定性决策下概率输出的可信度。现有校准方法通常在预测完成后修正概率输出，未能建模预测过程本身的结构性偏差来源。

Method: 将因果-时序超图上的概率预测分解为三个阶段：证据加权、证据聚合、来源融合，并提出CHAIN，针对每个阶段设计特定机制：(i) 由因果拓扑距离调制时间衰减函数；(ii) 在方向感知去重后，通过Noisy-OR聚合近似独立的因果链；(iii) 由因果覆盖率与方向平衡驱动自适应融合。

Result: 在跨领域预测基准上，CHAIN在期望校准误差（ECE）、Brier分数和准确率上均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过将校准视为预测过程中的结构性建模问题，而非事后修正，CHAIN有效缓解了分阶段的偏差来源，提升了概率预测的校准质量、评分与准确性。项目地址：https://github.com/QwenQKing/Chain。

Abstract: Large language models have achieved significant progress in event forecasting, yet their probability outputs exhibit systematic calibration bias that varies heterogeneously across different domains and question types, undermining the trustworthiness of probabilistic outputs for decision-making under uncertainty. However, existing calibration methods typically correct probability outputs after prediction is complete, without modeling the structural sources of bias within the prediction process itself. To address this challenge, we decompose probabilistic prediction over causal-temporal hypergraphs into three stages, evidence weighting, evidence aggregation, and source fusion, and propose CHAIN, which designs stage-specific mechanisms to mitigate bias at each stage: (i) modulating the temporal decay function by causal topological distance, (ii) aggregating approximately independent causal chains via Noisy-OR after direction-aware deduplication, and (iii) driving adaptive fusion by causal coverage and directional balance. Experimental results on cross-domain forecasting benchmarks show CHAIN outperforms existing methods in expected calibration error, Brier score, and accuracy. Our project is available at https://github.com/QwenQKing/Chain.

</details>


### [284] [Normalize-Then-Precondition: A Hierarchical Approach to Marginal Scale and Interaction Geometry for LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36692)
*Zixuan Gong,Zeyu Gan,Jiaye Teng,Yong Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Normalize-Then-Precondition 框架及 NormPre 系列矩阵优化器，先做边际归一化再用谱预条件处理交互几何，在大规模预训练中优于 AdamW、Muon 和 MANO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矩阵优化器（如 Muon）是新兴方向。作者通过 Muon 的全 Gram 表示发现其同时处理边际尺度信息与交互信息，这启发了一种分层组织几何信息的替代方式。

Method: 提出 Normalize-Then-Precondition 框架：先利用对角 Gram 信息构造边际归一化更新，再对其方向性交互几何施加谱预条件。基于此开发 NormPre，包括采用全局谱预条件的 NormPre-G（基于谱范数最速下降）和局部化谱预条件的 NormPre-L（基于正则化公式并选取主模态）。为支持大规模训练，NormPre-G 使用 Newton-Schulz 迭代，NormPre-L 使用随机草图近似主交互特征子空间。

Result: 理论上证明了简化版 NormPre 具有 O(T^{-1/2}) 收敛保证。在 GPT-2 Small、LLaMA 和 Qwen3 的广泛预训练实验中，两种变体在相同训练预算下均持续优于 AdamW、Muon 和 MANO。效率与谱分析揭示了两种变体的互补优势及其性能-效率权衡。

Conclusion: NormPre 框架为矩阵优化提供了有效且可扩展的新思路，两种变体在性能与效率间形成互补，代码已通过 GitHub 开源。

Abstract: Matrix optimizers have emerged as a promising direction, with Muon standing out as a prominent design. Revisiting Muon through its full-Gram representation, we observe that it jointly processes marginal-scale and interaction information. This opens an alternative way to organize geometric information hierarchically, motivating the Normalize-Then-Precondition framework. Specifically, it first uses diagonal-Gram information to construct a marginally normalized update, then applies spectral preconditioning to its directional interaction geometry. Building on this framework, we develop NormPre with NormPre-G and NormPre-L adopting global and localized spectral preconditioning, grounded in spectral-norm steepest descent and a regularized formulation followed by leading mode selection, respectively. To enable large-scale training, NormPre-G uses Newton-Schulz iterations and NormPre-L employs randomized sketching to approximate the leading interaction eigenspace. Theoretically, we establish $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ convergence guarantees for simplified versions of NormPre. Across extensive pretraining experiments on GPT-2 Small, LLaMA and Qwen3, both variants consistently outperform AdamW, Muon and MANO under matched training budgets. Further efficiency and spectral analyses reveal the complementary strengths of two variants and characterize their performance-efficiency trade-off. We open-source our code through a GitHub repository at https://github.com/zx-gong/NormPre.

</details>


### [285] [Know Thyself, Teach Thyself: Internal Information Flow for Selective Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36695)
*Rui Wang,Ruijie Wang,Bo Chen,Jiangxuan Long,Yingyu Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 InFlow，一种检索引导的在线策略自蒸馏框架，将自蒸馏过程建模为"潜在信息流到已实现信息流"，先检索潜在信息源，再通过教师信念偏移度衡量其实际效果并选择样本进行在线蒸馏，在四个开源语言模型和三个知识领域上取得最优跨模型平均表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自蒸馏将知识蒸馏变为闭环学习，具有递归自我改进的潜力，但缺乏外部教师时，模型必须自行判断哪些信息能改进监督、哪些诱导变化值得学习。现有方法通常孤立地改进教师生成数据或选择训练样本，未度量两个阶段之间传递的信息。

Method: InFlow 将自蒸馏建模为潜在信息到已实现信息的信息流：首先使用经过不确定性校准的隐状态轨迹检索潜在有信息量的来源；随后通过教师初始答案信念与检索条件化答案信念之间的 Jensen–Shannon 散度衡量其已实现效果；信念偏移更大的样本被选中用于在线策略蒸馏。理论分析形式化了检索与选择所优化的信息，并将答案层面的偏移与教师-学生蒸馏差距联系起来。

Result: 在四个开放权重语言模型和三个知识领域上，InFlow 在所比较的选择方法中取得最强的跨模型平均表现，且消融实验支持框架的两个阶段均有效。

Conclusion: InFlow 通过显式建模检索到选择之间的信息流，为无外部教师的自蒸馏提供了更有效的样本选择机制，并验证了检索与选择两阶段各自的贡献。

Abstract: Self-distillation turns knowledge distillation into a closed learning loop and offers a path toward recursive self-improvement. Without an external teacher, however, the model must determine both what information can improve its supervision and which induced changes should be learned. Existing methods typically improve teacher-generated data or select training examples in isolation, leaving the information transferred between these stages unmeasured. We introduce InFlow, a retrieval-guided on-policy self-distillation framework that models this process as potential-to-realized information flow. InFlow first retrieves potentially informative sources using certainty-calibrated hidden-state trajectories, then measures their realized effect through the Jensen--Shannon divergence between the teacher's initial and retrieval-conditioned answer beliefs. Examples with larger belief shifts are selected for on-policy distillation. Our analysis formalizes the information optimized by retrieval and selection and relates the answer-level shift to the teacher--student distillation gap. Across four open-weight language models and three knowledge domains, InFlow achieves the strongest cross-model average among the compared selection methods, with ablations supporting both stages of the framework. Our code is available at https://github.com/1240148048/INFLOW.

</details>


### [286] [Learned Queries and Keys Are All You Need: Replacing the Value Projection with Structured Transforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36698)
*Ene Meco,Emadeldeen Hamdan,A. Enis Cetin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出双头Transformer结构，用正交变换或MA算子替代第三个头，减少参数与缓存，在ImageNet上优于三头Transformer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer参数量和缓存开销较大，需在保持性能的前提下降低资源消耗。

Method: 以双头结构替代三头，用WHT、DCT、DFT、Shearlet变换及乘法避免(MA)算子构建第二个头，将空间patch与其变换在类注意力块中结合。

Result: 在ImageNet上取得优于三头Transformer的结果，并给出大量仿真示例。

Conclusion: 用正交变换或MA算子构建的双头Transformer可在减少参数和缓存的同时提升性能。

Abstract: To reduce the number of parameters and cache memory requirements of transformers we introduce dual-headed transformers instead of three heads. We studied Walsh-Hadamard Transform (WHT), Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), Discrete Fourier Transform, filterbank based Shearlet Transform, and Multiplication-Avoiding (MA) operators to construct dual heads. We combine spatial patches and their orthogonal transforms (or Shearlet and MA operators) in a structure similar to the attention block. We obtained better results than triple headed transformers in ImageNet. Extensive simulation examples are presented.

</details>


### [287] [When Is Coarse Supervision Worth It? Cost-Aware Learning under Unknown Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36704)
*Jianyu Xu,Smriti Jha,Aarti Singh,Bryan Wilder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究成本感知的双分辨率学习：昂贵细标签揭示向量响应，廉价粗标签揭示未知权重下的标量聚合，目标为完整响应，并刻画其信息几何与最优监督分配策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监督信号常存在于多个分辨率上，标注成本与信息含量之间存在权衡。未知的聚合方式会改变粗数据可识别的方向，因此粗监督的价值同时取决于成本、噪声与可识别性，需要系统刻画。

Method: 刻画双分辨率学习的信息几何；提出“估计-跟踪”（estimate-and-track）策略，在线学习聚合规则并跟踪最优分辨率配比；推导粗监督的闭式盈亏平衡条件；证明在线策略达到最优主导累积风险系数，并给出匹配的局部渐近极小极大下界。

Result: 合成实验验证了全细标签/混合监督的相变现象；在线学习器逼近 oracle-share 基准；当粗监督足够有利时，相比全细标签采集获得有限预算收益。

Conclusion: 结果为在不同监督分辨率间平衡信息价值与标注成本提供了有原则的方法。

Abstract: Modern learning systems often acquire supervision at multiple resolutions, trading annotation cost against information content. We study cost-aware two-resolution learning, where expensive fine labels reveal a vector response and cheaper coarse labels reveal a scalar aggregate formed with unknown weights, while the target remains the full response. The challenge is that unknown aggregation changes which directions coarse data can identify, so the value of coarse supervision depends jointly on cost, noise, and identification. We characterize this information geometry and develop an estimate-and-track policy that learns the aggregation rule and tracks the optimal resolution mix. We derive a closed-form break-even condition for coarse supervision and prove that the online policy attains the optimal leading cumulative-risk coefficient, with a matching local asymptotic minimax lower bound. Synthetic experiments support the predicted all-fine/mixed transition, show the online learner approaching the oracle-share benchmark, and demonstrate a finite-budget gain over all-fine acquisition when coarse supervision is sufficiently favorable. Our results provide a principled way to balance information and annotation cost across supervision resolutions.

</details>


### [288] [CALIBUDGET: Calibration-Guided Source Allocation for Fixed-Budget Mixed-Reasoning Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36721)
*Yupeng Chang,Yuan Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CALIBUDGET：一种带下限保护、可靠性感知的整数预算分配器，将数据源曝光量作为显式适应变量，在不改变模型、目标或总预算的前提下，通过少量校准集生成精确配额，小幅调整源配额即可提升异构数据源的适应性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定预算下从异构数据源适应时，不仅要决定用多少数据，还要决定每个数据源获得多少曝光。按规模比例分配会挤占小数据源，而仅按难度分配则会追逐噪声估计或把剩余预算分给接近饱和的池子，因此需要一个更稳健的源配额分配方法。

Method: CALIBUDGET 从训练内部的小型校准划分出发，综合模型需求、扣除下限后的可用量以及自助法（bootstrap）稳定性，生成满足容量约束的精确整数配额，且不改变模型、目标函数或总预算。

Result: 在数学与常识数据结合的受控实验中，CALIBUDGET 在三次配对的 LLaMA-2-7B LoRA+ 运行中，相比最强匹配基线 validation-error-with-floor，在 CommonAvg、FragileAvg、MacroAvg 上分别平均提升 0.56、0.46、0.41 个百分点；Overall 提升 0.18 个百分点，但 MathAvg 下降 0.20 个百分点，显示出覆盖保留的边界而非一致增益。它仅改变 1.14–1.42% 的源预算，却在 24 次常识任务与随机种子的比较中 15 次取得性能提升。

Conclusion: 源配额的小幅变化即可产生重要影响；在配额确定后，可再由样本级选择决定用哪些样本填充各配额。

Abstract: Fixed-budget adaptation from heterogeneous data sources requires deciding not only how much data to use, but how much exposure each source receives. Size-proportional rules can crowd out small sources, whereas difficulty-only rules can chase noisy estimates or allocate residual budget to nearly saturated pools. We introduce CALIBUDGET, a floor-protected, reliability-aware integer allocator that treats source exposure as an explicit adaptation variable. From small train-internal calibration splits, it combines model need, post-floor availability, and bootstrap stability, then produces exact capacity-respecting quotas without changing the model, objective, or total budget. In a controlled setting combining mathematical and commonsense data, CALIBUDGET improves CommonAvg, FragileAvg, and MacroAvg over validation-error-with-floor, the strongest matched comparator, in all three paired LLaMA-2-7B LoRA+ runs. The respective mean gains are 0.56, 0.46, and 0.41 percentage points (pp). Overall increases by 0.18 pp, whereas MathAvg decreases by 0.20 pp, exposing a coverage-retention boundary rather than a uniform gain. CALIBUDGET changes only 1.14-1.42% of the source budget but improves performance in 15 of 24 comparisons across commonsense tasks and seeds. These results suggest that small changes in source quotas can matter; example-level selection can then determine which examples fill each quota.

</details>


### [289] [Routing in Gradient Space: Balanced Usage Is Not Expert Specialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36724)
*Yuchen Li,Mingyu Du,Zongqi Fan,Nguyen H. Tran,Ken-Tye Yong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出梯度对齐路由（GAR），将路由建模为梯度划分问题，在多任务文本分类中一致优于任务损失路由及多种基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏专家模型虽能均衡流量，却可能在同一专家内混合不兼容的训练信号；论文希望从梯度划分视角研究路由，使专家分组与梯度对齐，而非仅追求负载均衡。

Method: 将路由视为梯度划分问题，提出GAR：其负载归一化的路由目标奖励梯度对齐的观测被分到同一专家。在五个多任务文本分类混合数据集上，与仅任务损失路由、梯度组合/梯度冲突方法及负载均衡损失对比；实验涵盖完全可训练RoBERTa主干+分类头专家、冻结DeBERTa与Qwen3-1.7B主干+低秩适配器专家，并考察Top-1路由、可训练全参数FFN专家与更大主干。

Result: GAR取得最高聚合验证准确率：可训练RoBERTa设置下比仅任务损失路由高1.07个百分点；冻结DeBERTa与Qwen3-1.7B+低秩适配器设置下同样第一，高1.10个百分点，同时专家负载更均衡、梯度质量纯度更高（各专家梯度范数质量中来自主导任务的占比）；负载均衡损失使负载更平坦，但纯度仍接近仅任务损失水平。Top-1路由、可训练全参数FFN专家及更大主干也显示正向聚合增益。

Conclusion: 结果区分了专家负载均衡与基于梯度的路由组织，表明梯度信息引导的路由在多任务文本分类中具有预测价值。

Abstract: Sparse expert models can distribute traffic evenly while still grouping incompatible training signals within the same experts. We study routing as a gradient-partitioning problem and introduce gradient-aligned routing (GAR), whose load-normalized router objective rewards grouping observations with aligned gradients. On five multi-task text-classification mixtures, we compare GAR with task-loss-only routing, gradient-combination and gradient-conflict methods, and load-balancing losses. With a fully trainable RoBERTa backbone and classification-head experts, GAR has the highest aggregate validation accuracy, 1.07 percentage points above task-loss-only routing. With frozen DeBERTa and Qwen3-1.7B backbones and low-rank adapter experts, it again ranks first, 1.10 points above task-loss-only routing, with better-balanced expert load and higher gradient-mass purity, the share of each expert's gradient-norm mass from its dominant task; the load-balancing losses flatten load further but leave this purity near its task-loss-only level. Top-1 routing, trainable full-parameter feed-forward network (FFN) experts, and a larger backbone also show positive aggregate gains. The results distinguish expert-load balance from gradient-based routing organization and indicate the predictive value of gradient-informed routing in multi-task text classification.

</details>


### [290] [Backpropagated Output Momentum: Relocating Optimizer History from Parameters to Task Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36738)
*Yuchen Li,Zongqi Fan,Nguyen H. Tran,Ken-Tye Yong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Backpropagated Output Momentum (BOM)，将动量存储从参数量级的梯度滑动平均改为输出端预测误差的紧凑滑动平均，并在每步通过当前网络重新投影历史，从而大幅降低优化器状态开销并提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统优化器动量以与参数同规模的滑动平均存储历史梯度，导致存储成本高，且每个历史信号被固定在计算时的坐标中，无法随网络更新而变化。

Method: BOM 在模型输出端存储预测误差的紧凑滑动平均，并在每一步通过当前网络将其重新投影；保留当前监督梯度，可作为一阶动量组件替换多种自适应优化器，也可作为插件与已有状态压缩优化器结合。

Result: 在三种组合中，参数量级优化器状态减少 49.7%-99.8%；在三个语言主干上平均配对步时减少 4.0%；在语言与视觉微调中平均验证性能提升，主要五项任务对比中提升 1.42 分；语言与视觉预训练研究及匹配机制对照进一步验证了该方法在不同输出空间与模型规模下的效果。

Conclusion: 将动量历史迁移到输出空间并通过当前网络重投影，是一种有效的优化器状态压缩与性能改进方案，具备良好的通用性和可插拔性。

Abstract: Optimizer momentum is usually stored as a parameter-sized moving average of past gradients, which makes history costly and fixes each past signal in the coordinates in which it was computed. We introduce Backpropagated Output Momentum (BOM), which instead stores a compact moving average of prediction errors at the model output and reprojects that history through the current network at every step. A batch-level analysis characterizes the information retained and omitted by this relocation, while the implementation preserves the current supervised gradient and can replace the first-moment component of several adaptive optimizers. As a plug-in for momentum-based optimizers, including ones that already compress their state, BOM reduces parameter-shaped optimizer state by 49.7-99.8% in three compositions and, averaged over three language backbones, paired step time by 4.0%. It also improves mean validation performance across language and vision fine-tuning, by 1.42 points in the primary five-task comparison. Language and vision pretraining studies, together with matched mechanism controls, further test the construction across output spaces and model scales.

</details>


### [291] [Efficient Offline Learning of Ranking Policies via Top-$k$ Policy Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36740)
*Ren Kishimoto,Koichi Tanaka,Haruka Kiyohara,Yusuke Narita,Yasuo Yamamoto,Nobuyuki Shimizu,Yuta Saito*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出R-POD方法，通过top-k策略分解结合策略梯度与回归方法，解决排序式推荐系统中Off-Policy Learning因动作空间巨大导致的方差与偏差问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商、新闻等推荐系统需要为用户提供可交互的排序，而离线策略学习（OPL）可利用历史日志数据学习新排序策略。但排序场景下动作空间由唯一物品的排列构成，规模极其庞大，使OPL极具挑战。现有方法主要分两类：基于策略的方法（通常用重要性加权策略梯度）因动作空间大而方差高；基于回归的方法用传统机器学习估计期望奖励，虽避免方差却可能偏差严重。因此需要一种兼顾两者优势的新方法。

Method: 提出R-POD（Ranking Policy Optimization via Top-k Policy Decomposition）。将排序策略分解为两个阶段：第一阶段策略用于选择top-k动作，第二阶段策略在给定top-k动作的条件下选择底部动作。第一阶段策略采用新的策略梯度估计器学习，第二阶段策略采用基于回归的方法学习。由于重要性加权仅作用于top-k动作，可显著降低方差。

Result: R-POD将策略方法与回归方法有效结合，大幅降低方差；并证明其第一阶段策略的策略梯度估计器在一种条件成对正确性条件下是无偏的，该条件仅要求可以正确估计共享相同top-k动作的排序对的期望奖励差异。

Conclusion: R-POD通过top-k策略分解有效融合策略梯度与回归方法，缓解了排序OPL中的方差与偏差问题，且在温和的成对正确性条件下具有无偏性。

Abstract: Many recommender systems such as for e-commerce and news platforms aim to provide users with rankings they are likely to interact with. Off-Policy Learning (OPL) of ranking policies enables us to learn new ranking policies using only historical logged data. However, ranking settings make OPL remarkably challenging because their action spaces consist of permutations of unique items, being extremely large. Existing methods primarily use either policy- or regression-based approaches. The policy-based approach, which typically uses importance-weighted policy gradients, can suffer from high variance due to large action spaces. The regression-based approach, on the other hand, estimates the expected reward using conventional machine learning methods, avoiding variance issues but potentially suffering from severe bias. To circumvent these issues of existing methods, we propose a new OPL method for ranking, named Ranking Policy Optimization via Top-$k$ Policy Decomposition (R-POD), which combines the policy- and regression-based approaches in an effective fashion. Specifically, R-POD decomposes a ranking policy into a first-stage policy for selecting top-$k$ actions and a second-stage policy for choosing the bottom actions given the top-$k$ actions. It learns the first-stage policy using a new policy gradient estimator and the second-stage policy via the regression-based approach. This method can substantially reduce variance, since it applies importance weighting only to the top-$k$ actions. We also demonstrate that our policy-gradient estimator for the first-stage policy is unbiased under a conditional pairwise correctness condition, which only requires that the expected reward differences of pairs of rankings sharing the same top-$k$ actions can be estimated correctly.

</details>


### [292] [Group-Marginalized Self-Rewarding RL Drives Zero-Label Self-Evolving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36750)
*Yiming Wang,Yikang Liu,Qingyuan Tian,Xingyu Chen,Zhuosheng Zhang,Zhaopeng Tu,Rui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation（GMAE），通过对响应在不同组上下文下的奖励实现进行聚合，估计期望优势，提升自奖励强化学习的稳定性与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于集成（ensemble）的自奖励强化学习方法从rollout组中构造奖励参考。但响应的奖励表示依赖其随机采样的组上下文（同组其他响应），单一组上下文实现可能遗漏期望的奖励信号，为策略优化提供不可靠的指导。

Method: 提出Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation（GMAE），将响应在不同可能上下文下的奖励实现聚合为响应级分布，并据此估计期望优势。

Result: 在八个基准和四个基座模型上实验，表现出强性能与跨域泛化能力；同时具备稳定学习、低额外开销以及在训练数据集与RL骨干上的良好适用性。

Conclusion: GMAE通过边缘化组上下文缓解单次采样带来的奖励信号偏差，为LLM自奖励RL提供更可靠的策略优化信号，兼具性能、稳定性与通用性。

Abstract: Self-rewarding reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to self-evolve without human labels. Existing ensemble-based methods construct reward references from rollout groups and assign rewards accordingly. However, a response's reward representation also depends on its randomly sampled group context, i.e., the other responses in its group. Using only one group-context realization may miss desired reward signals and provide unreliable guidance for policy optimization. To address this issue, we propose Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation (GMAE), which aggregates reward realizations across possible contexts into a response-level distribution and estimates expected advantages. Experiments across eight benchmarks and four base models demonstrate strong performance and cross-domain generalization. GMAE also exhibits stable learning, low extra cost, and good applicability across training datasets and RL backbones.

</details>


### [293] [cktFormer: Transformer-Based Approach for Automated Analog Circuit Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36752)
*Pasindu Dodampegama,Praveen Wijesinghe,Naveen Basnayake,Keshawa Jayasundara,Tharindu Bandaragoda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出双Transformer架构，将网表数据建模为图结构，通过节点预测与边预测两个互连模型协同生成电路，在生成有效性上超越AnalogGenie和cktGNN。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电路设计复杂且迭代性强，需在功耗、成本、信号完整性等约束下选择元件。人工设计耗时且易出错，虽其他制造环节已受益于AI优化，但电路设计仍是瓶颈，制约整体生产效率。生成式AI与机器学习有望自动化并改进该环节。

Method: 采用双Transformer架构，利用注意力机制建模复杂的非序列化电路关系。将网表数据组织为图表示，以有效学习电路拓扑与元件交互。系统包含两个互连模型：负责提出元件的节点预测模型，以及推断有效连接的边预测模型，通过协作且解耦的设计兼顾元件级语义与全局结构一致性。

Result: 在实验中，该架构在生成电路的有效性方面优于AnalogGenie和cktGNN等近期模型。

Conclusion: 通过解决现有方法的关键局限，该工作推进了电子工程自动化，并为AI驱动的电路综合提供了基准。

Abstract: Circuit design is a complex and iterative process that requires expertise in electronic engineering. It involves selecting components while meeting performance constraints, such as power efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and signal integrity. However, manual design is time-consuming and prone to errors. Although other stages of the manufacturing pipeline have benefited from AI-driven optimizations, circuit design remains a bottleneck, limiting overall productivity. Generative AI and machine learning offer the potential to automate and improve this stage, boosting efficiency and accuracy. To address this, we introduce a dual transformer architecture that bridges the gap between AI and circuit design by leveraging attention mechanisms to model complex, non-sequential circuit relationships. Our approach structures netlist data into graph-based representations, enabling effective learning of circuit topology and component interactions. The system consists of two interlinked models: a node prediction model that proposes components and an edge prediction model that infers valid connections. This collaborative and decoupled design captures both component-level semantics and global structural coherence. In our experiments, this architecture outperforms recent models such as AnalogGenie and cktGNN in the validity of generated circuits. By addressing key limitations in existing methods, our work advances automation in electronics engineering and contributes a benchmark for AI-driven circuit synthesis.

</details>


### [294] [QuantMLA: Function-Aligned Dual-Path Quantization for Low-Bit MLA KV Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36760)
*Zunhai Su,Yuxuan Sun,Jianchao Tan,Tao Zhang,Ruihan Hu,Yuchen Xie,Xunliang Cai,Ngai Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出QuantMLA，一个针对MLA双路径（content与RoPE）低比特量化的函数对齐框架，首次实现content与RoPE缓存的联合INT4缓存，并在INT2/INT4混合配置下保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLA虽支持紧凑缓存，但缓存内存仍随上下文长度和批大小线性增长。传统量化方法未针对MLA双路径误差特性进行建模，尤其RoPE路径误差会被显著放大，因此需要专门的双路径量化方法。

Method: 1) 建立MLA双路径量化误差的系统模型，分析其对注意力输出失真的不同影响及RoPE路径误差放大机制；2) 推导路径特定的变换空间，保持全精度计算且可离线融合进模型参数，消除在线变换开销；3) 在此空间内以函数对齐目标学习变换：content路径用注意力输出重构，RoPE路径用位置QK重构并给出输出失真理论上界；4) 开发原生低比特MLA注意力核，将解包与反量化直接集成到注意力计算中。

Result: 在四个MLA模型家族上，首次实现content与RoPE缓存的联合INT4缓存且精度损失极小；content压缩至INT2、RoPE key保持INT4时在推理与代码基准上仍具竞争力。物理缓存布局在128K上下文下实现3.59倍压缩，缓存压力服务负载下整体作业输出吞吐较BF16提升5.168倍。

Conclusion: QuantMLA通过双路径误差建模与函数对齐量化，实现了MLA缓存的低比特高效压缩，兼顾精度与推理吞吐，为长上下文大模型推理提供实用方案。

Abstract: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) enables expressive multi-head attention with compact caches for its content and decoupled RoPE paths, yet cache memory still scales linearly with context length and batch size. In this work, we establish a systematic model of MLA's dual-path quantization errors, characterizing their distinct effects on attention-output distortion and explaining the pronounced amplification of RoPE-path errors. Guided by this analysis, we introduce QuantMLA, a function-aligned framework for low-bit dual-path quantization. We derive path-specific transformation spaces that preserve full-precision computation while remaining fully fusible into model parameters offline, eliminating online transformation overhead. Within these spaces, QuantMLA learns path-specific transformations with function-aligned objectives: attention-output reconstruction captures the content path's coupled matching and aggregation errors, while positional QK reconstruction preserves the RoPE-induced component of the attention logits and admits a theoretical bound on output distortion. Across four MLA model families, QuantMLA enables, to our knowledge, the first reported joint INT4 caching of the content and RoPE caches with minimal accuracy degradation. Further compressing the content cache to INT2 while retaining the RoPE key cache at INT4 maintains competitive performance on challenging reasoning and code benchmarks. We develop a native low-bit MLA attention kernel that integrates unpacking and dequantization directly into attention computation. The physical cache layout provides 3.59x compression at 128K context, while a cache-pressure serving workload achieves 5.168x higher whole-job output throughput than BF16. The code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [295] [Federated Clustering with Unknown Local and Global Cluster Cardinalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36762)
*Mitushi Goyal,Tarun S.,Riddhanya Senapathi,Arun Raman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两阶段联邦聚类框架，在全局与本地簇数均未知时，先用自适应分裂-合并（ASM）估计各客户端本地簇数，再供FedGEM等聚合器使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦聚类方法虽不要求全局簇数K，却仍假设每个客户端已知本地簇数K_g。在独立运营的工业站点故障诊断等场景中，客户端对自身数据的了解并不比服务器多，该假设难以成立。

Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段用自适应分裂-合并（ASM），通过BIC驱动的分裂生长球形高斯混合模型，再合并多余分量；不使用标签，仅在留出的客户端数据上选择超参数，且不对簇跨客户端共享方式作假设。推导了闭式分裂准则，其临界簇大小随各向异性降低、随维度升高。第二阶段将估计的本地簇数替代真值输入FedGEM等需要本地计数的聚合器。

Result: 在八个数据集上，ASM配合FedGEM平均ARI为0.333，优于次优的无标签估计器（0.256），接近提供真实本地簇数时的0.361。同时给出最可靠的全局K估计，并在客户端规模与本地基数解耦时保持稳健。实证还发现过度分裂随每簇点数增加而增长，而联邦化会将点数分散到各客户端。

Conclusion: 该框架在全局和本地簇数均未知的现实设定下可行，ASM能有效估计本地簇数并提升联邦聚类性能与全局K估计可靠性。

Abstract: Federated clustering methods that do not require the global number of clusters $K$ still assume that each client knows its local number $K_g$. This assumption is hard to justify when clients know no more about their data than the server does, as in fault diagnosis across independently operated industrial sites. We propose a two-phase framework in which neither count is known: each client first estimates $K_g$ from its own data, and an aggregator that requires local counts, such as FedGEM, then uses these estimates in place of the true values. For the first phase we introduce Adaptive Split--Merge (ASM), which grows a spherical Gaussian mixture by BIC-driven splitting and then merges excess components. ASM uses no labels, selects its hyperparameters on held-out client data only, and makes no assumption about how clusters are shared across clients. We derive a closed-form split criterion whose critical cluster size falls with anisotropy and rises with dimension, and show empirically that over-fragmentation grows with the number of points per cluster, which federation divides among clients. Across eight datasets, ASM with FedGEM attains a mean ARI of 0.333, against 0.256 for the next best label-free estimator and 0.361 when the true local counts are supplied. It also gives the most reliable global estimates of $K$ and is robust when client size is decoupled from local cardinality.

</details>


### [296] [Graph-Spectral Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36765)
*Zepeng Zhang,Jhony H. Giraldo,Wenbin Wang,Olga Fink*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GRASP，一种基于图谱路径的流匹配框架，用于多变量时间序列异常检测，通过将图结构融入概率路径提升检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多变量时间序列异常检测依赖观测与模型输出的差异，标准流匹配采用线性概率路径，忽略了变量间依赖关系，与结构化数据分布不匹配。

Method: GRASP通过最小化结合动能与图狄利克雷能量的固定端点作用量，将图结构融入概率路径，得到基于图频率依赖双曲插值的闭式路径；训练速度预测器，用跨源样本、流时间和图频率加权的速度差异进行异常检测。

Result: 理论上证明GRASP对拉普拉斯特征基选择具有不变性，并将期望oracle异常分数分解为有界端点不确定性和图频率加权Fisher差异；四个基准实验证明其优越的异常检测性能并验证了图谱路径与加权机制的有效性。

Conclusion: GRASP通过图谱路径的流匹配有效融合变量依赖结构，验证了优越的异常检测性能。

Abstract: Multivariate time series anomaly detection typically relies on evaluating discrepancies between observations and outputs produced by models trained on normal data. An alternative perspective is to characterize the distribution of normal data through the generative dynamics, i.e., the velocity field, of flow matching models. However, standard flow matching typically adopts linear probability paths that overlook dependencies among variables, leading to a misalignment with the structured data distribution. To address this issue, we propose GRASP, a flow matching framework with a graph-spectral path for multivariate time series anomaly detection. GRASP incorporates graph structure into the probability path by minimizing a fixed-endpoint action that combines kinetic energy with graph Dirichlet energy. This formulation yields a closed-form path based on graph-frequency-dependent hyperbolic interpolation. A velocity predictor trained on normal data then detects anomalies using weighted velocity discrepancies aggregated across source samples, flow times, and graph frequencies. Theoretically, we establish that GRASP is invariant to the choice of Laplacian eigenbasis and decompose its expected oracle anomaly score into bounded endpoint uncertainty and graph-frequency-weighted Fisher discrepancy. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate the superior anomaly detection performance of GRASP and validate the effectiveness of its graph-spectral path and weighting mechanism.

</details>


### [297] [When Can Prefixes Compile LoRA? Exact Resource-Capped Tests for Frozen Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36766)
*Joyanta Jyoti Mondal,Ibne Farabi Shihab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明"固定连续前缀替代低秩适配器"成立与否取决于适配器目标，并给出可观测性、可实现性、可实施性三个条件，揭示部分适配效果无法被前缀编译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在注意力头冻结时，固定连续前缀能否等价替代给定的低秩适配器，并明确这种替代成立的条件与边界。

Method: 从三个条件展开分析：(1) 可观测性，分析单一因果读出下独立键值前缀仅通过query、注意力划分与value分子感知内容，并引入norm cap；(2) 可实现性，将前缀归结为两个聚合变量，建立二阶锥规划刻画norm-capped最优解，并考察固定输出投影；(3) 可实施性，研究仿射query暴露下用2r个符号槽近似rank-r value更新及其数值精度问题。

Result: 目标在相等摘要的不同输入上产生误差下限，norm cap将其扩展到近似相等摘要；norm-capped最优解为可达二阶锥规划，可区分两侧等范数rank-one value更新；2r符号槽可近似rank-r更新但取值以O(ε^{-3/2})增长，float64通过全部400项容差检查而bfloat16仅38项；在GPT-2首层三个头上，capped最优仍留下18.4%–74.2%的投影适配效果未被编译，且value–query序依赖具体头。

Conclusion: 固定连续前缀替代低秩适配器仅在满足特定可观测性、可实现性与可实施性条件时局部成立，且存在不可忽略的未编译残差；结论限于单头局部近似，不涉及整网等价。

Abstract: Can a fixed continuous prefix replace a given low-rank adapter while the attention head stays frozen?
